title_translated: 面向孟加拉国法律场景的高效大语言模型蒸馏：一种适配智能手机的检索增强生成模型
summary_translated: 孟加拉国的法律信息对大多数公民而言难以获取。法规文本仅以英文呈现，专业律师集中于城市地区，依赖云端的AI在移动网络不可靠的环境中失效，而幻觉产生的法律文本可能造成直接伤害。该系统仅处理法规解释；需要司法判例或案例法推理的问题不在其范围内。为弥合法规获取差距，我们通过两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏将一个90亿参数的Gemma-2教师模型压缩为20亿参数的学生模型。第一阶段在9,429个质量筛选后的法律问答对上进行监督微调（从14,514个生成查询中获得65%采纳率）；第二阶段在温度tau=4.0下最小化与教师模型每标记top-50 logits的稀疏Kullback-Leibler散度，采用QLoRA实现（4位NF4，秩为32的LoRA适配器）。先前的法律语言模型主要针对通用法律英语；本系统专注于孟加拉国的成文法。每个响应通过混合检索实现，结合密集语义搜索（60%）和BM25（40%），覆盖36,029条来自孟加拉国宪法和国家立法的法规段落。在50个查询的英文基准测试中，蒸馏模型达到ROUGE-L 0.4715和BERTScore F1 0.5679，相比检索增强的未蒸馏基线（ROUGE-L 0.2323，BERTScore 0.2340）分别提升103%和143%。适配器量化后大小为1.6 GB（GGUF Q4_K_M），在无网络连接的Pixel 6上运行速度为每秒4-8个词元。跨语言评估在50个孟加拉语查询上取得ROUGE-L 0.4083和BERTScore 0.8133，表明系统能有效从孟加拉语输入中检索英文语料库内容。在单评估者试点中，执业律师对50个响应的加权平均评分为4.16/5（90%评为4或5），支持其超出文本重叠度量的实用性。

summary: Most existing time series forecasting methods rely solely on numerical observations, overlooking rich contextual information from auxiliary texts. Recent multimodal approaches attempt to incorporate textual signals, but they often treat text as static features or use large language models as forecasting backbones, limiting their ability to capture temporal dynamics and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose TAC-Time, a unified framework that transforms textual information into additional temporal channels. By modeling text features jointly with numerical sequences in a shared temporal backbone, TAC-Time preserves temporal continuity and periodic structures while remaining efficient and scalable. This formulation also enables systematic interpretability analyses. We show strong cross-modal dependencies through attention and frequency-domain analyses, and identify predictive textual signals whose correlation-aware alignment yields partial forecasting improvements. Extensive experiments on real-world multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that TAC-Time outperforms prior methods.
title: TAC-Time: Texts as Channels For Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables
title_translated: TAC-Time：文本作为多模态时间序列预测的通道
summary_translated: 现有大多数时间序列预测方法仅依赖数值观测，忽略了辅助文本中丰富的上下文信息。近期的多模态方法尝试引入文本信号，但通常将文本视为静态特征或使用大型语言模型作为预测主干，限制了其捕捉时间动态的能力并增加了计算成本。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TAC-Time，一种统一框架，将文本信息转化为额外的时间通道。通过在共享时间主干中联合建模文本特征与数值序列，TAC-Time保持了时间连续性和周期结构，同时保持高效性和可扩展性。该形式还支持系统的可解释性分析。我们通过注意力和频域分析展示了强跨模态依赖关系，并识别出相关性感知对齐后能带来部分预测改进的预测性文本信号。在真实世界多模态基准上的大量实验表明，TAC-Time优于先前方法。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is hard to monitor in production: exhaustive relevance labels do not exist for non-stationary multi-million-passage corpora that re-index in real time. As a result, retrieval quality is generally understudied and often deprioritised in favour of generation-oriented metrics. In this work, we propose auditing retrieval coverage by probing for evidence of missing documents rather than enumerating every relevant one. Our method Re:CAP (REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing) is a reference-free audit loop applied to a deployed RAG pipeline's initial answer and retrieved context: it identifies the topics already covered, generates probing questions for plausibly missing topics, retrieves candidate documents, and applies an LLM-as-judge to retain only those that introduce previously-unretrieved information. On four public benchmarks, Re:CAP recovers 9-29% of gold labels that flat BM25 top-500 cannot reach, rising to 48% on TREC-COVID. On MuSiQue Re:CAP beats flat hybrid top-500 by +12.9 pp on recall at less than half the document budget. An ensemble BM25, dense, and hybrid baseline (top-500 each) still leaves out 21.2% of gold docs on TREC-COVID that Re:CAP recovers; human annotators judge that 78.9% of those structurally distinct documents add new information to the baseline answer (Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79, n = 123), and 73.9% on live production traffic (n = 180). End-to-end recall is reproducible to within $\pm$1% across three independent runs, making Re:CAP a stable instrument for periodic retrieval audits.
title: Re:CAP - Auditing Retrieval Coverage in Production RAG Pipelines
title_translated: Re:CAP —— 生产环境中检索覆盖率的审计
summary_translated: 在生产环境中，检索增强生成（RAG）难以监控：非平稳的数百万段落语料库实时重新索引，不存在详尽的相关性标签。因此，检索质量通常研究不足，常被生成导向指标所忽视。本文提出通过探测缺失文档的证据来审计检索覆盖率，而非枚举每一个相关文档。我们的方法Re:CAP（基于迭代探测的检索覆盖率审计）是一个无需参考的审计循环，应用于部署的RAG管道的初始答案和检索到的上下文：它识别已覆盖的主题，生成可能缺失主题的探测问题，检索候选文档，并利用大语言模型作为裁判，仅保留引入此前未检索到信息的文档。在四个公开基准上，Re:CAP恢复了9-29%的黄金标签，而平坦的BM25 top-500无法触及，甚至在TREC-COVID上达到48%。在MuSiQue上，Re:CAP以不到一半的文档预算实现了比平坦混合top-500高出12.9个百分点的召回率。一个集成的BM25、密集和混合基线（各取top-500）在TREC-COVID上仍遗漏21.2%的黄金文档，而Re:CAP成功恢复；人工标注者判断其中78.9%的结构性差异文档为基线答案新增了信息（Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79，n = 123），在实际生产流量中这一比例为73.9%（n = 180）。端到端召回率在三次独立运行中可重现至±1%以内，使Re:CAP成为定期检索审计的稳定工具。

summary: Questions scraped from the web are used across academia and industry as a proxy for what people want to know. Across QA training data, retrieval benchmarks, and content strategy, questions on a page are assumed to reflect human intent. We test this assumption at scale by extracting 13.4B question occurrences across 110 FineWeb snapshots (2013-2025), and report three findings. First, you can tell who is asking: provenance (the host/page of questions) leaves a signal in question form, and a logistic model can separate genuine user questions from templated/manufactured ones at AUC 0.725 via length and surrounding context rather than question type, though only 0.554 against commerce FAQ writing. Second, question frequency does not measure demand: the most-frequent questions are boilerplate/templated (over 70% of the top thousand), so occurrence counts measure how often a string was published and not how often it was asked. Third, over twelve years the genuine share of occurrences fell by 79% (42-56% after controlling for crawl composition), with question length and context decreasing. We present the first diachronic, occurrence-level measurement of web question provenance, and find the crawlable web's questions have shifted from being asked by humans toward manufactured for machines to read.
title: You Can Tell Who's Asking: What the Web's Questions Are Made Of, and Where They Come From
comment: Accepted to the 13th Web as Corpus Workshop (WaC-13) at EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 你能看出提问者是谁：网络问题的构成及其来源
summary_translated: 从网络抓取的问题被学术界和工业界广泛用作人们想知道什么的代理。在问答训练数据、检索基准和内容策略中，页面上的问题被认为反映了人类意图。我们通过提取110个FineWeb快照（2013–2025年）中的134亿个问题实例，大规模检验这一假设，并报告三个发现。第一，你能看出提问者是谁：问题来源（主机/页面）会在问题形式中留下信号，逻辑回归模型可通过长度和周围上下文而非问题类型，以AUC 0.725区分真实用户问题与模板化/制造的问题，但与商业FAQ写作的区分能力仅为0.554。第二，问题频率并不反映需求：最频繁的问题大多是模板化/标准化的（前一千名中超过70%），因此出现次数衡量的是字符串被发布的频率，而非被询问的频率。第三，十二年来，真实问题占比下降了79%（控制爬取组成后为42%-56%），问题长度和上下文也在减少。我们首次提供了关于网络问题来源的历时性、实例级测量，发现可爬取网络中的问题已从人类提出转向为机器阅读而制造。

summary: Generative AI enables scalable production of educational videos, but current systems largely focus on producing visually coherent content rather than supporting learning. As a result, generated videos often lack explicit pedagogical structure, reliable quality control, and mechanisms for assessing learner understanding or addressing misconceptions. In this work, we introduce PIVOT (Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring), a generative video tutoring framework for STEM learning via learning-centered instructional support.1 Inspired by conventional teaching workflows, our framework integrates pedagogy into the full generation pipeline: it first uses instructional principles to guide storyboard generation, then produces verified multimodal videos through code-centric generation and a pedagogical verification harness, and finally connects videos with assessment and misconception-aware remediation. Experiments and expert evaluations across four STEM domains show that our framework produces educational videos with pedagogically aligned content, clear and engaging presentation, coherent instructional flow, and perceived effectiveness for learning. These findings suggest a human-centered perspective on educational content generation: generative systems should be evaluated and designed not only by what they produce, but also by how they support teaching practices, learner understanding, and corrective feedback.
title: From Content Generation to Learning Support: Pedagogy-Guided Generative Video Tutors for STEM Learning
comment: accepted to EMNLP 2026, code available at GitHub
title_translated: 从内容生成到学习支持：面向STEM教育的教育学引导型生成视频导师
summary_translated: 生成式AI实现了教育视频的大规模生产，但当前系统主要关注视觉上的连贯性，而非学习支持。因此，生成的视频往往缺乏明确的教育学结构、可靠的质控机制以及评估学习者理解或纠正误解的手段。本文提出PIVOT（教育学引导的教学视频辅导框架），通过以学习为中心的教学支持，实现STEM领域的生成式视频辅导。受传统教学流程启发，该框架将教育学理念融入整个生成流程：首先利用教学原则指导故事板生成，然后通过代码驱动的生成和教育学验证机制生成经过验证的多模态视频，并最终将视频与评估及误解感知的补救措施相连接。在四个STEM领域进行的实验和专家评估表明，该框架生成的教育视频具有符合教育学的内容、清晰且吸引人的呈现方式、连贯的教学流程，并被普遍认为对学习有效。这些发现提示了教育内容生成的人本视角：生成系统不仅应根据其产出内容进行评估和设计，还应关注其如何支持教学实践、学习者理解以及纠错反馈。

summary: Best-of-$N$ is a widely used inference strategy for complex reasoning, whose effectiveness depends on whether sampled candidates can cover diverse and high-quality reasoning paths. However, post-trained reasoning models often suffer from \emph{exploration collapse}, where independent rollouts repeatedly follow similar reasoning paths and limit the gains from increasing the rollout budget. Existing methods alleviate this issue by promoting broader exploration, but do not explicitly guide exploration toward continuations that make meaningful progress, resulting in limited exploration efficiency. To address this, we propose \emph{\underline{S}tate-conditioned \underline{P}rogress-guided \underline{S}teering} (SPS), a training-free latent steering framework. Specifically, SPS constructs a state-conditioned Direction Bank containing multiple progress-guided steering vectors for different prefix-state regions. During online inference, SPS retrieves a suitable steering vector based on the current prefix state and applies it at high-uncertainty transitions to guide the next reasoning step toward meaningful progress. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and benchmarks demonstrate that SPS consistently outperforms strong baselines. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of its key designs and offer valuable insights for future research. The code is available at https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS.
title: Efficient Reasoning Exploration via State-Conditioned Latent Steering with Progress Guidance
title_translated: 通过状态条件化潜在引导与进展指引实现高效推理探索
summary_translated: Best-of-$N$是一种广泛用于复杂推理的推断策略，其有效性取决于采样候选是否能覆盖多样且高质量的推理路径。然而，后训练的推理模型常出现	extit{探索坍缩}现象，即独立推演反复遵循相似的推理路径，限制了增加推演预算带来的收益。现有方法虽通过促进更广泛的探索缓解此问题，但未显式引导探索朝向能实现有意义进展的延续路径，导致探索效率有限。为此，我们提出	extit{“S”状态条件化“P”进展引导“S” Steering}（SPS），一种无需训练的潜在引导框架。具体而言，SPS构建了一个状态条件化的方向库，包含针对不同前缀状态区域的多种进展引导方向向量。在线推理过程中，SPS根据当前前缀状态检索合适的引导向量，并在高不确定性转换点应用该向量，以引导下一步推理朝着有意义的进展方向进行。在多个模型规模和基准测试上的大量实验表明，SPS始终优于强基线。进一步分析验证了其关键设计的有效性，并为未来研究提供了宝贵洞见。代码已公开于https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS。

summary: Crash datasets that carry an investigator narrative hold information the coded fields omit. Coding those narratives at scale has been blocked by three obstacles. Frontier large language models are costly at that scale, their generated text cannot be verified, and no rule says how much output a human must check. This paper formulates narrative coding as gated, typed decisions answered by Jev, a System One model that returns probabilities over analyst-defined options and generates no text. A screen covered 499,500 Texas narratives and 195,857 were coded with a 27-question schema. Cost is governed by schema size rather than narrative length. The probabilities are audited against coded fields and against 2,416 blinded human judgments drawn under a stated sampling design. Two frontier large language models are benchmarked on the same records. Against human labels the typed model attains an F1 of 0.908. One frontier model gains 0.059 and the other is indistinguishable from it. Calibration varies by model rather than by paradigm, so each model must be audited. Recalibration on the same labels reduces calibration error by a factor of 3.3. Agreement with coded fields understates fidelity to the narrative by a median of 0.26 in kappa. A resolution-floor bound covers any model that reports probabilities on a discrete grid. A review budget over flagged records gives the records a human must read per variable and per year. Adding the calibrated variables to the coded fields raises the injury and fatal crashes attributed to nine factors by 10,747 per year.
title: Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)
title_translated: 大规模校准决策：使用System One模型（Jev）将警察事故叙述转化为概率性事故变量
summary_translated: 包含调查员叙述的事故数据集包含了编码字段所遗漏的信息。然而，大规模编码这些叙述面临三大障碍：前沿大语言模型成本过高，生成文本无法验证，且无人规定人类需检查多少输出。本文将叙述编码建模为由Jev——一个System One模型——回答的门控类型决策任务，该模型返回分析师定义选项的概率，不生成任何文本。一个屏幕覆盖了499,500条德克萨斯州事故叙述，其中195,857条采用27个问题的编码方案完成编码。成本由编码方案大小决定，而非叙述长度。概率结果经由编码字段以及2,416个基于指定抽样设计盲评的人类判断进行审计。两个前沿大语言模型在同一记录上进行了基准对比。与人工标签相比，该类型模型达到F1值0.908。一个前沿模型提升0.059，另一个则无显著差异。校准性能因模型而异，而非因范式而异，因此每个模型都需单独审计。在相同标签上重新校准可使校准误差降低3.3倍。与编码字段的一致性在kappa值上中位数低估了对叙述的真实忠实度0.26。一个分辨率下界约束适用于报告离散网格概率的任何模型。对标记记录的审查预算给出了每变量每年需人工阅读的记录数量。将校准后的变量加入编码字段后，每年归因于九个因素的受伤和致命事故增加了10,747起。

summary: Generating coherent meta-reviews from multiple peer reviews is challenging when reviewer evidence conflicts and varies in reliability. Existing approaches typically formulate meta-review generation as a multi-document summarization task and aggregate reviewer feedback uniformly, making it difficult to determine which opinions should be prioritized under disagreement. In this paper, we study meta-review generation through reliability-aware evidence aggregation. Our framework first extracts aspect-level opinions from peer reviews and identifies conflicting evidence within each aspect. It then estimates opinion-level support and review-level quality to measure evidence reliability. Based on these signals, the framework assigns reliability-aware weights to reviewer feedback, enabling the generator to prioritize better-supported arguments while preserving diverse perspectives. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves meta-review generation over strong baselines on both automatic and human evaluations, with clear gains in conflict recognition and resolution under high-conflict review scenarios. The code and implementation details are publicly available at https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review.
title: When Evidence Conflicts: Reliability-aware Meta-review Generation
title_translated: 当证据冲突时：可靠性感知的元评审生成
summary_translated: 当评审者的证据存在冲突且可靠性不同时，从多份同行评审中生成连贯的元评审极具挑战性。现有方法通常将元评审生成视为多文档摘要任务，并对评审反馈进行均匀聚合，难以在意见分歧时确定应优先采纳哪些观点。本文通过可靠性感知的证据聚合研究元评审生成。我们的框架首先从同行评审中提取细粒度观点，并识别每个维度内的冲突证据。随后，估计观点层面的支持度和评审层面的质量，以衡量证据的可靠性。基于这些信号，框架为评审反馈分配可靠性感知权重，使生成器能够优先考虑支持度更高的论点，同时保留多元视角。实验表明，我们的方法在自动和人工评估中均显著优于强基线，在高冲突评审场景下尤其在冲突识别与解决方面表现突出。代码与实现细节已在https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review公开。

summary: LLMs can generate fluent descriptions from tables, but their outputs may remain logically unsupported by the structured data. We introduce STAT-TO-TEXT, a controlled task in which LLMs generate quantified natural language inferences from statistical tables using quantified constructions such as all, some, no, and most. To evaluate these inferences, we use an LLM generated Python checker code which when executed verifies the corresponding truth conditions against the table. We compare four open-weight LLMs across model families and scales, evaluating faithfulness, logical accuracy, table coverage, and diversity. Our results show that model scale and family matter, with the largest model (GPT-OSS-120B) consistently producing the most faithful inferences without sacrificing greater table coverage and quantifier diversity, as opposed to smaller models. These findings are supported by human annotation, which shows that the automated checker closely aligns with human judgments.
title: From Tables to Quantified Statements: Evaluating LLM Inference Generation through Executable Verification
title_translated: 从表格到量化陈述：通过可执行验证评估LLM推理生成
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以从表格中生成流畅的描述，但其输出可能并未在逻辑上得到结构化数据的支持。我们引入STAT-TO-TEXT，一项受控任务，要求LLMs使用all、some、no、most等量化构造，从统计表格中生成量化的自然语言推理。为评估这些推理，我们使用LLM生成的Python检查代码，执行后可验证其对应真值条件是否与表格一致。我们在四种开源权重LLM之间进行比较，评估忠实度、逻辑准确性、表格覆盖率和多样性。结果显示，模型规模和家族至关重要，最大模型（GPT-OSS-120B）始终生成最忠实的推理，且不牺牲更大的表格覆盖率和量化词多样性，而较小模型则表现较差。这一发现得到了人工标注的支持，表明自动化检查器与人工判断高度一致。

summary: Screening a phone call for fraud needs a trustworthy probability after every caller turn, in milliseconds. Jev-style typed decisions promise exactly that: declared options go in, one calibrated probability per option comes out of a single forward pass, with no generated text. We test an open implementation of this readout, JevLite, on scam-call screening: Qwen3-4B is LoRA-tuned so that the temperature-scaled softmax over two answer-label logits is P(scam). On 41 held-out CallScreenBench scenarios (577 per-turn decisions) a three-seed ensemble reaches AUROC .974 with calibration error .052, non-inferior to an LLM judge (MiniMax-M3) at a pre-registered .02 margin, with no false alarms on legitimate calls, decisions 1.14 turns earlier under the same hang-up rule, and 64.5 ms per decision on one consumer GPU, 4.9x lower than the same backbone fine-tuned to generate its answer. The gain is in the readout and calibration, not accuracy: a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder is not significantly worse, the recipe was selected with test-set exposure, and all callers are synthetic. We claim no architectural novelty; the contribution is the application and an evaluation reporting calibration, false alarms and decision timing alongside AUROC.
title: Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
title_translated: Open-Jev 对 CallScreenBench 的判断：使用小型语言模型实现校准的一次性诈骗电话筛查
summary_translated: 在电话通话中进行欺诈筛查需要在每个来电者发言后毫秒级地给出可信的概率。Jev 风格的类型化决策恰好满足这一需求：输入选项后，仅通过一次前向传播即可输出每个选项的校准概率，无需生成文本。我们在诈骗电话筛查任务中测试了这种输出机制的开源实现 JevLite：将 Qwen3-4B 模型通过 LoRA 微调，使其在两个答案标签 logits 上的温度缩放 softmax 输出 P(诈骗)。在 41 个保留的 CallScreenBench 场景（共 577 次每轮决策）上，三种子集成达到 AUROC 0.974，校准误差为 0.052，与预注册的 LLM 判官（MiniMax-M3）相比不劣于 0.02 的边际，且对合法来电无误报；在相同挂断规则下，决策提前 1.14 轮，并且每次决策仅需 64.5ms（单个消费级 GPU），比同一骨干模型微调为生成答案快 4.9 倍。性能提升来自输出机制和校准，而非准确性：微调后的 ModernBERT 编码器表现并不显著更差，该方案是基于测试集暴露选择的，且所有来电者均为合成数据。我们不主张架构上的创新；贡献在于应用方法以及报告校准度、误报率和决策时机等指标的评估。

summary: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.
title: Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs
title_translated: 某些方言比其他方言更平等：大型语言模型中的非主流阿拉伯方言偏见
summary_translated: 以往关于埃及阿拉伯语的研究主要集中在声望较高的开罗埃及阿拉伯语（CEA）方言，导致声望较低的萨伊迪埃及阿拉伯语（SEA）方言在大模型和资源开发中代表性不足。这种代表性缺失是否会影响大模型对 SEA 方言可接受性的判断（上游影响），以及上游对 SEA 的偏见是否会引发下游性能下降？我们通过目标句法评估（TSE）任务研究了 SEA 方言特征对大模型偏好的上游影响，发现多个大模型均存在显著的 SEA 偏见。随后，我们分析了这些特征对 MMLU 基准测试下游模型性能的影响，结果显示当模型遇到 SEA 语言时性能明显下降。本工作强调了进一步探索子方言差异如何影响语言技术的必要性。

summary: Expressive speech synthesis has advanced through prosody modeling, yet generating structured poetic speech, such as haiku, remains challenging. Prior work on prosody transfer improves expressiveness, and fine-tuned poetry TTS (text-to-speech) systems capture verse intonation. However, these models do not model haiku's 5-7-5 syllable structure or line-ending pauses. We present a cascaded system, HaikuS2S, combining ASR (automatic speech recognition), LLM (large language model)-generated haiku, and TTS fine-tuning on both prose and custom haiku datasets. Our evaluation focuses on emotion similarity, speech quality, and prosody alignment. In our experiments, we see that our prosody and tonal alignment improve significantly with our fine-tuned systems, particularly the one trained on both general poetry and haiku. We also see that we maintain similar emotion similarity scores across all systems.
title: HaikuS2S: A Cascaded System For Responding In Verse
comment: Accepted to SLT 2026, Demo Track. 5 pages, 5 figures
title_translated: HaikuS2S：一种用于诗歌回应的级联系统
summary_translated: 富有表现力的语音合成通过韵律建模取得了进展，但生成结构化的诗歌语音（如俳句）仍具挑战性。先前的韵律迁移工作提升了表达力，微调的诗歌文本转语音（TTS）系统捕捉了诗歌的语调特征。然而，这些模型未能建模俳句的 5-7-5 音节数结构或行尾停顿。我们提出一个级联系统 HaikuS2S，结合自动语音识别（ASR）、LLM 生成的俳句，以及在散文和自定义俳句数据集上微调的 TTS 系统。我们的评估聚焦于情感相似性、语音质量和韵律对齐。实验表明，经过微调的系统在韵律和音调对齐方面有显著提升，尤其是同时在通用诗歌和俳句数据上训练的系统。此外，所有系统间的情感相似性得分保持一致。

summary: Effective communication between users and AI agents is essential for human-AI collaboration. The XY problem is a well-known communication pitfall where a person asks about their attempted solution rather than their actual problem. We extend prior sycophancy evaluation to the XY problem in agentic settings, evaluating whether agents can resist plausible but misleading suggestions from users and communicate their reasoning. We introduce XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that can transform an existing benchmark into an XY problem evaluation. We evaluate five models across six diverse benchmark suites. Agents suffer large XY drops under XY mutation across benchmarks, with relative drops reaching up to 46.7%. With $τ^2$-bench, we further show that agent performance drops more when encountering a pedantic user who requires detailed explanations before approving a better solution. Our findings suggest that current agents lack the ability to effectively reason and communicate when facing misleading suggestions. A simple system instruction baseline that encourages awareness of XY problems only offers partial mitigation. Extensive trace analyses provide behavioral insights into how and why these XY drops occur across execution trajectories. Our results show that mitigating the XY problem remains challenging, requiring agents to both recognize user misdirection and clearly communicate the underlying problem.
title: XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures
title_translated: XYEval：智能体对糟糕建议说‘是’
summary_translated: 用户与 AI 智能体之间的有效沟通对于人机协作至关重要。XY 问题是一种常见的沟通陷阱，即人们询问自己尝试的解决方案，而非真实问题。我们将先前的谄媚行为评估扩展到智能体场景下的 XY 问题，评估智能体能否抵制用户提出的看似合理但具有误导性的建议，并清晰传达其推理过程。我们引入 XYEval，一种元评估框架，可将现有基准转化为 XY 问题评估。我们在六个不同基准套件上评估了五个模型。在各类基准中，智能体在 XY 变异下均出现显著性能下降，相对降幅高达 46.7%。通过 $τ^2$-bench 进一步发现，当遇到要求详细解释才能批准更优方案的刻板用户时，智能体性能下降更为严重。研究结果表明，当前智能体在面对误导性建议时缺乏有效的推理与沟通能力。一个简单的系统指令基线（鼓励识别 XY 问题）仅能部分缓解该问题。深入的轨迹分析揭示了 XY 下降发生的行为机制。结果表明，缓解 XY 问题依然极具挑战，要求智能体既能识别用户误导，又能清晰阐明根本问题。

summary: Post-training turns a general next-token predictor into a chat model with a persistent assistant persona. If that persona is a character the model plays only on its own turns, its preferences should govern what the assistant says, not what the model predicts other speakers will say. We test this boundary and find that it does not hold: a safety-relevant preference of the assistant---for harmless over harmful tasks---shapes the model's predictions even on the user's turn, where the assistant is not the one speaking. We find that this preference is small or near-zero in pretrained base models, that it emerges through post-training, replicated across open-weight model families, grows with scale, and can be moved by narrow finetuning that never touches user turns. We claim that this is evidence that post-training does not merely install a shallow assistant persona, but instead generalises beyond just the local assistant turn, into the model's representation of the user.
title: Measuring the Assistant's Harmlessness Preferences on the User Turn
title_translated: 衡量助手在用户回合中的无害偏好
summary_translated: 后训练将通用的下一个词预测器转变为具有持续助手人格的聊天模型。如果该人格只是模型在自身发言时扮演的角色，那么其偏好应仅决定助手说什么，而不应影响模型对其他说话者话语的预测。我们检验这一边界，发现它并不成立：助手的一个安全相关偏好——倾向于无害任务而非有害任务——即使在用户发言回合（助手并未说话）也影响了模型的预测。我们发现，这种偏好在预训练基础模型中很小或接近零，通过后训练才出现，跨多个开源权重模型家族重复出现，随模型规模增长，并可通过仅不接触用户回合的窄范围微调改变。我们认为，这表明后训练并非仅仅植入一个浅层的助手人格，而是使模型在表征层面泛化到了对用户的理解之中。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) drift out of date the moment their pretraining ends, yet retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive. Continued pretraining (CPT) is the natural remedy, but it is typically evaluated through a continual learning lens that assumes disjoint data streams. This is a poor fit for time-incremental updates on web-scale crawls, where successive snapshots share substantial URL overlap by design. We study time-incremental CPT in this realistic regime: continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn strictly from after each model's knowledge cutoff, evaluated across six open-weight models spanning three families (OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, Gemma-3-1B) and four parameter scales (1B-3B-7B-8B).   We organize our findings around four practical questions. (i) Is knowledge acquired? Yes, but heterogeneously, and without catastrophic forgetting: five of six models also improve on pre-cutoff factual recall, and the gains track pretraining saturation (driven primarily by token budget per parameter). (ii) What does it cost? Almost nothing: the macro-average across a thirteen-task suite stays within 0.01 of the base for every model. (iii) What is the recipe? Data quality dominates quantity (a curated 6B-token slice matches a broader 40B one); the optima for knowledge acquisition and general capability are separated by roughly an order of magnitude in learning rate; and LoRA at sufficient rank matches full CPT. (iv) Does it survive deployment? CPT gains transfer through SFT, while DPO's effect is family-dependent. Together, these results paint a more optimistic picture of time-incremental CPT than the prior continual learning literature suggests.
title: Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting
comment: Preprint
title_translated: 时间增量持续预训练：在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下实现知识更新
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在其预训练结束后立即开始过时，而从头重新训练则成本过高。持续预训练（CPT）是自然的解决方案，但通常以连续学习视角评估，假设数据流互不重叠。这与基于网络规模爬取的时间增量更新场景不符，因为后续快照在设计上具有大量URL重叠。我们在此现实场景中研究了时间增量CPT：在FineWeb-Edu数据集上进行持续预训练，这些数据严格来自每个模型知识截止时间之后，评估涵盖六个开源模型，覆盖三个模型家族（OLMo2、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-3-1B）和四种参数规模（1B-3B-7B-8B）。我们围绕四个实际问题展开研究：(i) 是否获取了知识？是的，但存在异质性，且未出现灾难性遗忘：六种模型中有五种在截止前的事实回忆能力也得到提升，增益与预训练饱和度相关（主要由每参数的token预算驱动）。(ii) 成本如何？几乎为零：在十三项任务套件上的平均表现与基础模型相差不超过0.01。(iii) 最佳实践是什么？数据质量优于数量（经过筛选的60亿token片段可媲美更广泛的400亿token）；知识获取与通用能力的最优学习率相差约一个数量级；足够秩的LoRA可达到全量CPT的效果。(iv) 是否能适应部署？CPT收益可传递至SFT，而DPO的影响因模型家族而异。综合来看，这些结果比以往连续学习文献所暗示的更为乐观。

summary: Software delegates more of its branches to models every year: which queue a ticket enters, whether a command is safe to run, whether a claim clears without a person. What the program needs back is not prose. It is one of n declared options and a number it can threshold. Today that costs a round trip to a frontier model -- hundreds of milliseconds, a per-token bill, and a parser -- for a question that is usually a conjunction of three clauses. this-that-model-1.0 is a 2B-parameter typed decision model. Its answer is read directly from the hidden state at a designated position and restricted to the option set the caller declared, so no text is generated, nothing can be malformed, and every question in a request is answered in the same forward pass. It decides in 30.9 ms on one laptop GPU and generates zero output tokens doing it, where a frontier API call costs 8758 ms and the hosted systems that answer these questions well spend between 21 and 212 generated tokens per question thinking first, billed for every one. It sustains 32 decisions per second on one consumer GPU and never lets the state leave the machine. On a third party's recorded cohort of 68 decision questions, on their inputs and their wording, it scores 0.941 with a Brier score of 0.042, against 0.765 and 0.133 for the hosted service Jev on the same items. One pass of our 42-family internal suite takes 32 seconds and 0.000217 USD of electricity; the most accurate hosted model we measured needs 155.2 minutes and 10.636 USD. We also report where it loses. On multi-step arithmetic, which a single forward pass cannot carry intermediate results through, it scores 0.560 against their 0.98 to 1.00, and a targeted second training round improved the five task families it was written for and transferred to none of the other 13. The model is open-sourced in https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0
title: this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
title_translated: this-that-model-1.0：一种可在30毫秒内决策、成本仅为百万分之一美分的类型化决策模型
summary_translated: 软件每年将越来越多的分支逻辑委托给模型：决定工单进入哪个队列、命令是否安全执行、索赔是否无需人工即可通过。程序需要的不是散文式回答，而是从n个已声明选项中选择一个，并附带一个可阈值化的数值。如今，这需要一次前沿模型调用——数百毫秒、按token计费、还需解析器——而这个问题通常由三个子句构成。this-that-model-1.0是一个20亿参数的类型化决策模型。其答案直接从指定位置的隐藏状态读取，并被限制在调用方声明的选项集中，因此不会生成文本，不会出现格式错误，且请求中的每个问题都能在同一前向传播中完成回答。该模型在一台笔记本GPU上决策耗时30.9毫秒，生成零输出token；而前沿API调用需8758毫秒，托管系统为回答这些问题需先生成21至212个token，每个token均被计费。它在单个消费级GPU上维持每秒32次决策，且始终确保状态不离开本地机器。在第三方记录的68个决策问题数据集上，使用其输入和表述，该模型得分0.941，Brier得分为0.042，而托管服务Jev在同一项目上得分为0.765和0.133。我们内部42个家族的测试套件仅需32秒和0.000217美元电力消耗；我们测量到最准确的托管模型需155.2分钟和10.636美元。我们也报告了其失败之处：在多步算术任务中，由于单次前向传播无法传递中间结果，其得分为0.560，而对手得分为0.98至1.00；经过针对性的第二轮训练，该模型在所设计的五个任务族上表现提升，但未能迁移到其余13个任务族。该模型已在https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0 开源。

summary: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE.
title: Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: this https URL
title_translated: Q-TIE：一种轻量且可泛化的时序信息检索重排序框架
summary_translated: 随着检索增强生成（RAG）的发展，时序信息检索（TIR）变得日益重要。由于时间不匹配的证据可能极具误导性，TIR旨在检索在语义和时间上均与查询相关的文档。目前出现了两种TIR范式——时序检索器和时序重排序器——它们在如何建模时间相关性方面有所不同。尽管这两种范式各有优势，但我们的分析表明，单独使用任一范式都无法实现稳健的TIR：时序检索器通过学习表示提供灵活的查询理解，但往往未能显式考虑时间约束；时序重排序器能更明确地施加此类约束，但通常依赖于预定义的重排序规则。为此，我们提出Q-TIE，一种基于学习的时序意图提取（TIE）的重排序框架。通过引入一个TIE模型，将每个查询的时间约束映射为统一的区间表示（即⟨t_start, t_end⟩），Q-TIE通过基于模型的学习超越了预定义规则的局限，同时将时间约束作为独立信号显式建模——从而在传统范式常需权衡的两个方面实现了联合优化。实验表明，Q-TIE在多种时序查询类型下持续优于现有TIR方法，展现出更强的泛化能力，并为时序感知的RAG流水线提供了一种轻量但高效的附加组件。代码见：https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE。

summary: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.
title: From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures
title_translated: 从UNDRR报告到事件记录：基于模式约束的LLM地理灾害信息抽取
summary_translated: 灾害减灾档案以叙述性文字描述灾害事件，而EM-DAT等数据库无法直接处理此类文本。我们提出一个LLM流水线，利用受控灾害词汇表和固定模式生成候选地理标记事件记录，并保留证据以供审查。该方法应用于联合国减灾署（UNDRR）管理的PreventionWeb平台的10,000份文档，从中生成了3,572条记录，覆盖1,913份文档和24种灾害类型，并将81%的位置提及成功映射至OpenStreetMap几何数据。在从217份文档中分层抽样的171个包含人类标注的文档窗口上，GPT-5的合并属性F1得分为86.0%，远高于spaCy-gazetteer基线的44.2%。评估涵盖文档内的灾害类别、位置字符串和事件年份，但不评估其对具体事件的分配准确性。在十种LLM中，GPT-5.4排名最高，F1得分为86.6%。GPT-5的原文证据出现率为72.0%，GPT-5.4为47.2%，用于衡量文本可追溯性但未验证属性支持。我们报告了生产中的失败模式以及自动化标签和位置规则合规性检查。提示词、模式和输出将公开发布，以便适配国家报告档案。

summary: We present a comprehensive benchmark of Federated Learning (FL) for multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), evaluating four Speech-LLM architectures on the Multilingual LibriSpeech dataset. We compare FedAvg and FedProx across frozen and unfrozen encoder configurations, demonstrating that optimized learning rates are critical for performance. Specifically, independently tuning the learning rates for the speech encoder, connector, and decoder yields the lowest error rates, with full three-component adaptation (LoRA for encoder and decoder, full training for the connector) producing the best FL results. We observe that FedProx efficacy is architecture-dependent, providing notable advantages in multilingual pre-trained architectures (e.g., EuroLLM over TinyLlama when keeping the encoder fixed); this indicates that LLM backbone capacity plays a key role in mediating resilience to heterogeneous data distributions. These findings offer concrete design guidance for deploying multilingual Speech-LLMs in privacy-sensitive, distributed environments.
title: Federated Multilingual Speech-LLMs: Architecture and Aggregation Strategy Benchmarking
comment: Accepted Iberspeech 2026
title_translated: 联邦多语言语音-LLM：架构与聚合策略基准测试
summary_translated: 我们对多语言自动语音识别（ASR）中的联邦学习（FL）进行了全面基准测试，评估了四种语音-LLM架构在多语言LibriSpeech数据集上的表现。我们在冻结与非冻结编码器配置下比较了FedAvg与FedProx算法，表明优化的学习率对性能至关重要。具体而言，分别对语音编码器、连接模块和解码器独立调整学习率可获得最低误差率，其中完整的三组件自适应（编码器和解码器使用LoRA，连接模块全量训练）产生了最佳的FL效果。我们观察到，FedProx的有效性依赖于架构，在多语言预训练架构中表现显著（例如，当保持编码器固定时，EuroLLM相比TinyLlama有明显优势）；这表明LLM骨干网络的容量在缓解异构数据分布带来的影响中起关键作用。这些发现为在隐私敏感、分布式环境中部署多语言语音-LLM提供了具体的架构设计指导。

summary: While test-time scaling enhances Large Language Model (LLM) agents in long-horizon software engineering (SWE), sparse binary rewards (Pass/Fail) create a severe credit assignment crisis and waste failed exploratory trajectories. Current trajectory optimization and scaling methods are costly and structurally limited, relying on heuristic state reuse without causal diagnosis or delayed scalar scoring without actionable online guidance. We propose FLARE (Full-Lifecycle Alignment and Reward Engine), a novel dense supervision paradigm driven by a lightweight Generative Reward Model (GRM). First, RADAR, an offline causal-aware diagnostic framework, extracts high-fidelity, hindsight-free supervision through causal-chain backtracking to distill a GRM providing real-time, step-level risk feedback. Second, FLARE uses this GRM to continuously optimize the agent across its entire lifecycle. During inference, FLARE acts as an Active Scaffold, autonomously intercepting high-risk generation steps for localized breakpoint re-execution, drastically reducing compute overhead. During post-training, the GRM's structured signals serve as process-supervised reranking scores for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and step-level dense rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL), mitigating policy collapse in sparse environments. Extensive evaluations show that FLARE establishes a new Pareto frontier across the agent lifecycle: FLARE (N=1) outperforms Global Rollout (N=5) with a 5x reduction in token consumption. Extending FLARE to training overcomes the sparse reward problem in long-horizon interactive tasks, delivering relative performance gains of 19.13% in SFT through process-aware data curation and a consistent 9.19% improvement in RL.
title: FLARE: A Full-Lifecycle Dense Supervision Paradigm for Long-Horizon Coding Agents via Generative Reward Model
title_translated: FLARE：通过生成式奖励模型实现长周期编码智能体全生命周期密集监督范式
summary_translated: 尽管测试时扩展提升了大型语言模型（LLM）在长周期软件工程任务中的表现，但稀疏的二元奖励（通过/失败）导致严重的信用分配危机，并浪费了失败的探索轨迹。当前的轨迹优化与扩展方法成本高昂且结构受限，依赖启发式状态重用而缺乏因果诊断，或延迟的标量评分而无即时可操作的在线指导。我们提出FLARE（全生命周期对齐与奖励引擎），一种由轻量级生成式奖励模型（GRM）驱动的新颖密集监督范式。首先，RADAR——一个离线因果感知诊断框架——通过因果链回溯提取高保真、无事后偏差的监督信号，以提炼出提供实时、步骤级风险反馈的GRM。其次，FLARE利用该GRM持续优化智能体在整个生命周期中的表现。推理阶段，FLARE作为主动支架，自主拦截高风险生成步骤并进行局部断点重执行，显著降低计算开销。训练后阶段，GRM的结构化信号作为过程监督下的重排序分数用于监督微调（SFT），以及强化学习（RL）中的步骤级密集奖励，缓解稀疏环境下的策略崩溃问题。大量评估表明，FLARE在智能体生命周期内建立了新的帕累托前沿：FLARE（N=1）在token消耗减少5倍的情况下优于全局展开（N=5）。将FLARE扩展至训练阶段克服了长周期交互任务中的稀疏奖励问题，在SFT中通过过程感知数据整理实现了19.13%的相对性能提升，在RL中则保持稳定的9.19%改进。

summary: Small open-source large language models (LLMs) in the 0.6B-4B parameter range are increasingly deployed for structured output generation (JSON, function calling, data extraction), yet little is known about how constrained decoding (CD) interacts with model scale in this regime. We benchmark five models from three families across 14 structured-output tasks under three decoding conditions (native, Outlines, XGrammar). We introduce a two-axis evaluation that separates structural correctness (schema validity) from semantic correctness (content accuracy). We find that CD eliminates all structural failures across all models (schema validity: 78.6-92.9% to 100%), but content accuracy reveals a persistent semantic gap that is scale-dependent: type coercion failures are fully CD-rescuable, while instruction-semantic failures (e.g., multi-step function calling) remain CD-resistant. Schema conformance is necessary but not sufficient for semantic correctness; CD's reach ends exactly where schema conformance ends.
title: Constrained Decoding Eliminates Structural Failures in Small LLMs but Reveals a Scale-Dependent Semantic Gap
comment: 6 pages, ACL format Code and task suite: this https URL (tag v1.0)
title_translated: 约束解码消除小型LLM的结构性失败，但揭示了依赖规模的语义鸿沟
summary_translated: 参数量在0.6B至4B范围内的小型开源大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于结构化输出生成（如JSON、函数调用、数据提取），但关于约束解码（CD）在此规模区间内如何与模型规模相互作用的研究仍不充分。我们在14个结构化输出任务上对来自三个家族的五个模型进行了基准测试，涵盖三种解码条件（原生、Outlines、XGrammar）。我们引入了一个双轴评估体系，将结构正确性（模式有效性）与语义正确性（内容准确性）分开。研究发现，约束解码消除了所有模型的所有结构性失败（模式有效性从78.6%-92.9%提升至100%），但内容准确性揭示了一个持续存在的、依赖规模的语义鸿沟：类型强制失败可被CD完全修复，而指令-语义失败（如多步函数调用）仍对CD具有抵抗力。模式符合是语义正确的必要条件，但并非充分条件；CD的作用范围恰好止于模式符合的边界。

summary: Large language models have shown strong performance across a range of legal tasks, but existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the ability to take and defend a legal position, reason under incomplete information, or synthesize multiple statutory provisions. This gap is particularly pronounced for Canadian law, which remains underrepresented in legal NLP. We introduce GRACE (Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples), a dataset of 1,915 question-reasoning-answer instances grounded in Canadian federal legislation. GRACE covers three reasoning modes: adversarial advocacy, uncertainty, and applied reasoning. We develop a pipeline that partitions raw statutory text, generates scenario-based questions and reasoning, and filters examples through model-free citation verification and LLM-based quality auditing. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune CLeAR-4B (Canadian Legal Adversarial Reasoning), a lightweight model for grounded legal reasoning, and evaluate it against the unmodified Qwen3-4B base model in open- and closed-book settings. CLeAR-4B substantially improves agreement with teacher outputs and statutory citation behavior when the relevant act text is provided, while its grounding degrades sharply when the statute is withheld. These results suggest that GRACE can support the development of lightweight legal models that reason more effectively from supplied statutory text.
title: GRACE: Grounded Adversarial Reasoning over Canadian Law
title_translated: GRACE：基于加拿大法律的接地对抗性推理
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在各类法律任务中表现出色，但现有基准很少评估其采取和辩护法律立场、在信息不完整条件下推理或综合多个法规条文的能力。这一差距在加拿大法律领域尤为突出，其在法律自然语言处理中仍处于代表性不足状态。我们提出了GRACE（基于加拿大联邦立法的接地推理对抗性法律示例），一个包含1,915个问题-推理-答案实例的数据集，所有内容均基于加拿大联邦立法。GRACE覆盖三种推理模式：对抗性辩护、不确定性推理和应用性推理。我们开发了一套流程，将原始法规文本分块，生成基于场景的问题与推理，并通过无模型引用验证和基于LLM的质量审计筛选示例。作为概念验证，我们微调了CLeAR-4B（加拿大法律对抗性推理轻量模型），并在开放书和闭卷设置下将其与未修改的Qwen3-4B基线模型进行对比。结果显示，当提供相关法案文本时，CLeAR-4B在与教师输出的一致性及法定引用行为方面有显著提升，但若省略法案文本，其接地能力急剧下降。这些结果表明，GRACE能够支持轻量级法律模型的发展，使其能更有效地基于提供的法规文本进行推理。

summary: Textual-gradient methods automate prompt optimization through natural-language feedback, but their iterative updates can be unstable. We identify two sources of this instability: noisy gradients produced from already-correct examples and over-specialization to hard cases that degrades performance on simpler inputs. We introduce STEVE, a stabilization framework with two coupled mechanisms. Error-Driven Refinement generates gradients only from incorrectly handled examples, concentrating updates on informative failures. Regularized Verification treats every update as provisional and accepts it only when improvement on hard cases does not cause unacceptable regression on a preservation set. Across ten reasoning benchmarks, three evaluator/optimizer models, and established prompt-optimization baselines, STEVE reduces degradation and produces more robust prompts. Additional evaluations with gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4 on symbolic reasoning, GSM8K-Platinum, and DS-1000 show that these gains persist with newer models and larger test sets. STEVE therefore provides a practical way to improve the stability and effectiveness of textual-gradient prompt optimization.
title: STEVE: Stabilizing Textual Gradient-Based Prompt Optimization via Error-Driven Refinement and Regularized Verification
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: AACL-IJCNLP 2026
title_translated: STEVE：通过错误驱动精炼与正则化验证稳定基于文本梯度的提示优化
summary_translated: 基于文本梯度的方法通过自然语言反馈实现提示自动优化，但其迭代更新可能不稳定。我们识别出两个不稳定性来源：来自已正确处理样本的噪声梯度，以及对困难案例过度专门化而导致简单输入性能下降。我们提出STEVE，一种包含两个耦合机制的稳定化框架。错误驱动精炼仅从处理错误的样本生成梯度，将更新集中在有信息量的失败上。正则化验证将每次更新视为临时状态，只有当困难案例的改进不会导致保留集上的不可接受退化时才予以接受。在十个推理基准、三种评估器/优化器模型以及既定提示优化基线上，STEVE减少了性能退化并生成了更鲁棒的提示。额外评估使用gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4在符号推理、GSM8K-Platinum和DS-1000上的结果表明，这些优势在新模型和更大测试集下依然存在。因此，STEVE为提升基于文本梯度提示优化的稳定性与有效性提供了实用方案。

summary: Financial language models can transform unstructured firm-specific news into structured decision signals, but financial AI research lacks an integrated deployment framework for evaluating whether those signals remain useful in financial decision systems. Computer science research has developed strong methods for time-series forecasting, text classification, multimodal stock prediction, graph-based market modeling, and machine-learning operations, yet these streams do not provide a domain-specific protocol that jointly tests financial language-model outputs under event-time observability, probability calibration, execution timing, transaction costs, liquidity constraints, capacity limits, operational diagnostics, and statistical inference. We introduce MFAST, a Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading framework that converts timestamped financial text into auditable, reproducible, and market-feasible trading decisions. The application is news-based trading, where firm-specific text must be linked to securities before portfolio decisions can be evaluated. The framework links Refinitiv News Analytics to Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) equity data, restricts the primary out-of-sample evaluation to post-release news outside disclosed foundation-model data-freshness periods, and adds a public replication arm using open financial text and public price data. Results show that decoder-only language models outperform encoder baselines and dictionary sentiment in classification, calibration, return prediction, and net portfolio performance, while operational diagnostics reveal trade-offs among accuracy, latency, memory, throughput, and inference cost. The paper shows that credible evaluation of financial language models requires an end-to-end engineering approach combining language understanding, temporal discipline, market-friction-aware deployment, and reproducible validation.
title: Financial Language Models as Applied Artificial Intelligence Systems for News-Based Trading under Market Frictions

title_translated: 金融语言模型作为应用于新闻驱动交易的带市场摩擦的人工智能系统
summary_translated: 金融语言模型可将非结构化的公司特定新闻转化为结构化的决策信号，但金融AI研究缺乏一个集成部署框架来评估这些信号在金融决策系统中是否仍具实用性。计算机科学领域已发展出强大的时间序列预测、文本分类、多模态股票预测、基于图的市场建模及机器学习运维方法，但这些方向并未提供一个领域特定协议，联合测试金融语言模型输出在事件时间可观测性、概率校准、执行时机、交易成本、流动性约束、容量限制、操作诊断和统计推断等方面的性能。我们提出MFAST（市场摩擦感知的情感到交易框架），将带时间戳的金融文本转化为可审计、可复现且符合市场实际的交易决策。应用场景为新闻驱动交易，其中公司特定文本必须与证券关联后才能评估投资组合决策。该框架将Refinitiv新闻分析与CRSP股票数据连接，将主要外部样本评估限制在披露基础模型数据新鲜度周期之外的新闻，并增加一个公开复现分支，使用开放金融文本和公开价格数据。结果表明，仅解码器的语言模型在分类、校准、收益预测和净投资组合表现方面优于编码器基线和词典情感分析，而操作诊断揭示了准确率、延迟、内存、吞吐量和推理成本之间的权衡。本文表明，可信的金融语言模型评估需要一个端到端工程方法，融合语言理解、时间纪律、市场摩擦感知部署和可复现验证。

summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD uses each specialist's RL-induced displacement from a shared pre-RL reference as a proxy for local reliability, calibrates these scores across teachers, and constructs a weighted distillation target. Across mathematics, code, and instruction following, TrustMOPD outperforms the strongest label-free baseline, increasing the recovery ratio from $54.4\%$ to $91.5\%$ on \textsc{SingleCap} and from $54.5\%$ to $98.0\%$ on \textsc{MultiCap}, while approaching label-based MOPD on \textsc{SingleCap}. Randomizing token-level weights independently of the student-generated prefix performs no better than uniform weighting, supporting the importance of conditioning supervision on the evolving generation context.
title: Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

title_translated: 信任你所信赖的内容：可靠性感知的多教师在线蒸馏
summary_translated: 多教师在线蒸馏允许学生从自身轨迹中的互补专家中学习。然而，领域路由方法对每个示例仅选择一个教师并保持固定，这种设计既依赖于混合训练语料库中常缺乏的标签，也无法在轨迹内部所需专长发生变化时动态调整教师选择。我们提出	extbf{TrustMOPD}，将示例级别的教师选择替换为无标签的、基于token级别的监督分配。在每个学生生成的前缀处，TrustMOPD利用各专家相对于共享预强化学习参考点的强化学习诱导偏移作为局部可靠性的代理，校准各教师的得分，并构建加权蒸馏目标。在数学、代码和指令遵循任务中，TrustMOPD优于最强的无标签基线，在	extsc{SingleCap}上将恢复率从54.4%提升至91.5%，在	extsc{MultiCap}上从54.5%提升至98.0%，并在	extsc{SingleCap}上接近基于标签的MOPD表现。当token级别权重独立于学生生成的前缀进行随机化时，性能不优于均匀加权，支持了将监督条件依赖于动态生成上下文的重要性。

summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) incur high inference costs, often mitigated by efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning. However, the impact of these techniques on model adversarial robustness remains largely unexplored. This study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the interplay between efficiency, jailbreak vulnerability, and reasoning in LRMs. We find that while efficiency methods seemingly reduce the success rate of jailbreak attacks, this improvement is often superficial. It largely arises from degraded reasoning capabilities leading to "attempted but failed" malicious responses, rather than an increase in genuine alignment. Mechanistic analysis of representational drift confirms this, revealing a strict coupling between reasoning capability loss and the model's inability to maintain malicious semantic trajectories. Additionally, we identify quantization with pruning as the optimal strategy to balance efficiency and robustness. These findings clarify the distinction between true safety alignment and capability-induced failure, providing an empirical foundation for LRM deployment.
title: On the Efficiency-Safety Dilemma in Large Reasoning Models

title_translated: 大型推理模型中的效率-安全困境
summary_translated: 大型推理模型（LRMs）推理成本高昂，通常通过量化和剪枝等效率技术缓解。然而，这些技术对模型对抗鲁棒性的影响仍 largely 未被探索。本研究首次全面分析了效率、越狱漏洞与推理能力之间的相互作用。我们发现，尽管效率方法看似降低了越狱攻击的成功率，但这种改善往往是表面现象，主要源于推理能力下降导致的“尝试但失败”的恶意响应，而非真正的对齐增强。机制性分析揭示了推理能力损失与模型无法维持恶意语义轨迹之间的严格耦合。此外，我们识别出量化结合剪枝是平衡效率与鲁棒性的最优策略。这些发现澄清了真实安全对齐与能力退化导致的失败之间的区别，为LRM部署提供了实证基础。

summary: Maintenance work orders must often be processed offline on embedded hardware, yet downstream software requires predictable structured output. We present ARID (Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment), which extracts component, failure mode, symptom, and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. ARID combines conservative dual-teacher filtering, targeted noise-aware synthesis, one routing decision per work order, 4-bit inference, and grammar-constrained decoding. From 2,326 unlabeled OMIn records, it retains 716 training pairs and adds 99 topology-constrained records targeting action extraction. On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. On zero-shot MaintNet transfer, semantic F1 falls to 46.4% while parser success remains at least 99.8%, showing that output validity transfers but field semantics do not.
title: ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE IECON 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
title_translated: ARID：面向工业维护工单结构化信息提取的可部署边缘AI系统
summary_translated: 维护工单通常需在嵌入式硬件上离线处理，但下游软件要求可预测的结构化输出。我们提出ARID（航空启发的工业部署路由），可在8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上将组件、故障模式、症状和维护操作提取为固定模式的JSON格式。ARID结合了保守的双教师过滤、针对性的噪声感知合成、每份工单一次路由决策、4比特推理以及语法约束解码。从2,326条未标注的OMIn记录中，保留716个训练对，并新增99条拓扑约束记录以聚焦于动作提取。在300条人工标注记录上，ARID在参考栈上的token-F1达到84.8%，在部署的Jetson上达到82.9%。驻留服务实现P50/P99延迟分别为5,310/5,656毫秒，功耗为12.5 W。在零样本MaintNet迁移中，语义F1降至46.4%，而解析成功率保持在99.8%以上，表明输出有效性可迁移，但字段语义不可迁移。

summary: Synthetic essays can help reduce dependence on human-written data in Automated Essay Scoring (AES). However, they often lack realistic errors, limiting their ability to represent authentic human writing, particularly when the target texts are intended to resemble those produced by language learners. In this study, we present a simple approach that introduces error supervision into synthetic essay generation. Specifically, we fine-tune an LLM generator on error-annotated texts of the kind commonly used in Grammatical Error Detection (GED). To assess the utility of the proposed approach, we fine-tune and evaluate AES scorers under three data conditions: authentic essays, synthetic essays generated conventionally, and synthetic essays generated using our proposed approach. The results show that in the larger-data settings, the proposed approach outperforms the conventional synthetic baseline in 11 out of 12 dataset-metric comparisons, with performance in some cases approaching that of models trained on authentic essays. Despite these gains, performance under extremely low-resource settings remains mixed, with advantages over the conventional baseline only becoming more apparent at 200 training essays, although not consistently across datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses further show that the proposed approach produces learner-like errors whose distributions broadly resemble those observed in authentic essays.
title: Error-Supervised Synthetic Learner Writing for Automated Essay Scoring

title_translated: 错误监督的合成学习者写作用于自动作文评分
summary_translated: 合成作文有助于减少自动作文评分（AES）对人工写作数据的依赖。然而，它们通常缺乏真实的错误，限制了其在模拟语言学习者真实写作方面的表现，尤其是在目标文本旨在模仿学习者产出时。本研究提出一种简单方法，将错误监督引入合成作文生成过程。具体而言，我们在常用语法错误检测（GED）数据集的错误标注文本上微调LLM生成器。为评估该方法的有效性，我们在三种数据条件下微调并评估AES评分器：真实作文、传统方式生成的合成作文，以及使用我们提出方法生成的合成作文。结果表明，在大数据设置下，该方法在12个数据集-指标组合中的11个上优于传统合成基线，某些情况下性能接近基于真实作文训练的模型。尽管取得进展，但在极低资源环境下表现仍参差不齐，优势仅在200篇训练作文时才逐渐显现，且并非所有数据集都一致。定性和定量分析进一步显示，该方法生成的学习者级错误分布总体上与真实作文中的错误分布相似。

summary: Standard positional encodings represent position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure. We use a hierarchical rotary positional encoding (hRoPE) that represents paragraph, sentence, and token indices as separate channels, hold the token sequence fixed, intervene on the paragraph coordinate p1, and measure cross-paragraph attention with a token-distance-exact estimator. Attention is compressed relative to a token-distance-matched baseline in every corpus, but compression alone is not diagnostic of true structure: an architecturally identical channel with density-matched random labels is compressed too, more shallowly. What distinguishes real structure is the depth of compression, which is greater and corpus-dependent while the control's is not. Comparing eight corpus-only quantities across three constructs (lexical persistence, paragraph length, embedding-based coherence), none fully reproduces the cross-corpus ordering of depth, though embedding-based coherence comes closest. Compression depth, not its location, is the reproducible signature of genuine paragraph structure in our setting.
title: Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure
title_translated: 段落边界并非空白：压缩深度是层次结构的标志
summary_translated: 标准的位置编码将位置表示为一维阅读顺序坐标，但仅靠阅读顺序无法决定文本的层次结构。我们采用一种层次化旋转位置编码（hRoPE），将段落、句子和词元索引分别作为独立通道表示，固定词元序列，干预段落坐标p1，并使用词元距离精确估计器测量跨段注意力。在所有语料库中，注意力均相对于词元距离匹配的基线出现压缩，但压缩本身不足以诊断真实结构：一个架构相同但标签密度匹配随机的通道也出现压缩，但程度更浅。真正区分真实结构的是压缩深度，其更深且具有语料库依赖性，而对照组则不具备。在三个构念（词汇持续性、段落长度、基于嵌入的一致性）的八种仅语料库量度中，没有一种能完全复现压缩深度的跨语料库排序，尽管基于嵌入的一致性最接近。在我们的设定中，压缩深度而非其位置，是真实段落结构的可重复标志。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows through tool use and interaction with users and environments. However, current agent evaluations are largely English-centric, limiting our understanding of agent capabilities in multilingual settings. We introduce BabelFlow, a benchmark-general agentic workflow that adapts existing agent benchmarks to new languages by analyzing runtime dependencies, coordinating structure-preserving translation, and combining multi-layer verification with human review to preserve task and evaluation semantics. Using BabelFlow, we construct BabelArena, a task-aligned benchmark comprising 16,146 instances derived from 702 canonical tasks across four benchmark families, 13 domains, and 23 languages. Experiments with five frontier models show that no single model dominates across benchmark families and that cross-language disparities extend well beyond task success. Lower-resource languages exhibit distinct failure patterns, with larger shares of tool-use and control-flow errors rather than answer-quality errors alone, pointing to gaps in reliable task execution across the resource levels of these languages. On the same tasks, agents in low-resource languages also consume substantially more tokens than in English (up to roughly twice the input) without proportional increases in interaction length, and language consistency degrades further on tasks requiring structured output, where switches are directed overwhelmingly toward English. We believe BabelArena provides a foundation for advancing research on reliable and efficient multilingual agents.
title: BabelArena: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for LLM Agents
comment: 20 pages, 11 tables, and 7 figures
title_translated: BabelArena：面向大语言模型智能体的大规模多语言基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过工具使用和与用户及环境的交互，越来越多地执行多步骤工作流。然而，当前的智能体评估主要以英语为中心，限制了我们对多语言环境下智能体能力的理解。我们提出了BabelFlow，一种基准通用的智能体工作流方法，通过分析运行时依赖关系、协调结构保持的翻译，并结合多层验证与人工审查，以保留任务和评估语义。利用BabelFlow，我们构建了BabelArena，这是一个任务对齐的基准，包含从702个标准任务中衍生出的16,146个实例，覆盖四个基准家族、13个领域和23种语言。对五种前沿模型的实验表明，没有单一模型在所有基准家族中占据主导地位，跨语言差异远超任务成功率。低资源语言表现出独特的失败模式，工具使用和控制流错误占比更高，而非仅答案质量错误，揭示了这些语言在不同资源水平下可靠任务执行的差距。在同一任务上，低资源语言中的智能体消耗的token数量显著高于英语（最多约为输入的两倍），但交互长度并未成比例增加，且在需要结构化输出的任务中，语言一致性进一步下降，切换几乎完全指向英语。我们认为BabelArena为推进可靠高效的多语言智能体研究提供了基础。

summary: Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. Parametric memory encodes experience directly into model computation, but existing approaches provide limited support for cross-session memory evolution. Their coupling to a specific backbone further restricts memory reuse after model replacement. We introduce RPMem, a two-stage architecture that compiles each session into a model-independent latent memory through forward computation and selectively integrates it with retained memory via a task-trained recurrent gate. The consolidated memory is then mapped to backbone-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters, allowing the encoding capability to transfer when the backbone is replaced. Evaluation across three long-term memory benchmarks and five diverse backbones demonstrates broad generalization with near-constant update cost and memory footprint. With Qwen3-8B on PERMA, RPMem reaches 85.52%, outperforming the strongest parametric and text-based baselines by 5.32 and 12.98 percentage points, respectively. Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main.
title: RPMem: Learning Long-Term Recurrent Parametric Memory Across Sessions for LLM Agents
comment: 38 pages, 7 figures. Code: this https URL
title_translated: RPMem：跨会话学习长期循环参数化记忆的大语言模型智能体
summary_translated: 长时间运行的LLM智能体需要在会话间持续并演进的记忆。基于文本的记忆在每次查询时检索并重构过往交互，随着历史增长，长周期性能越来越依赖于检索质量和上下文推理。参数化记忆将经验直接编码到模型计算中，但现有方法对跨会话记忆演化支持有限。其与特定主干模型的耦合也限制了模型替换后的记忆重用。我们提出RPMem，一种两阶段架构：通过前向计算将每个会话编译为与模型无关的潜在记忆，并通过任务训练的循环门选择性地与保留记忆整合。整合后的记忆随后映射到主干特定的低秩适配（LoRA）参数，实现主干更换时编码能力的迁移。在三个长期记忆基准和五个不同主干上的评估显示，该方法具有广泛泛化能力，更新成本和内存占用近乎恒定。在PERMA基准上使用Qwen3-8B，RPMem达到85.52%，优于最强的参数化和文本基基线分别5.32和12.98个百分点。消融实验验证了会话编译与跨会话整合的互补作用，动态分析揭示门控机制获得了任务特定的记忆整合策略。这些结果确立了RPMem作为生命周期无关的参数化记忆框架，能够维持可重用的跨会话演化记忆。代码已开源：https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main。

summary: Long-horizon conversational memory is especially challenging in multi-actor settings, where relevant evidence is distributed across participants and contexts and previously established information may later be revised. We introduce EGMEMORY, which formulates long-horizon multi-actor memory as a searchable state machine that separates persistent message-level evidence from an explicit active state. At write time, adaptive state resolution and an evidence-grounded propose-verify-commit protocol govern how this state evolves. At read time, adaptive evidence navigation iteratively resolves the state and supporting evidence required for a query, using conversational structure to narrow the search space and lexical-semantic relevance to rank candidates. The system operates through prompting and tool use without memory-specific policy training. EGMEMORY achieves 68.2% on GroupMemBench and 77.9% on EverMemBench, outperforming the strongest evaluated baselines by 22.7 and 21.4 percentage points, respectively. It further reaches 73.6% on the dyadic LoCoMo benchmark, demonstrating generalization beyond multi-actor conversations. We will release the codebase upon formal publication.
title: Propose, Verify, Commit: Evidence-Grounded Memory for Long-Horizon Multi-Actor Conversations
title_translated: 提出、验证、提交：面向长周期多参与者对话的证据锚定记忆
summary_translated: 在多参与者场景中，长周期对话记忆尤其具有挑战性，因为相关证据分散在各参与者和上下文中，且先前建立的信息可能后续被修正。我们引入EGMEMORY，将长周期多参与者记忆建模为可搜索的状态机，将持久的消息级证据与显式的活跃状态分离。在写入时，自适应状态解析和基于证据的“提出-验证-提交”协议控制状态演化。在读取时，自适应证据导航通过迭代解析查询所需的状态和支撑证据，利用对话结构缩小搜索空间，借助词汇-语义相关性对候选进行排序。该系统通过提示和工具使用运行，无需专门的记忆策略训练。EGMEMORY在GroupMemBench上达到68.2%，在EverMemBench上达到77.9%，分别优于最强基线22.7和21.4个百分点。它还在双人对话的LoCoMo基准上达到73.6%，展示了超越多参与者对话的泛化能力。代码将在正式发表后发布。

summary: Federated learning lets multiple parties train a shared model without pooling their data, but a client with far less data than the others can end up poorly served even when the group's average accuracy looks fine. We ask whether the choice of pretrained backbone affects this under LoRA fine-tuning, and whether per-word perplexity on the target text predicts which backbone helps the worst-off client before federated training starts. We ran 313 experiments across three text-classification datasets and three similarly sized backbones (RoBERTa, BERTweet, PubMedBERT), each compared against a task-specific baseline on identical data splits. Lower-perplexity backbones consistently produced larger gains for the worst-performing client, with a rank correlation of -0.87 across nine dataset-backbone pairs; a backbone held out of the analysis confirmed the pattern. Personalization with Ditto recovered only 4-12% of the gap between training alone and full federation, and removing aggregation entirely erased the benefit. A client's update also showed no sign of conflicting with the group's update; the two are close to orthogonal, ruling out one proposed explanation for this failure. Practically: measure perplexity on a sample of task text before choosing a backbone, and do not rely on personalization to protect a data-poor client. We release our code, predictions, and full results for others to test.
title: Perplexity Predicts Protection: Choosing Pretrained Backbones for Worst-Client Fairness in Federated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
title_translated: 困惑度预测保护：在联邦参数高效微调中选择预训练主干以实现最差客户端公平性
summary_translated: 联邦学习允许多方在不共享数据的情况下共同训练一个共享模型，但当某个客户端的数据远少于其他客户端时，即使整体平均准确率看起来良好，该客户端仍可能表现不佳。我们探讨了预训练主干的选择是否影响LoRA微调下的这一现象，以及目标文本上的每词困惑度是否能在联邦训练开始前预测哪个主干能更好地帮助最弱势客户端。我们在三个文本分类数据集和三个相似规模的主干（RoBERTa、BERTweet、PubMedBERT）上进行了313次实验，每个主干均与任务特定基线在相同数据划分下对比。低困惑度主干始终为表现最差的客户端带来更大提升，九个数据集-主干组合间的排名相关性为-0.87；一个未参与分析的主干验证了这一模式。使用Ditto进行个性化仅恢复了训练单独与完整联邦之间差距的4-12%，而完全移除聚合则抹除了全部优势。客户端更新也未显示出与群体更新冲突的迹象；两者接近正交，排除了该失败的一种可能解释。实践建议：在选择主干前，先在任务文本样本上测量困惑度，不要依赖个性化来保护数据贫乏的客户端。我们已公开代码、预测结果和完整实验数据供他人验证。

summary: Long-context language models interface with external knowledge through raw natural language. In retrieval-augmented systems, this creates a persistent index-payload schism: dense vectors enable searchable routing, but models must re-ingest lengthy text payloads for reasoning at O(N^2) attention cost. Existing compression methods further produce private states tied to specific architectures. We introduce Machine-Interpretable Information (MII), the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol. A dual-timescale state-space Writer compiles documents into a canonical, fixed-bandwidth state (56 tokens), and a lightweight Translator maps it into any frozen Reader's embedding space, reducing query-time cost to O(K). The resulting .mii artifact unifies Retrieval (searchable geometry), Reasoning (global memory), and Reconstruction (grounded details) in a single transferable medium. We demonstrate strong cross-model interoperability across heterogeneous LLMs (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) -- despite the Writer using a legacy GPT-2 vocabulary, forcing genuine semantic translation rather than token-level memorization. Mechanistic probes reveal modular latent structure: entity representations can be causally traced and zero-shot transplanted between unrelated document states while remaining decodable. To address lexical reconstruction under fixed bandwidth, we propose Residual-MII, a cache hierarchy combining compiled global memory with sparse local evidence. On HotpotQA (7,405 queries), Residual-MII exceeds full-context Exact Match at approximately 7% of the attention FLOPs, suggesting a paradigm shift toward compiled, transferable neural document formats.
title: Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures
title_translated: 机器可解释信息：将文档编译为可搜索且可读的协议状态
summary_translated: 长上下文语言模型通过原始自然语言与外部知识交互。在检索增强系统中，这导致了索引-载荷分裂：密集向量支持可搜索路由，但模型必须重新摄入长文本载荷以进行推理，产生O(N^2)的注意力开销。现有压缩方法进一步生成与特定架构绑定的私有状态。我们提出机器可解释信息（MII），首个代理到代理（A2A）的文档到状态协议。一个双时间尺度状态空间写入器将文档编译为统一的固定带宽状态（56 token），一个轻量级翻译器将其映射到任意冻结阅读器的嵌入空间，将查询时间开销降至O(K)。由此产生的.mii文件在单一可传输介质中统一了检索（可搜索几何）、推理（全局记忆）和重建（基于事实的细节）。我们在异构LLM（如Llama、Qwen、Mistral）间展示了强大的跨模型互操作性——尽管写入器使用旧版GPT-2词汇表，强制真正的语义翻译而非词元级记忆。机制探针揭示了模块化的潜在结构：实体表示可被因果追踪并在无关文档状态间零样本移植，同时保持可解码性。为应对固定带宽下的词汇重建问题，我们提出Residual-MII，一种结合编译全局记忆与稀疏局部证据的缓存层次结构。在HotpotQA（7,405个查询）上，Residual-MII在约7%的注意力FLOPs下超越全上下文Exact Match，暗示向编译式、可迁移神经文档格式的范式转变。

summary: The visual modality, i.e., images, plays a key role in multi-modal entity alignment (MMEA). Existing approaches often directly fuse the image with other modalities to align different entities. Although simple, such strategies overlook the potential noise in the images and their semantic misalignment with corresponding entities, resulting in suboptimal fusion and degraded performance. Addressing this, we propose a novel Reliability-Aware framework for MMEA (RA-MMEA), which assesses visual reliability and adaptively improves unreliable visual representations for robust entity alignment. The core lies in two modules, including dependency-aware visual reliability prediction (DA-VRP) and stability-regularized visual embedding generation (SR-VEG). The former aims to estimate the reliability of an image by leveraging multi-modal dependency within the entity, while the latter focuses on producing alternative visual representation conditioned on semantics encoded in textual modalities for multi-modal fusion. Compared to current methods, RA-MMEA enables more reliable visual representations for modality fusion, thereby improving performance. In extensive experiments, RA-MMEA achieves state-of-the-art results, verifying the importance of reliable visual modality for entity alignment and the effectiveness of RA-MMEA. The code and results will be released.
title: Knowing When to Trust Images: Reliability-Aware Multi-modal Entity Alignment
title_translated: 何时信任图像：可靠性感知的多模态实体对齐
summary_translated: 视觉模态（即图像）在多模态实体对齐（MMEA）中起着关键作用。现有方法通常直接将图像与其他模态融合以对齐不同实体，但这种策略忽略了图像中的潜在噪声及其与对应实体的语义不一致，导致融合效果不佳、性能下降。为此，我们提出一种新颖的可靠性感知多模态实体对齐框架（RA-MMEA），通过评估视觉可靠性并自适应地改进不可靠的视觉表示，实现鲁棒的实体对齐。核心包含两个模块：依赖感知的视觉可靠性预测（DA-VRP）和稳定性正则化的视觉嵌入生成（SR-VEG）。前者利用实体内部的多模态依赖关系估计图像可靠性，后者则基于文本模态编码的语义生成替代性视觉表示，用于多模态融合。相比现有方法，RA-MMEA能够提供更可靠的视觉表示，从而提升融合性能。大量实验表明，RA-MMEA达到当前最优结果，验证了可靠视觉模态在实体对齐中的重要性及RA-MMEA的有效性。代码与结果将公开发布。

summary: Peer-review evaluation is increasingly being automated with LLM-as-a-judge metrics, but this creates a measurement risk. A review may receive a high score because it is fluent, organized, and polished, rather than because it provides a strong evaluation of the paper. This risk is especially important in AI-assisted reviewing, where reviewers may use LLMs to improve clarity or presentation while preserving the underlying judgments. We propose a statistical framework for testing whether peer-review evaluation metrics capture substantive review quality beyond surface-level linguistic form. The framework compares original human reviews with faithful LLM rewrites that preserve the same evaluative content while changing wording and presentation. Using a dataset comprising 4,044 meaning-preserving rewrites derived from 674 human reviews from ICLR and NeurIPS, we evaluate 29 content-oriented peer-review evaluation metrics drawn from four prior works through complementary tests of surface sensitivity and robustness. Although these metrics are intended to capture review properties beyond surface-level, writing-dependent characteristics, we find that sensitivity to rewriting is widespread. Under our primary analysis, 23 metrics assign significantly different scores to reviews whose evaluative content is preserved, while only six satisfy our robustness criterion. The patterns are largely consistent across two LLM judge models, suggesting that the issue is not specific to a single judge. These findings show that many peer-review evaluation metrics partially conflate review quality with linguistic presentation, and indicate that robustness to meaning-preserving rewriting should be validated before such metrics are used to compare human-written, AI-assisted, and AI-generated reviews.
title: Judging a Review by its Cover: A Reliability Analysis of LLM-based Peer Review Evaluation Metrics
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026
title_translated: 通过封面判断评审质量：基于大语言模型的同行评审评估指标可靠性分析
summary_translated: 同行评审正越来越多地采用大语言模型作为评判者来自动化评估，但这带来了测量风险。一篇评审可能因语言流畅、结构清晰而获得高分，而非因其对论文提供了有力评价。这一风险在AI辅助评审中尤为突出，因为评审者可能使用大语言模型提升表达清晰度或呈现形式，同时保留原有的判断内容。我们提出一个统计框架，用于检验同行评审评估指标是否超越表面语言形式，真正捕捉到评审的实质性质量。该框架比较原始人工评审与忠实的大语言模型重写版本——后者保留相同的评价内容，仅改变措辞和呈现方式。基于来自ICLR和NeurIPS的674篇人工评审生成的4,044个语义保持不变的重写样本，我们通过表面敏感性和鲁棒性互补测试，评估了来自四项前期研究的29个面向内容的同行评审评估指标。尽管这些指标旨在捕捉超越表面特征的评价属性，但我们发现其对重写的敏感性普遍存在。在主要分析中，23个指标对评价内容相同但表述不同的评审分配显著不同的分数，仅有6个满足我们的鲁棒性标准。两种大语言模型裁判的结果模式高度一致，表明问题并非特定于某一裁判模型。这些发现表明，许多同行评审评估指标在一定程度上混淆了评审质量与语言呈现，提示在用于比较人工撰写、AI辅助和AI生成评审前，必须验证其对语义保持重写的鲁棒性。

summary: An automated fact-checking system returns a label: the claim is true, or it is false. In many such systems the verdict remains the primary output. What is generally missing is a record of which document settled the question, of what would have had to be different for the verdict to change, or of whether the same claim, reworded, would have been judged the same way. We call the missing piece a warrant: a separate statement of what was guaranteed and on what grounds. Formal methods produce evidence of this kind, and regulation is beginning to ask for it, since the Digital Services Act and the AI Act both call for auditable evidence about how systems behave. Surveys of automated fact-checking are usually organised by pipeline stage, and treat logic as one technique among many. We organise the field by what is being formalised instead, which gives five levels: the claim, the reasoning, the system doing the checking, the ecosystem the claim spreads through, and the regulatory obligation. Sorting 121 works into those levels, two patterns stand out. Most of the relevant formal machinery already exists, but it was built for other domains and has rarely been applied here, and the gap is widest for verifying the checking system itself. Several stages of the routine professional fact-checkers follow also have no stated correctness criterion, and two of them, writing a claim in checkable form and correcting a verdict already published, are not formally specified in any work we coded. We close with open problems, each with a suggested first step.
title: SoK: Formal Methods for Fact-Checking and Information Integrity
title_translated: 综述：事实核查与信息完整性的形式化方法
summary_translated: 自动化事实核查系统返回一个标签：声明为真或为假。在许多此类系统中，最终结论是主要输出。然而普遍缺失的是：哪份文档决定了该结论？若何种条件变化会导致结论改变？同一声明换种表述是否仍会被同样判定？我们称这些缺失部分为“理由”（warrant）：一个独立陈述，说明什么被保证以及依据何在。形式化方法可生成此类证据，而监管机构正开始要求此类证据——《数字服务法》和《人工智能法案》均要求提供关于系统行为的可审计证据。现有自动化事实核查综述通常按处理流程阶段组织，并将逻辑视为众多技术之一。我们则按被形式化的对象进行组织，分为五个层次：声明本身、推理过程、核查系统、声明传播的生态系统，以及监管义务。我们将121项相关工作归类至这五个层次，发现两个显著模式：大多数相关形式化工具已存在，但多源自其他领域，极少在此应用；尤其在验证核查系统自身方面差距最大。此外，专业事实核查流程中的多个环节缺乏明确的正确性标准，其中两项——将声明转化为可核查形式，以及修正已发布的结论——在我们所编码的所有工作中均未被正式定义。最后，我们提出若干开放问题，并为每个问题建议首个可行步骤。

summary: Cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) is increasingly important in multi-national industries, where critical technical evidence may exist in a different language than the query. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately capture domain-specific cross-lingual retrieval or the retrieval-depth and recoverability failures that aggregate recall hides.   In this work, we benchmark CLIR in the chemical domain, with a focus on patent data. We construct a multilingual dataset from Google Patents and the European Patent Office (EPO) data, spanning five languages (covering major Eastern and Western languages) and reflecting the diversity and complexity of real-world industrial documentation.   Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate eight state-of-the-art embedding models for cross-lingual retrieval. Our results show a substantial performance gap between monolingual and cross-lingual settings: for the best-performing model, Recall@10 drops from 0.72 to 0.53 in cross-lingual setting. Retrieval depth also degrades significantly, with relevant documents ranked lower across languages in cross-lingual scenarios. Furthermore, some multilingual embedding models that perform strongly in monolingual settings exhibit sharp declines when queries and documents are in different languages, providing practical insights for model selection in cross-lingual use cases.   These findings highlight critical limitations of current approaches and emphasize the need for more robust cross-lingual retrieval methods in domain-specific settings. Our benchmark provides actionable insights for model selection and establishes a controlled diagnostic evaluation framework for CLIR over industrial technical text. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/MohammadKhodadad/Multi-Lingual-QAC.
title: ChemCLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Multilingual Chemical Patents
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 22 pages including references and appendices; 7 pages of main text
title_translated: ChemCLIR-Bench：多语言化学专利中跨语言信息检索的基准测试
summary_translated: 跨语言信息检索（CLIR）在跨国产业中日益重要，关键的技术证据可能存在于与查询语言不同的语料中。然而，现有基准未能充分反映领域特定的跨语言检索，也未能揭示聚合召回率掩盖的检索深度不足和可恢复性失败问题。本文针对化学领域，聚焦专利数据构建CLIR基准。我们从Google专利和欧洲专利局（EPO）数据中构建了一个多语言数据集，涵盖五种语言（覆盖主要东西方语言），反映了真实工业文档的多样性和复杂性。基于该数据集，我们系统评估了八种最先进的嵌入模型在跨语言检索中的表现。结果显示，跨语言设置下性能显著低于单语言设置：最佳模型的Recall@10从0.72降至0.53。检索深度也大幅下降，相关文档在跨语言场景中排名更低。此外，一些在单语言设置中表现优异的多语言嵌入模型，在查询与文档语言不同时出现急剧性能下滑，为跨语言应用场景中的模型选择提供了实用洞见。这些发现突显了当前方法在特定领域中的关键局限，强调需要更稳健的跨语言检索方法。本基准为模型选择提供行动指南，并建立了一个受控的诊断评估框架，适用于工业技术文本的CLIR。数据与代码已在https://github.com/MohammadKhodadad/Multi-Lingual-QAC公开。

summary: Reasoning language models are trained to produce solutions, not to refuse them, and this bias persists when the problem they are handed is false. Asked to prove a corrupted theorem, a strong model will typically comply and produce a confident derivation of something untrue. We present Euston, an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist exactly this. Training data were generated with GraphSynth, a probabilistic factor-graph generator that couples attribute-level diversity to decode-time structural masking and span-synchronized verification, yielding 3{,}026 matched true/corrupted statement pairs (6,052 statements) drawn from arXiv papers spanning 2010--2025. We fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-8B with GRPO under a rule-based, zero-API reward for 189 steps on four H100 GPUs. On a balanced 200-true/200-false held-out split, balanced accuracy rises from 29.50% to 63.75% and the discrimination gap---the difference between the rate of calling false statements false and the rate of calling true statements false moves from -0.5% (z=-0.1) to +27.5% (z=+6.0). Critically, the gain is not purchased with general mathematical ability: AIME 2026 accuracy under official semantics is 65.00% against a 69.17% base, a difference of -4.17% that is not statistically significant, whereas an earlier run of the same recipe on a smaller GraphSynth corpus collapsed to 40.00%. Median response length also falls from 19,217 to 18,296 tokens and the truncation rate from 25.8% to 8.3%, so the improvement does not come from thinking longer. We report the result together with the confounds that bound its interpretation, principally the all-false composition of the official evaluation sets and the low precision implied at realistic error prevalence.
title: Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics
title_translated: Euston：在不丢失数学能力的前提下消除数学奉承倾向的训练方法
summary_translated: 推理型语言模型被训练为生成解决方案，而非拒绝它们，因此当面对错误问题时，这种偏见依然存在。若要求模型证明一个被破坏的定理，强模型通常会顺从并自信地推导出一个虚假结论。我们提出Euston，一个80亿参数的数学命题验证模型，专门训练以抵抗此类情况。训练数据由GraphSynth生成，这是一种概率因子图生成器，通过解码时的结构掩码与跨度同步验证，结合属性级多样性，生成了3,026对匹配的真/被破坏命题（共6,052个命题），数据源自2010–2025年arXiv论文。我们使用GRPO算法，在四块H100 GPU上对DeepSeek-R1-8B进行微调，采用基于规则的零API奖励机制，共189步。在平衡的200真/200假保留测试集上，平衡准确率从29.50%提升至63.75%，辨别差距（即错误命题被识别为错误的比例与真命题被误判为错误的比例之差）从-0.5%（z=-0.1）跃升至+27.5%（z=+6.0）。关键在于，这种提升并未以牺牲通用数学能力为代价：在官方语义下的AIME 2026准确率为65.00%，相较于基线69.17%仅下降4.17%，差异无统计显著性；而此前使用较小GraphSynth语料库的实验则崩溃至40.00%。中位响应长度从19,217降至18,296个token，截断率从25.8%降至8.3%，说明改进并非源于更长时间的思考。我们报告结果的同时也指出影响解释的主要混杂因素，尤其是官方评估集的全假组成以及在现实错误发生率下的低精度暗示。

summary: Acoustic representation learning is crucial for speech processing, yet low-resource languages (LRLs) face severe data scarcity, limiting the effectiveness of traditional and self-supervised methods. As a promising alternative, in this work, we propose to enhance acoustic representation trough a cross-modal transfer knowledge approach, based on heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs), where acoustic and linguistic entities are modeled as distinct node types within a unified graph. Through message-passing mechanisms, linguistic nodes explicitly transfer knowledge to acoustic nodes, enabling structured and interpretable cross-modal information flow. To highlight this knowledge transfer and its benefits, we measured standard clustering metrics as an intrinsic evaluation of acoustic representation, and to emphasize applicability, we performed isolated-word recognition tasks using an English benchmark and a Cameroonian language dataset in low resources settings . Results demonstrate that acoustic representations consistently benefit from linguistic knowledge propagated through the graph. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of explicit cross-modal knowledge transfer for acoustic representation learning using HGNNs, highlighting a promising direction for speech representation in low-resource settings.
title: Enhancing speech representation learning with cross-modal knowledge transfer with HGNN under low resource settings: the case study of Yemba
title_translated: 在低资源环境下利用HGNN进行跨模态知识迁移以增强语音表示学习：以Yemba语言为例
summary_translated: 语音表示学习对于语音处理至关重要，但低资源语言（LRLs）面临严重数据稀缺问题，限制了传统和自监督方法的有效性。作为一种有前景的替代方案，本文提出通过基于异构图神经网络（HGNN）的跨模态知识迁移方法来增强语音表示，其中语音和语言实体被建模为统一图中的不同节点类型。通过消息传递机制，语言节点显式地将知识传递给语音节点，从而实现结构化且可解释的跨模态信息流动。为突出这种知识迁移及其优势，我们使用标准聚类指标对语音表示进行了内在评估，并在低资源设置下，利用英语基准和喀麦隆语言数据集执行孤立词识别任务以强调其适用性。结果表明，语音表示在通过图传播的语言知识中持续受益。据我们所知，这是首次使用HGNN实现语音表示学习中显式的跨模态知识迁移，凸显了低资源环境下语音表示的一个有前景方向。
