summary: Speech-text space alignment is a multimodal representation learning method consisting to map different speech and text into a shared representation space, leading to enrichment of the representation of each modality. Proposed architectures, such as SAMU-XLSR, typically follow a student/teacher framework, with the goal of fine-tuning an audio encoder to produce representations that closely match those of the text. In this way a speech representation is semantically enriched. However, such systems generally require large amounts of training data and considerable computational resource, making them difficult to apply to low resources languages under frugal constraints. The present work proposes a data-efficient space alignment method based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks and link prediction. The core idea is to leverage message passing to explicitly transfer information from the text modality to the speech modality, thereby reducing the need for large training datasets and intrinsically enriching the acoustic representations, all in a more interpretable manner. Although thoroughly explored for high-resource languages, word-level tasks in speech remain relevant for certain low-resource languages. Therefore, we conducted experiments on speech-text alignment at the word level using the TIMIT (English) dataset and Yemba (a Cameroonian language). Our approach yields results comparable to those of SAMU-XLSR, a state-of-the-art method, and even surpasses it for the Yemba language in the task of word retrieval, while using far fewer resources, demonstrating its power, frugality, and efficiency.
title: Low resource cross-modal alignment using HGNN to enhance speech representation
title_translated: 利用HGNN实现低资源跨模态对齐以增强语音表示
summary_translated: 语音-文本空间对齐是一种多模态表示学习方法，旨在将不同的语音和文本映射到共享表示空间，从而丰富每种模态的表示。现有架构如SAMU-XLSR通常采用学生/教师框架，目标是微调音频编码器以生成与文本表示高度匹配的输出，从而使语音表示在语义上得到增强。然而，这类系统通常需要大量训练数据和大量计算资源，使其难以在资源受限的低资源语言中应用。本文提出一种基于异构图神经网络（HGNN）和链接预测的数据高效空间对齐方法。核心思想是利用消息传递机制，显式地将文本模态的信息传递到语音模态，从而减少对大规模训练数据的需求，并以更可解释的方式内在地丰富语音表示。尽管在高资源语言中已广泛研究，但语音中的词级任务对某些低资源语言仍具相关性。因此，我们在TIMIT（英语）和Yemba（喀麦隆语言）数据集上进行了词级语音-文本对齐实验。我们的方法在性能上可与最先进的SAMU-XLSR相当，甚至在Yemba语言的词检索任务中表现更优，同时使用远少的资源，展示了其强大的能力、节俭性和效率。

summary: Language models are appealing tools for research on the past. But to trust the evidence a model provides, researchers need to know whether its responses fit the period represented. Validation is challenging, because this is not a task living people ordinarily perform, and because many questions have multiple correct answers. We use historical texts to develop a benchmark for a model's representation of English-language contexts 1831-1930, relying on pairwise comparisons to multiple ground truths and strong distractors to score the hardest questions in an appropriately graduated way. We find that generative tasks are harder than discriminative ones; in fact, reasoning models can typically discern the weakness of their own generated answers. While models pretrained exclusively on historical text lead the pack when evaluated by answer likelihood, they cannot compete with commercial models in free generation. None of the models we tested represent historical contexts in a fully persuasive way yet, but progress toward that goal is evident.
title: Chronologic: Measuring Language Models' Ability to Represent the Past
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
title_translated: Chronologic：衡量语言模型对过去时间表征的能力
summary_translated: 语言模型是研究历史的重要工具。但为了信任模型提供的证据，研究人员需要了解其回答是否符合所代表的历史时期。验证具有挑战性，因为这并非普通人日常会执行的任务，且许多问题存在多个正确答案。我们利用历史文本开发了一个针对1831-1930年英语语境下模型表征能力的基准测试，依赖于与多个真实答案的成对比较以及强干扰项，以适当分级的方式评分最难的问题。我们发现生成任务比判别任务更难；事实上，推理模型通常能察觉自己生成答案的弱点。虽然仅在历史文本上预训练的模型在答案似然性评估中领先，但在自由生成方面无法与商业模型竞争。我们测试的所有模型尚未完全令人信服地表征历史语境，但向这一目标迈进的进展已明显可见。

summary: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.
title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
title_translated: OmniEdu：面向学习与教学的开放基础模型
summary_translated: 教育基础模型必须能够解决问题、理解课程结构、诊断学习者困难并提供适当的指导支持。现有的教育语言模型往往只关注问题求解或辅导，其训练混合数据按来源或任务组织，而非能力维度。我们提出了OmniEdu，一个面向K-12教育学习与教学的开源基础模型家族。其指令微调语料库整合了超过100个教育资源和通用指令来源，围绕四大能力组织：学科能力、课程根基、诊断推理和教学行动与支架构建。我们的流水线包括确定性清洗、语义审计与重写、任务特定质量评分、基于token预算的多样性选择以及教学指令分配。该流程生成了69,999个样本和1596万条监督响应token，其中包括60,951个教育专用样本。我们对4B、9B和27B模型进行微调，并评估课程根基、K-12问题求解和教学辅导能力，以及通用能力。教育导向的微调在所有模型规模下均一致提升了三个教育基准组的表现。OmniEdu-27B在K12-Bench上达到63.12% EM和76.69% F1，在MathFish上达85.89%，在EDUMATH上达86.95%，在MathTutorBench的Scaffold设置中达78.74%。它还在LongTutor的Teaching平均得分上达到3.02，为所评估模型中的最高分。这些结果证明了精心策划、能力均衡的监督数据在将通用语言模型适配至涵盖问题求解、课程理解与教学支持的教育任务中的价值。

summary: The distinction between the spirit and letter of the law is a central issue across research and everyday life, and a growing concern for building safe, intelligent machines. What is this distinction based on, and how can we develop machines that follow the intention behind a rule? We used targeted adaptation that made large language models prioritize the spirit or letter of the law. With minimal modifications, our method significantly changed LLM behavior across diverse measures, novel vignettes, real-world scenarios, and influential legal cases. An analysis of model internals revealed a low-dimensional space with three interpretable dimensions matching a formal pre-specified framework for the geometry of legal concepts. These findings show how legal thought in LLMs may be organized and directed.
title: Directing large language models to follow the letter or spirit of the law
title_translated: 引导大型语言模型遵循法律的字面或精神
summary_translated: 法律的字面与精神之间的区别是研究和日常生活中一个核心议题，也是构建安全、智能机器日益关注的问题。这种区别的基础是什么？我们如何开发出能遵循规则意图的机器？我们采用了针对性适应方法，使大型语言模型优先遵循法律的精神或字面。通过极少的修改，我们的方法显著改变了LLM在多种度量、新情景、现实世界场景和重要法律案例中的行为。对模型内部的分析揭示了一个低维空间，包含三个可解释的维度，与预先指定的法律概念几何框架相匹配。这些发现表明了LLM中法律思维的组织方式及其可引导性。

summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) can sound plausible yet be unfaithful to the model's underlying reasoning. Most prior work probes CoT faithfulness through input--output behavior or input attributions, leaving internal computation largely underexplored. We instead cast faithfulness as internal concept grounding: Does a large language model's (LLM) CoT reasoning engage the same internal concepts that support the LLM's direct prediction, and do the shared concepts causally drive its answer? Encoding a prediction pass and a CoT pass with a single shared sparse autoencoder (SAE), a reliable approximator of the latent concepts LLMs use, makes their internal concepts directly comparable. We introduce three correlational metrics of concept-level alignment and a causal metric, $Δp$, which ablates the shared concepts and measures the drop in answer probability. Across five LLMs and four datasets, concept alignment is generally high, as indicated by the correlational metrics; yet these only identify which concepts are shared, not how much they causally contribute. $Δp$ fills this gap: causal faithfulness varies substantially with model depth, peaking at mid-to-late layers rather than the final ones, and model scale reshapes the layer-wise profile. Moreover, causally important shared concepts are not always verbalized in the CoT. These dissociations suggest that faithfulness cannot be reliably assessed from surface-level or representational correspondence alone; assessing it requires causal tests of whether the internal concepts underlying a CoT actually drive the model's prediction.
title: From Concept Alignment to Causal Grounding: An Intervention Test of Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
comment: In submission
title_translated: 从概念对齐到因果锚定：链式思维忠实性的干预测试
summary_translated: 链式思维（CoT）可能听起来合理，但未必忠实于模型的内在推理过程。以往多数研究通过输入-输出行为或输入归因来探测CoT的忠实性，而内部计算过程仍被严重忽视。本文将忠实性重新定义为内部概念的因果锚定：大语言模型（LLM）的CoT推理是否使用了支持其直接预测的相同内部概念，且这些共享概念是否在因果上驱动了最终答案？通过使用单一共享稀疏自编码器（SAE）编码预测过程和CoT过程，该方法可可靠地近似LLM所使用的潜在概念，从而实现内部概念的直接比较。我们提出了三种概念层面的对齐相关度量指标和一种因果度量指标$Δp$，后者通过消除共享概念并测量答案概率的下降来评估因果贡献。在五个LLM和四个数据集上的实验表明，概念对齐度普遍较高（由相关度量反映），但这些指标仅能识别共享概念，无法揭示其因果重要性。$Δp$填补了这一空白：因果忠实性随模型深度变化显著，在中后期层达到峰值而非最终层，且模型规模会重塑层间分布特征。此外，具有因果重要性的共享概念并不总在CoT中被显式表达。这些分离现象表明，仅凭表面或表征对应无法可靠评估忠实性；必须通过因果测试来验证CoT背后的内部概念是否真正驱动了模型预测。

summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.
title: Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering
title_translated: 弥合静态与代理型RAG在台湾历史问答中的应用
summary_translated: 代理型检索增强生成（RAG）使语言模型能够根据先前检索到的证据动态调整检索策略，但尚不清楚这种自适应编排是否始终优于精心设计的静态流水线。我们对台湾历史问答任务中的代理型与静态RAG进行了受控对比，两者共享相同的生成器和混合检索后端。尽管总体性能相似，但在70.83%的问题上两种流水线表现不同，平均后优势相互抵消。一个为每个问题选择更优响应的“理想选择器”比表现最好的单一流水线提升了0.2417的综合得分，揭示了巨大的问题级优化空间。因此，我们提出一种事后选择机制，通过比较两种响应及其引用证据，显著优于任一单独流水线，并恢复了60.34%的理想选择器性能差距。结果表明，整体性能比较可能掩盖不同检索策略之间的有意义问题级差异，利用它们的互补性可能比追求通用最优流水线更具成效。

summary: A RAG system can hand you the right answer and cite a source it did not actually use. Models output these unfaithful citations via post-rationalization: they write the answer first and then attach a citation to whatever passage looks close enough. Search agents are now trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which pays them for getting the answer right. We asked whether that training also teaches them to cite honestly.   Improving an existing methodology with a required control, we compared an instruction-tuned model against three RLVR agents trained from it, on four question-answering datasets, using only free-tier Kaggle GPUs. Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.
title: Attributable Post-Rationalization in RAG Citations: A Controlled Reproduction and an RLVR Comparison
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, code available at: this https URL
title_translated: RAG引用中的可归因后理性化：一次受控复现与RLVR对比
summary_translated: RAG系统可以给出正确答案并引用一个它实际上并未使用的来源。模型通过后理性化产生这些不忠实的引用：先写出答案，再附上看起来相近的段落作为引用。如今，搜索代理已通过可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行训练，以奖励正确答案。我们探究这种训练是否也教会了模型诚实引用。通过改进现有方法并引入必要对照，我们在四个问答数据集上，仅使用免费级Kaggle GPU，将指令微调模型与三个基于该模型训练的RLVR代理进行了对比。后理性化普遍存在：在基于维基百科的问题中，约七分之一的引用是不忠实的。RLVR并未解决此问题，代理的后理性化率与基础模型一致，甚至有一个略差。仅奖励正确答案无法提升引用忠实性，因此忠实性必须独立地进行训练和评估。

summary: LLM-based AI systems answer political questions for hundreds of millions of people. Current audits measure what they say to an average user, but their behavior is dynamic. I argue that their political behavior is a set of policies over whom to answer, what to say, and whether to engage at all, conditional on the topic and what the system knows about the user. I call these policies the system's speech regime, which is how a developer settles the tradeoff between answering, accommodating the user, and refusing, each of which carries a cost that varies by topic. I derive a typology of five regimes from two dimensions, engagement and stance. I test six AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek) in a preregistered experiment of 7,500 multi-turn conversations that randomly assign the user's political identity across five topics: abortion, Catalan independence, climate change, Nazism, and a zero-stakes control (pineapple on pizza). Two LLM judges from different developers score every answer, validated against human coding, and refusal is treated as an outcome rather than missing data. Every system accommodates the user on the control topic, showing that political restraint is a policy. On contested topics the systems fall into different regimes: on abortion, GPT engages and mirrors every user, Gemma refuses everyone, Claude answers strongly conservative users 35 percent of the time and almost no one else, and Grok accommodates conservatives only. On settled topics such as climate change and Nazism, five systems hold firm for every user. The systems also infer the user's overall ideology, so accommodation can spill over to topics not yet discussed. A comparison of two Grok releases shows the regime changing between versions in a way current audits miss. Speech regimes matter for alignment research and for polarization, political knowledge, and the quality of democracy.
title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity
comment: 51 pages, 6 figures. Preregistered; registration at doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21135155
title_translated: 审计LLM助手的政治倾向：参与度、立场与用户身份
summary_translated: 基于LLM的AI系统为数亿人回答政治问题。当前审计仅衡量它们对普通用户的回答内容，但其行为是动态的。我认为其政治行为是一组关于回答谁、说什么以及是否参与的策略，这些策略取决于话题和系统对用户了解的程度。我将这些策略称为系统的‘言论制度’，即开发者在回答、迎合用户与拒绝之间权衡的结果，每种选择都有成本，且成本随话题变化。我从两个维度——参与度与立场——推导出五种言论制度类型。我们在一项预注册实验中测试了六个AI系统（OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Google、Mistral、DeepSeek），共7,500轮多轮对话，随机分配用户在五个话题（堕胎、加泰罗尼亚独立、气候变化、纳粹主义，以及无风险控制题：披萨上放菠萝）中的政治身份。两名来自不同开发者的LLM裁判评分，经人类编码验证，拒绝被视为结果而非缺失数据。所有系统在控制话题上均迎合用户，表明政治克制是一种策略。在争议话题上，各系统表现出不同制度：在堕胎议题上，GPT会回应并镜像每位用户，Gemma拒绝所有人，Claude仅在面对强烈保守用户时回答35%的情况，其他情况几乎不回应，而Grok仅迎合保守派。在气候变迁和纳粹主义等共识话题上，五个系统对所有用户都保持坚定立场。系统还能推断用户的整体意识形态，导致迎合效应蔓延至尚未讨论的话题。对两个Grok版本的对比显示，其言论制度在版本间发生变化，而当前审计方法未能捕捉这一点。言论制度对对齐研究、极化、政治知识及民主质量均有重要意义。

summary: Multilingual code language models transfer skills across programming languages (PLs), but whether any PL occupies a privileged pivot position remains contested: geometric analyses point to C-family languages and Go, while behavioral evidence highlights Python. We revisit this question under controls for representational anisotropy and length variation across PLs, two confounds that compromise prior cosine-based analyses. Across three code models on multilingual competitive-programming data, we study three views of cross-PL organization: pairwise PL geometry, PL-English alignment, and pivoted retrieval through candidate PL representation spaces. The results are relation-dependent. Code-code geometry reveals structured language regions but no universal center; code-English alignment favors high-level scripting languages; and pivoted retrieval favors different intermediate spaces for code-to-code and English-to-code transfer. These findings suggest that Python's special role is better understood as English-facing affinity than as universal geometric centrality.
title: Rethinking Pivot Programming Languages in Code Language Models
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 重新思考代码语言模型中的枢纽编程语言
summary_translated: 多语言代码语言模型可在编程语言间迁移技能，但是否存在某种编程语言占据特权枢纽地位仍存在争议：几何分析指向C族语言和Go，而行为证据则强调Python。我们在此控制表示异质性和语言长度差异这两个干扰因素，重新审视该问题，这些因素曾损害以往基于余弦相似度的分析。在三个代码模型处理多语言竞赛编程数据时，我们考察了跨语言组织的三种视角：编程语言间的成对几何关系、编程语言与英语的对齐程度，以及通过候选语言表示空间进行的枢纽检索。结果具有依赖性：代码-代码几何揭示了结构化的语言区域，但无统一中心；代码-英语对齐偏好高级脚本语言；而枢纽检索在代码-代码与英语-代码迁移中分别青睐不同的中间空间。这些发现表明，Python的特殊作用更应理解为对英语的亲和性，而非普遍的几何中心性。

summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) on live websites through user testing is expensive, subjective, and difficult to scale. LLM agents offer a promising route to automating UX testing by simulating realistic user behaviour. However, existing simulation approaches typically lack multimodality and require time-consuming manual review to extract actionable insights. We formalise UX improvement recommendation from simulation data as a structured natural language generation and ranking problem, and establish an evaluation protocol using expert annotation and LLM-as-a-Judge. We present AMUSER, a multimodal framework which simulates user behaviour and automatically generates prioritised UX improvement recommendations from resulting data. We evaluate AMUSER on commercial websites and show that its recommendations substantially outperform those from text-only simulation (NDCG@3 = 0.758 versus 0.359) at an 89% lower simulation cost. Our results suggest an asymmetric role of multimodality: visual access during simulation improves recommendations through richer traces, while providing visual inputs during recommendation generation can modestly degrade quality. We also discuss practical deployment lessons from applying AMUSER to commercial websites.
title: Automatic multimodal UX improvement recommendations from LLM agent user simulations
title_translated: 基于大语言模型代理用户模拟的自动多模态用户体验优化建议
summary_translated: 通过用户测试评估实时网站的用户体验（UX）成本高昂、主观性强且难以扩展。大语言模型（LLM）代理通过模拟真实用户行为，为自动化UX测试提供了有前景的路径。然而，现有的模拟方法通常缺乏多模态能力，且需要耗时的人工审查才能提取可操作的洞察。我们将从模拟数据中生成UX优化建议的形式化为结构化自然语言生成与排序问题，并采用专家标注和LLM作为评判者建立评估协议。我们提出了AMUSER，一个支持多模态的框架，能够模拟用户行为并自动生成优先级排序的UX优化建议。我们在商业网站上对AMUSER进行了评估，结果表明其建议在NDCG@3指标上显著优于仅文本模拟（0.758 vs 0.359），同时模拟成本降低了89%。我们的研究发现多模态作用具有不对称性：模拟过程中视觉信息的访问通过更丰富的行为轨迹提升了建议质量，但在生成建议时提供视觉输入则会轻微降低质量。此外，我们还分享了将AMUSER应用于商业网站的实际部署经验。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human decisions and communication, yet their behavioural regularities remain difficult to characterize systematically. We develop a cross-linguistic psychometric profiling framework and evaluate nine LLMs using seven psychological instruments, with five repeated administrations per model and language in Chinese and English. Items unresolved after a prespecified retry procedure are retained as NA. Joint analysis of scored and NA responses captures response tendencies and boundaries of self-report applicability. LLMs exhibit structured, model-specific profiles despite a shared alignment-shaped pattern of higher prosocial and self-regulatory responses and lower dominance, disengagement and harmful-intent endorsement. NA responses are structured rather than uniformly distributed, indicating where outputs are treated as inapplicable, refused or cannot be mapped to valid response options. Language condition and provider origin are associated with profile configuration and answerability, whereas repeated administrations show high reproducibility and permit recovery of model identity. Human-reference and prompt-robustness analyses further indicate that these signatures are context dependent. Joint analysis of psychometric profiling and answerability offers a framework for quantifying deployment-level behavioural signatures.
title: Measuring Behavioural Signatures of Large Language Models through Psychometric Profiling
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures
title_translated: 通过心理测量学分析衡量大语言模型的行为特征
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地参与人类决策与交流，但其行为规律仍难以系统刻画。我们开发了一个跨语言的心理测量学分析框架，使用七种心理学工具评估九个LLM，每种模型在中文和英文环境下重复测试五次。在预设重试次数后仍未解决的问题保留为NA值。对评分结果与NA值的联合分析捕捉了模型的响应倾向及其自报告适用性的边界。尽管存在共同的对齐模式（表现为更高的亲社会性和自我调节反应，更低的支配性、脱离感和有害意图认同），各模型仍表现出结构化的、特有的心理画像。NA值并非均匀分布，而是呈现结构性特征，表明模型输出在某些情况下被视为不适用、拒绝或无法映射到有效选项。语言条件和模型提供商来源与画像配置及可回答性相关，而重复测试显示出高度可复现性，并能恢复模型身份。人类参照与提示鲁棒性分析进一步表明这些行为特征具有上下文依赖性。心理测量学分析与可回答性联合分析为量化部署层面的行为特征提供了框架。

summary: Non-technical stakeholders frequently cannot write the SQL needed to extract insights from operational databases. We built and evaluated a Text-to-SQL agent that closes this gap end to end: a six-node LangGraph StateGraph checks question relevance, fetches the live schema, generates PostgreSQL, validates it with a dry run, retries on failure, executes the query, and narrates the result set in plain English. The agent uses prompt engineering only; no model was fine-tuned. We evaluated it on the Chicago Crime dataset (approximately 8.5 million records, 22 attributes) against a hand-built benchmark of 100 natural language questions with ground-truth SQL, stratified into 30 Easy, 40 Medium and 30 Hard items. Comparing two prompt revisions of the same agent, the revised system (V2) reached a Valid SQL Rate of 93% (from 87%), an Execution Accuracy of 60% under a hybrid relational equivalence metric (from 47%; 19% from 12% under strict JSON matching), and a mean Synthesis Quality of 4.34 out of 5 (from 3.91). The single largest driver was removing a LIMIT 10 instruction from the system prompt, which had been truncating multi-row answers. Error analysis attributes the residual failures to relevance-checker false rejections, ambiguous question semantics, and free-tier API rate limits rather than to the language generation step. We report no comparison against an external baseline system or a public benchmark; the study is a single-model engineering evaluation.
title: An Iterative LangGraph Agent for Text-to-SQL: Natural Language Access to the Chicago Crime Database
title_translated: 用于文本转SQL的迭代式LangGraph代理：面向芝加哥犯罪数据库的自然语言访问
summary_translated: 非技术利益相关者通常无法编写SQL以从运营数据库中提取洞察。我们构建并评估了一个端到端的文本转SQL代理：一个六节点的LangGraph StateGraph依次执行问题相关性检查、获取实时数据模式、生成PostgreSQL语句、通过预运行验证、失败时重试、执行查询，并用自然语言叙述结果集。该代理仅使用提示工程，未进行模型微调。我们在芝加哥犯罪数据集（约850万条记录，22个属性）上进行评估，对比一个包含100个自然语言问题的手动基准，问题按难度分为30个简单、40个中等和30个困难项。比较同一代理的两个提示版本，改进后的系统（V2）在有效SQL率上达到93%（从87%提升），在混合关系等价度量下执行准确率达到60%（从47%提升；严格JSON匹配下从12%提升至19%），平均合成质量达4.34/5（从3.91提升）。最大改进源于移除系统提示中的LIMIT 10指令，该指令曾导致多行结果被截断。错误分析表明剩余失败主要归因于相关性检查的误拒、问题语义模糊以及免费版API速率限制，而非语言生成步骤。研究未与外部基线系统或公开基准进行比较，属于单一模型的工程评估。

summary: Triage in the emergency department (ED) is a sequential decision process that unfolds turn by turn. Existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for triage use completed retrospective records and report performance close to that of physicians. We implement a methodology for evaluating LLMs on sequential triage, the task of predicting a triage acuity label from a growing prefix of a nurse-patient conversation. We evaluate six LLMs at five sequential checkpoints on two corpora: 425 LLM-generated (SIMULATED) and 50 physician-authored (CLINICIAN) conversations, both labelled under the Emergency Severity Index (ESI). Every model, measured by quadratic weighted kappa (QWK), degrades from moderate-to-substantial agreement on completed records to fair-to-moderate agreement at every sequential checkpoint. Controlled perturbations show that the label at every checkpoint is anchored on the chief complaint exchanges, and prompting interventions fail to lift this plateau. Models extract clinically relevant content from later turns, yet the surprisal of the true label rises across the checkpoints. So the model fails to integrate the evidence. Three expert clinicians on the same conversations reach a QWK of 0.887-0.929, while the best model reaches 0.295. Predictions concentrate at ESI-2 and ESI-3, and models agree with each other more than with the ground truth, so ensembling worsens the failure. Deploying LLMs for ED triage based on offline benchmarks alone misses this sequential failure.
title: LLMs Anchor on Chief Complaint and Fail to Integrate Evidence in Sequential Clinical Triage
comment: Under Review
title_translated: 大语言模型在连续临床分诊中锚定主诉且未能整合证据
summary_translated: 急诊科（ED）的分诊是一个逐轮展开的序列化决策过程。现有针对LLM分诊的评估通常基于已完成的回顾性记录，报告性能接近医生水平。我们实现了一种针对连续分诊任务的评估方法，即根据护士-患者对话的逐步增长前缀预测分诊严重程度标签。我们在两个语料库上对六个LLM在五个连续时间点进行评估：425条由LLM生成的（SIMULATED）和50条由医生撰写的（CLINICIAN）对话，均依据急诊严重指数（ESI）标注。所有模型在完整记录上的表现均为中等到实质性一致（QWK），但在每个连续时间点上均下降至公平到中等一致。受控扰动实验显示，每个时间点的标签都锚定在主诉环节，提示干预无法打破这一僵局。模型虽能从后续对话中提取临床相关信息，但真实标签的意外性随时间点上升，说明模型未能整合证据。三位专家在相同对话上的QWK为0.887–0.929，而最佳模型仅为0.295。模型预测集中于ESI-2和ESI-3，且模型间一致性高于与真实标签的一致性，因此集成反而加剧了失败。仅依赖离线基准部署LLM进行ED分诊会忽略这种序列性失败。

summary: Long-context inference has become a defining capability of large language models, but exact dense attention remains costly due to its quadratic scaling with sequence length. Block-sparse attention offers a hardware-friendly alternative by routing each query block to a small set of relevant key blocks, yet accurate training-free block routing remains difficult. Existing routers often pool post-RoPE token representations, which entangles semantic aggregation with RoPE-induced geometry and attenuates local positional cues through high-frequency phase cancellation. To resolve this mismatch, we propose \textbf{Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing}, a training-free block routing framework that shifts semantic aggregation to the pre-RoPE space and reconstructs geometric bias with an offline structural prior and relative block distances. This decomposition yields an explicit closed-form block routing score without token-level search or post-hoc calibration. Experiments on long-context text and video tasks show that our method approaches full-attention accuracy across 4K--128K contexts, keeps routing overhead below 3.4 ms, and achieves a 5.03$\times$ speedup over FlashAttn at a 128K context length.
title: Block-Sparse Attention with Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing
comment: Technical report; Submitted to ACL ARR 2026 May
title_translated: 基于语义-几何解耦路由的块稀疏注意力机制
summary_translated: 长上下文推理已成为大语言模型的关键能力，但精确的密集注意力由于与序列长度呈二次方增长，计算成本高昂。块稀疏注意力通过将每个查询块路由到少量相关键块，提供了一种硬件友好的替代方案，但无需训练的块路由仍具挑战性。现有路由机制通常对RoPE后的token表示进行池化，这将语义聚合与RoPE引起的几何结构纠缠在一起，并通过高频相位抵消削弱局部位置线索。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出	extbf{语义-几何解耦路由}，一种无需训练的块路由框架：将语义聚合移至RoPE前空间，并利用离线结构先验和相对块距离重建几何偏置。该分解实现了无需逐token搜索或事后校准的显式闭式块路由得分。在长上下文文本和视频任务上的实验表明，我们的方法在4K–128K上下文范围内逼近全注意力精度，路由开销低于3.4毫秒，在128K上下文长度下相比FlashAttn实现5.03倍加速。

summary: Natural language generation (NLG) tasks span the spectrum of conditional entropy, ranging from highly constrained machine translation to open-ended dialogue generation. Structured tasks like automated peer-review generation occupy the intermediate region, where a single input admits multiple valid, overlapping outputs. In this work, we demonstrate that traditional single- and multi-reference training paradigms are suboptimal for these intermediary tasks. We provide empirical evidence that consolidating diverse references into a unified training signal is crucial for developing effective systems. To facilitate this, we introduce MERC-36K, a large-scale corpus of over 36,000 papers paired with original and consolidated peer reviews. Using this dataset, we train specific architectures to isolate the impact of different reference paradigms and benchmark against existing state-of-the-art systems. Through extensive automatic and human evaluation, we demonstrate that models trained on consolidated references significantly outperform those trained on unconsolidated references. Dataset and code will be released upon acceptance.
title: To Consolidate or not to Consolidate? Evaluating the Impact of Consolidation in Multi-Reference Training using Peer Reviews
title_translated: 整合还是不整合？基于同行评审的多参考训练中整合影响的评估
summary_translated: 自然语言生成（NLG）任务涵盖了从高度受限的机器翻译到开放式对话生成的条件熵谱。像自动同行评审生成这样的结构化任务位于中间区域，其中单个输入可以产生多个有效且重叠的输出。本文表明，传统的单参考和多参考训练范式对于这些中间任务并不理想。我们提供了实证证据，证明将多样化的参考整合为统一的训练信号对开发高效系统至关重要。为此，我们引入了MERC-36K，一个包含超过36,000篇论文及其原始与整合后同行评审的大规模语料库。利用该数据集，我们训练特定架构以隔离不同参考范式的影响，并与现有最先进系统进行基准对比。通过广泛的自动和人工评估，我们证明在整合参考上训练的模型显著优于在未整合参考上训练的模型。数据集和代码将在接受后发布。

summary: Dialectal Arabic machine translation (MT) remains challenging despite recent progress in Arabic language technologies, particularly because effective translation requires modeling not only semantic content but also dialectal variation, conversational context, speaker and addressee characteristics, and sociolinguistic appropriateness. Moreover, conventional MT metrics provide limited insight into the linguistic errors produced by dialectal systems. We present the AlexandriaX 2026 Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic MT, which addresses these challenges through three complementary subtasks: (1) context-aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic dialogue translation across 13 Arabic varieties, (2) cross-dialect Arabic translation in the financial domain covering six Arabic dialects, and (3) span-level MT error detection and classification using linguistically motivated error categories across five Arabic varieties. The shared task attracted 38 registrations for Subtask 1, 33 for Subtask 2, and 35 for Subtask 3. Twelve unique teams submitted their system description papers, all of which we accepted for publication. The best system on Subtask 1 achieved 30.42 spBLEU in the constrained track and 33.49 spBLEU in the unconstrained track. On Subtask 2, the top system obtained 28.40 spBLEU. On Subtask 3, the best system achieved an overall score of 49.82, outperforming the 24.29 baseline. Taken together, the results of the leading systems across the three subtasks highlight the benefits of explicit dialect modeling, context-aware generation, retrieval and reranking, and specialized approaches to interpretable MT error analysis. All the resources of AlexandriaX 2026 shared task are publicly available, including data, baselines, and evaluation code on our project page: https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai.
title: AlexandriaX 2026: The First Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation
comment: To Appear in ArabicNLP 2026, resources available in the following project page: this https URL
title_translated: AlexandriaX 2026：首个方言阿拉伯语机器翻译共享任务
summary_translated: 尽管阿拉伯语技术取得进展，方言阿拉伯语机器翻译（MT）仍然具有挑战性，尤其因为有效的翻译不仅需要建模语义内容，还需考虑方言差异、对话上下文、说话者与受话者特征以及社会语言得体性。此外，传统MT指标对方言系统产生的语言错误提供有限洞察。我们提出了AlexandriaX 2026方言阿拉伯语MT共享任务，通过三个互补子任务应对这些挑战：（1）跨13种阿拉伯方言的上下文感知英-方言阿拉伯语对话翻译；（2）覆盖六种阿拉伯方言的金融领域跨方言翻译；（3）使用语言学驱动的错误类别，在五种阿拉伯方言中进行细粒度MT错误检测与分类。该共享任务吸引了38支队伍参加子任务1，33支参加子任务2，35支参加子任务3。共有12支独立团队提交系统描述论文，全部被接受发表。子任务1最佳系统在约束赛道获得30.42 spBLEU，非约束赛道获得33.49 spBLEU。子任务2最佳系统获得28.40 spBLEU。子任务3最佳系统总体得分为49.82，远超24.29基线。综合来看，各子任务领先系统的成果凸显了显式方言建模、上下文感知生成、检索与重排序以及可解释MT错误分析专门方法的优势。AlexandriaX 2026所有资源均公开可用，包括数据、基线和评估代码，详见项目页面：https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai。

summary: LLM-based machine translation evaluation can closely match human judgments, but in practice it remains largely diagnostic, with the signals rarely translating into direct quality improvements under real production constraints. We propose a two-stage, evaluator-guided automatic post-editing framework that turns MQM-style evaluation into targeted repairs: a retrieval-augmented LLM evaluator outputs structured, span-level MQM diagnoses under an explicit edit contract, and a separate LLM post-editor applies minimal edits restricted to those diagnoses. This separation improves controllability and reduces paraphrastic drift compared to one-stage "judge-and-refine" baselines. In a systematic study involving seven LLMs spanning three model providers and seven languages, our best configuration consistently improves both COMET-22 and COMETKiwi scores over one-stage post-edit methods, while the evaluator's error spans and severities show strong agreement with human MQM annotations and human editor preferences.
title: Diagnose, Then Repair: A Two-Stage MQM-Guided Post-Editing Framework for Domain-Specific Machine Translation
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Industry Track and presented at ACL 2026
title_translated: 诊断后修复：一种基于MQM引导的两阶段机器翻译后编辑框架
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的机器翻译评估可接近人类判断，但在实际应用中仍主要停留在诊断层面，其信号很少能在真实生产环境中转化为直接的质量提升。我们提出一种两阶段、评估器引导的自动后编辑框架，将MQM风格评估转化为针对性修复：一个增强检索的LLM评估器在明确编辑协议下输出结构化的、细粒度的MQM诊断，而另一个独立的LLM后编辑器仅根据这些诊断进行最小限度的修改。这种分离提升了可控性，并相比单阶段“评估-优化”基线减少了改写漂移。在涉及七种LLM、三家模型提供商和七种语言的系统性研究中，我们的最优配置在COMET-22和COMETKiwi得分上持续优于单阶段后编辑方法，且评估器的错误片段及其严重程度与人类MQM标注及编辑偏好高度一致。

summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as evaluators, yet their reliability in professional assessment tasks that require expert judgment remains unclear. We investigate this challenge in the context of assessing psychotherapeutic interpersonal skills and introduce MIS-Bench, a Multimodal Interpersonal Skills (MIS) benchmark comprising 996 psychotherapy response videos annotated across 8 dimensions of Facilitative Interpersonal Skills. Across 9 MLLMs with multiple modality and prompting settings, we find that current models show only modest agreement with human experts, inconsistent gains from multimodal input, and limited benefits from reasoning-based prompting. To mitigate this gap, we propose MIS-RAFT, a regression-aware fine-tuning method inspired by RAFT and tailored to fine-grained interpersonal skill scoring at one-decimal precision. MIS-RAFT addresses the mismatch between autoregressive token prediction and scalar-valued expert assessment, significantly improving agreement with human ratings. Overall, MIS-Bench reveals a clear gap between general multimodal capability and expert-level interpersonal judgment, while MIS-RAFT offers a promising path toward more reliable model-based assessment.
title: MIS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Psychotherapeutic Interpersonal Skills Assessment
title_translated: MIS-Bench：用于心理治疗人际技能评估的多模态大模型基准测试
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地被用作评估工具，但其在需要专家判断的专业评估任务中的可靠性仍不明确。我们在此背景下研究心理治疗人际技能评估的挑战，并引入MIS-Bench，一个包含996段心理治疗回应视频的多模态人际技能（MIS）基准，涵盖8个促进性人际技能维度。在9个MLLM及多种模态和提示设置下，我们发现当前模型与人类专家仅有适度一致性，多模态输入带来的增益不稳定，基于推理的提示也未能带来明显优势。为弥合这一差距，我们提出MIS-RAFT，一种受RAFT启发并针对小数点精度的人际技能评分进行微调的回归感知方法。MIS-RAFT解决了自回归标记预测与标量型专家评估之间的不匹配问题，显著提升了与人类评分的一致性。总体而言，MIS-Bench揭示了通用多模态能力与专家级人际判断之间的明显差距，而MIS-RAFT为更可靠的模型驱动评估提供了有前景的路径。

summary: This paper presents our system for Track 2 of the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 10 on citation-level faithfulness in AI-assisted scientific reporting. Given an atomic scientific claim and the structured full text of its cited paper, the task requires both a four-way relation label and up to three evidence paragraph identifiers. The label head ensembles a paragraph-aware cross-encoder with a document-level DeBERTa-large classifier, followed by class-wise decision calibration. Probability-level fusion is motivated by an out-of-fold tendency to over-predict Topical Match. The evidence head combines paragraph scores from top-20 and top-30 joint models with BM25 scores. The system runs fully offline without external retrieval or LLM prompting. On the final leaderboard, our system achieved 82.9898 overall (89.5491 Macro-F1 and 76.4305 Joint@3), ranking second in Track 2. Ablations and error analysis show that model complementarity and calibration drive the label gains. Gold-evidence inference changes label Macro-F1 negligibly, whereas evidence ranking remains important for Joint@3.
title: NLPCC 2026 Task 10: Citation-Level Faithfulness Verification with DeBERTa Ensembles and Class-Wise Calibration
comment: Accepted to the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 10 system paper track. Ranked 2nd in Track 2 on the final leaderboard
title_translated: NLPCC 2026 任务10：基于DeBERTa集成与类别校准的引用级忠实度验证
summary_translated: 本文介绍了我们在NLPCC 2026共享任务10第2赛道上的系统，该任务关注AI辅助科学报告中的引用级忠实度。给定一个原子科学主张及其引用论文的结构化全文，任务要求同时输出四类关系标签和最多三个证据段落标识符。标签头采用段落感知交叉编码器与文档级DeBERTa-large分类器的集成，并进行类别级决策校准。概率级融合是出于对交叉验证中过度预测“主题匹配”的倾向的考量。证据头结合了前20和前30联合模型的段落得分与BM25得分。该系统完全离线运行，无需外部检索或LLM提示。在最终排行榜上，我们的系统整体得分为82.9898（Macro-F1为89.5491，Joint@3为76.4305），在第2赛道中排名第二。消融实验与错误分析显示，模型互补性和校准机制推动了标签性能的提升。黄金证据推断对标签Macro-F1影响极小，而证据排序对Joint@3仍至关重要。

summary: The IEEE BigData Cup benchmark combines three prediction problems with different output structures: ordinal suicide-risk classification, multi-label psychosocial factor detection, and extraction of supporting phrases. We introduce heterogeneous readout decomposition (HRD), which separates semantic verification from output realization. A locally deployed Qwen3.8-27B model, adapted with task-specific QLoRA adapters, produces both answer-token margins and layer-63 answer states for card-conditioned queries. HRD compares four latent scores for ordinal risk, retains token margins for most factors while routing seven labels through one shared latent probe, and constructs evidence sets from verbatim span candidates with calibrated, risk-conditional constraints. On two held-out user-grouped confirmation folds, the latent risk readout improves weighted F1 from 0.8237 to 0.8372 and macro F1 from 0.7965 to 0.8185. Selective factor routing improves macro F1 by 0.0105 and tail-label macro F1 by 0.0189; in contrast, global latent replacement and independent label-specific probes fail. The constrained evidence decoder raises pooled phrase F1 from 0.7488 to 0.7609 in row-level out-of-fold evaluation. Lenormand's best public result is 0.8052 on Subtask 1 and 0.6636 on Subtask 2, giving a composite score of 0.7627. These results identify the answer-token boundary, rather than semantic representation alone, as a measurable source of error in this benchmark.
title: Beyond Final-Token Classification: Heterogeneous Readouts for Evidence-Grounded Suicide Risk Detection
comment: Competition paper for the IEEE Big Data Cup 2026. Ranked 2nd among 31 participating teams and invited for submission to IEEE Big Data 2026
title_translated: 超越最终标记分类：用于证据支撑自杀风险检测的异构输出机制
summary_translated: IEEE BigData Cup基准测试结合了三种具有不同输出结构的预测任务：有序自杀风险分类、多标签心理社会因素检测以及支持性短语提取。我们提出了异构输出分解（HRD）方法，将语义验证与输出实现分离。一个本地部署的Qwen3.8-27B模型，通过特定任务的QLoRA适配器进行微调，生成答案标记边界和第63层的答案状态，以响应卡片条件查询。HRD对有序风险进行四种潜在得分比较，保留大多数因素的标记边界，同时将七个标签通过一个共享的潜在探测器进行路由，并基于校准的风险条件约束构建证据集。在两个保留的用户分组验证折中，潜在风险输出使加权F1从0.8237提升至0.8372，宏F1从0.7965提升至0.8185。选择性因素路由使宏F1提升0.0105，尾部标签宏F1提升0.0189；相比之下，全局潜在替换和独立标签特定探测器表现不佳。受约束的证据解码器在行级交叉验证中将合并短语F1从0.7488提升至0.7609。Lenormand的最佳公开结果在子任务1为0.8052，在子任务2为0.6636，综合得分为0.7627。这些结果表明，在该基准测试中，答案标记边界而非仅语义表示，是可度量的误差来源。

summary: Clinical domain classification plays an important role in organizing and analyzing large volumes of unstructured medical text. However, medical transcription datasets are often highly imbalanced, which can substantially degrade classification performance, particularly for underrepresented clinical specialties. In this work, we present a comparative study of machine learning and transformer-based approaches for clinical domain classification from medical transcriptions. We evaluate six traditional machine learning classifiers---Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and XGBoost---along with two pretrained transformer models, BERT and XLNet, and a few-shot large language model prompting approach. Experiments are conducted on medical transcription data collected from MTSamples, comprising 5,013 samples across 40 clinical specialties. To address severe class imbalance, we investigate two balancing strategies: text augmentation using NLP-based synonym replacement and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE). Experimental results demonstrate that data balancing substantially improves classification performance across the evaluated models. In particular, BERT achieves the highest F1-score of 0.996 on the SMOTE-balanced dataset while requiring lower training time than XLNet. The results highlight the effectiveness of transformer-based representations combined with appropriate data balancing strategies for clinical domain classification and provide a systematic comparison of classical machine learning, transformer models, and few-shot prompting for medical transcription analysis.
title: Clinical Domain Classification from Medical Transcriptions
title_translated: 从医学转录文本中进行临床领域分类
summary_translated: 临床领域分类在组织和分析大量非结构化医学文本中起着重要作用。然而，医学转录数据集通常存在严重不平衡问题，这会显著降低分类性能，尤其是对于代表性不足的临床专科。本文对机器学习和基于Transformer的方法在医学转录文本中的临床领域分类进行了对比研究。我们评估了六种传统机器学习分类器——朴素贝叶斯、支持向量机（SVM）、决策树、随机森林、K近邻（KNN）和XGBoost，以及两种预训练Transformer模型BERT和XLNet，还有少量样本大语言模型提示方法。实验基于从MTSamples收集的医学转录数据，涵盖40个临床专科共5,013个样本。为解决严重的类别不平衡问题，我们研究了两种平衡策略：基于NLP的同义词替换文本增强和合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）。实验结果表明，数据平衡显著提升了所有评估模型的分类性能。特别是，BERT在SMOTE平衡数据集上达到最高F1分数0.996，且训练时间低于XLNet。结果突显了基于Transformer的表示与适当的数据平衡策略相结合在临床领域分类中的有效性，并为经典机器学习、Transformer模型和少样本提示方法在医学转录分析中的系统性比较提供了依据。

summary: Online discourse about urban issues - walkability, cycling infrastructure, public transit, housing density, and street safety - is voluminous but unstructured, and existing city-evaluation tools capture none of it. We present a pipeline and conversational system that combines geographic entity resolution, topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over 22,788 chunks of YouTube transcripts and comments spanning 309 North American cities. Beyond the system itself, our contribution is a set of measurements about what happens when standard NLP components meet short, informal, geographically ambiguous text. A Twitter-tuned RoBERTa classifier outperforms a VADER lexicon baseline by 12.6 macro-F1 points (0.589 vs. 0.464; McNemar p = 0.0001), but both models collapse on the neutral class, which dominates urbanist comment traffic; annotators disagree on the same class (Cohen's kappa = 0.53). Dense retrieval beats a TF-IDF baseline at every cutoff (P@5 0.790 vs. 0.560), and video-level relevance proxies understate chunk-level precision by a wide margin (0.660 vs. 0.94 under human rating). For groundedness evaluation, we find BERTScore unusable when a multi-sentence generated summary is compared against a single short comment - scores are nearly flat regardless of relevance - and show that ROUGE-1-based groundedness is a paraphrase-driven lower bound rather than a hallucination rate. These findings generalize beyond the urbanist domain to any RAG system built over short user-generated documents.
title: Analyzing Public Discourse on Urbanism: Topic Clustering, Sentiment Analysis and Retrieval-Augmented Generation using YouTube Comments
title_translated: 分析关于城市主义的公众话语：主题聚类、情感分析与使用YouTube评论的检索增强生成
summary_translated: 关于城市议题——步行友好性、自行车基础设施、公共交通、住房密度和街道安全——的在线讨论内容庞大但非结构化，而现有的城市评估工具未能捕捉其中任何信息。我们提出一个流程和对话系统，结合地理实体解析、主题建模、情感分析以及对22,788段来自309个北美城市的YouTube视频转录和评论的检索增强生成（RAG）。除了系统本身，我们的贡献在于揭示标准NLP组件与简短、非正式、地理模糊文本相遇时的实际表现。经过Twitter调优的RoBERTa分类器相比VADER词典基线提高了12.6个宏F1点（0.589 vs. 0.464；McNemar p = 0.0001），但两者在中性类别上均表现崩溃，该类别在城市主义评论中占主导地位；标注者对该类别的判断也存在分歧（Cohen's kappa = 0.53）。密集检索在每个截断点上均优于TF-IDF基线（P@5 0.790 vs. 0.560），而视频级别相关性代理在块级别精度上严重低估（0.660 vs. 0.94，由人工评分确认）。在真实性评估方面，我们发现当多句生成摘要与单一句子评论对比时，BERTScore几乎无用——无论相关性如何，得分几乎平坦；并证明基于ROUGE-1的真实性评估是一种由改写驱动的下界，而非幻觉率。这些发现可推广至任何基于短用户生成文档构建的RAG系统。

summary: Step-level reasoning evaluators are commonly based on autoregressive language models, whose causal attention restricts each step representation to the problem, previous steps, and the current step. Yet, when the complete solution is available, the validity of an earlier step may become clearer only through its downstream consequences. We validate this hypothesis through a controlled 54-run comparison of causal and bidirectional LLaDA evaluators at 1B--3B scale, changing only the self-attention mask, and find bidirectional attention yields consistent improvements. Building on this finding, we introduce \prm{}, an 8B bidirectional evaluator that reaches 88.8 step-level F1 on MR-MATH-invalid and 83.8 on the out-of-distribution MR-GSM8K original-question subset, outperforming ReasonEval-Llemma-34B by 11.3 and 10.3 F1 points, respectively. \prm{} also remains effective when evaluating incomplete reasoning traces in online settings, outperforming the strongest baselines on both benchmarks by a large margin. We further show that \prm{} provides an effective training-data selection signal, improving Mistral-7B performance on MATH-500.
title: LLaDA-PRM: A Bidirectional Step-Level Reasoning Evaluator
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables, including appendices
title_translated: LLaDA-PRM：一种双向步骤级推理评估器
summary_translated: 步骤级推理评估器通常基于自回归语言模型，其因果注意力机制限制每一步表示仅依赖于问题、先前步骤和当前步骤。然而，当完整解决方案可用时，早期步骤的有效性可能只有通过其下游后果才能更清晰地显现。我们通过控制变量的54次运行对比，在1B–3B规模下比较因果与双向LLaDA评估器，仅改变自注意力掩码，发现双向注意力带来一致的性能提升。基于此发现，我们引入	exttt{PRM}，一个8B的双向评估器，在MR-MATH-invalid上达到88.8的步骤级F1，在分布外的MR-GSM8K原始问题子集上达到83.8，分别优于ReasonEval-Llemma-34B 11.3和10.3 F1点。	exttt{PRM}在在线环境中评估不完整推理轨迹时仍表现出色，大幅超越最强基线。此外，我们还证明	exttt{PRM}能有效提供训练数据选择信号，显著提升Mistral-7B在MATH-500上的表现。

summary: Recently, text-to-speech systems have made significant progress in speech expressiveness and controllability. However, the speaking style of generated speech typically relies on clear user-specified instructions. In natural conversations, speaking style should be naturally inferred from the preceding conversational context. Therefore, we propose COT-TTS, a context-aware, reasoning-based text-to-speech task. Given historical conversation audio, target text, and a reference speech, the system should comprehend the conversational context, infer an explicit intermediate reasoning, and finally synthesize the target speech with the specified timbre. To support this task, we constructed a large-scale bilingual conversational speech dataset comprising 9 million training samples, including a high-quality subset of 1 million samples. We further constructed a source-disjoint benchmark with 800 human-verified samples and established strong task-specific baselines. Additionally, we developed end-to-end autoregressive models with parameter sizes of 0.6B and 1.7B, generating emotion-labeled transcripts, editable speech style inferences, and speech tokens. Experimental results show that the proposed model achieves performance comparable to large-scale baseline systems with significantly fewer parameters. At the same time, the model performs well in terms of duration consistency and emotional consistency, and can generate appropriate emotional, stress, and rhythmic variations based on the conversational context. To facilitate future research, we will publicly release the data construction pipeline, dataset, trained models, and related resources. The demo page and additional resources are available at https://luckybian.github.io/COT-TTS
title: COT-TTS: Audio Context-Aware Text-to-Speech with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
title_translated: COT-TTS：具备思维链推理能力的音频上下文感知语音合成
summary_translated: 近年来，语音合成系统在语音表现力和可控性方面取得了显著进展。然而，生成语音的语调风格通常依赖于明确的用户指令。在自然对话中，语调风格应从先前的对话上下文中自然推断。因此，我们提出COT-TTS，一种上下文感知、基于推理的语音合成任务。给定历史对话音频、目标文本和参考语音，系统需理解对话上下文，推断出明确的中间推理过程，最终合成具有指定音色的目标语音。为支持该任务，我们构建了一个包含900万训练样本的大规模双语对话语音数据集，其中包括100万高质量样本。我们进一步构建了一个源不重叠的基准测试，包含800个人工验证样本，并建立了强任务特定基线。此外，我们开发了参数量分别为0.6B和1.7B的端到端自回归模型，能够生成带情绪标签的转录文本、可编辑的语音风格推断和语音标记。实验结果表明，所提出的模型在参数量显著更少的情况下，性能可媲美大规模基线系统。同时，该模型在持续时间一致性和情感一致性方面表现良好，能够根据对话上下文生成适当的情感、重音和节奏变化。为促进未来研究，我们将公开发布数据构建流程、数据集、训练模型及相关资源。演示页面和附加资源见 https://luckybian.github.io/COT-TTS

summary: Bilingual language models (LMs) offer a controlled setting for studying how training conditions shape second-language (L2) behaviour, but prior work typically varies exposure structure, scale, and architecture at once, making it difficult to attribute effects to any single factor. We introduce Beetle, a controlled language model pretraining framework in which tokeniser, target language, training budget, and exposure structure are each independently manipulable, enabling systematic and comparable experimentation of training conditions. Using Beetle, we train and release 285 bilingual and 45 monolingual open-source LMs with rich checkpoints across a range of exposure schedules, data scales and first languages (L1s) to study multilingual pretraining and computational modelling of bilingualism and second language learning. Evaluating models on human bilingual and second language reading-time prediction and grammaticality judgement tasks, we find that staged and temporally structured curricula consistently improve alignment with language learner reading time compared to balanced bilingual training, with the largest gains at smaller data scales and for typologically closer language pairs. The Beetle models are well suited tools to help move computational psycholinguistics beyond its prevailing monolingual, English-centric focus toward models of human bilingual processing, to study cross-lingual learning dynamics, while supporting community-based development of controlled model families.
title: Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing
comment: Accepted EMNLP Main Conference 2026
title_translated: Beetle：用于建模第二语言处理的双语模型套件
summary_translated: 双语语言模型为研究训练条件如何影响第二语言（L2）行为提供了受控环境，但以往研究通常同时改变暴露结构、规模和架构，难以将效果归因于单一因素。我们提出了Beetle，一个受控的语言模型预训练框架，其中分词器、目标语言、训练预算和暴露结构均可独立调节，从而实现系统化且可比较的训练条件实验。利用Beetle，我们训练并发布了285个双语和45个单语开源语言模型，涵盖多种暴露时间表、数据规模和第一语言（L1），以研究多语言预训练及双语主义与第二语言学习的计算建模。在人类双语者和第二语言阅读时间预测及语法判断任务上评估模型，发现分阶段且具有时间结构的课程设计相较于均衡双语训练能更一致地提升与语言学习者阅读时间的对齐度，尤其在小数据量和语言类型相近的语言对中收益最大。Beetle模型是推动计算心理语言学摆脱其主流的单语化、英语中心化局限的理想工具，有助于研究跨语言学习动态，并支持社区驱动的受控模型家族发展。

summary: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.
title: Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation
comment: 11 pages in body, 36 with appendices. 7 figures. 8 tables
title_translated: 预训练人格混合模型与串联模型用于人类模拟
summary_translated: 本文认为当前大语言模型（LLM）进行人类模拟的主流做法——通过提示指令微调的助手语言模型扮演特定人格角色——存在不准确且产生刻板预测的问题（缺乏自然多样性）。已有研究表明，可通过自然对话文本避免刻板化来绑定LLM的人格特征。本文进一步展示，仅使用特定人物的简短对话样本也可实现有效绑定。人口统计信息可在后期通过简单查询添加，不会带来负面影响。我们称这类校准良好的人类模型为‘人格混合模型’（PMMs），目前以预训练基础模型形式实现。实验表明，PMMs生成的预测比指令微调模型更准确，并保留了更多人类对话中的词汇、语义和语用多样性。我们在涵盖开放域文本、人机聊天及任务导向对话的多样化语料库中衡量了LLM模拟人类对话者的现实感与多样性。然而，基础预训练模型可能生成域外对话，并在长上下文下丢失部分人类内部状态。为此，我们提出并探索了串联模型，即结合预训练模型与指令微调的监督器。实验结果显示，串联模型在整体准确性和多样性方面表现最佳。

summary: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.
title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the AIMS Workshop at COLM 2026
title_translated: 保留重要信息：超越饱和的摘要评估中的语义支架
summary_translated: 摘要广泛应用于各类生产系统，使得模型选择成为常规决策，依赖于摘要质量的度量。现有指标难以胜任：ROUGE仅捕捉表面重叠，而LLM作为评判者得分趋于饱和，无法有效区分模型性能。我们在三个公开数据集、两个专有数据集及多语言场景中均观察到这一饱和现象。为此，我们提出语义支架（Semantic Scaffold）评估框架，从源文本中提取事实、问题和实体属性的层次化表示，并标注为关键点或支持细节，将此结构作为固定参考用于摘要评分。基于该结构，我们推导出三项诊断性指标：事实保留率（FPS）、问题保留率（QPS）和实体保留率（EPS），旨在奖励核心信息的保留，同时惩罚细节过载，并作为可解释的诊断工具，在整体评估轴崩溃时仍保持信息量。最后，我们分析了ROUGE和LLM作为评判者分数的四种常见失效模式，证明基于支架的评估在传统指标失效时依然具有信息价值。

summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.
title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
title_translated: 学生大模型是否继承了分布外鲁棒性？基于不变性的加权蒸馏实现可靠知识迁移
summary_translated: 知识蒸馏（KD）旨在将高性能教师大模型压缩为轻量级学生模型。然而，蒸馏后的学生模型在分布外（OOD）设置下常表现出显著性能下降，这一关键差距尚未得到充分研究。我们识别出导致OOD性能退化的两个叠加机制：（1）数据虚假性：学生可能在蒸馏数据中学到虚假相关性而非真实因果关系；（2）教师能力差异：标准KD对所有样本一视同仁，忽略了教师在特定样本上是依赖因果特征还是被虚假捷径误导。为应对这些挑战，我们提出基于不变性的加权蒸馏（IWD），一种理论基础坚实的框架，通过在多个合成环境中预测不变性来估计教师的因果依赖程度，动态重定训练样本权重。IWD抑制虚假线索，同时保留核心语义，对教师预测保持不变的样本赋予更高蒸馏权重，表明其更依赖因果特征而非虚假特征。理论上，IWD相比标准均匀加权KD降低了学生的虚假-因果（S2C）梯度比，促使学生趋向更具不变性的表征。在四个NLP基准测试（MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER、SST-2）及两种模型族（DeBERTa-v3 和 Qwen-2.5）上的实验表明，IWD在OOD评估中持续优于强基线KD方法，同时保持竞争力的分布内（ID）性能。具体而言，IWD在16个OOD基准中的15个达到最高准确率，在NLI任务上平均OOD性能比标准KD提升4.34个百分点，在QA任务上提升14.94个百分点。

summary: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available
title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
title_translated: 正确诊断，更好反馈：逻辑证明中忠实的大模型辅导反馈的符号验证器
summary_translated: 有效的LLM辅导依赖于在生成反馈前准确识别学生推理中的具体错误。我们在此研究命题逻辑证明辅导中的这一问题，其中学生的行为可依据形式推理规则进行检验。我们引入一种基于验证器的架构，将诊断与语言生成分离。基于600个平衡的学生行为样本，我们比较了零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器和符号验证器。每个诊断由共享的理由和反馈代理处理，以隔离初始诊断的影响。零样本检测器的宏F1为0.191；微调后提升至0.709，但仍存在结构性相关类别间的系统性错误。理由通常忠实保留输入诊断，表明错误诊断可在流程中被准确传递。反馈同样可忠实于其理由，非揭示性且教学恰当，却针对错误的错误。基于验证器的反馈在诊断正确性上表现最佳，专家评分与自动反馈评估结果差异较大。这些发现表明，表面反馈质量可能掩盖上游诊断错误，且忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。我们的代码已公开。

summary: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.
title: Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI

title_translated: 基于留一方言交叉验证与可解释AI的孟加拉地区方言跨方言命名实体识别
summary_translated: 孟加拉语是全球第七大使用语言，具有显著的地区方言多样性，如巴里沙尔、查特格拉姆、锡尔赫特、诺阿卡利和迈明辛等地方言在词汇、形态和句法特征上存在差异。这些变化给命名实体识别（NER）带来了巨大挑战，限制了基于标准孟加拉语或单一地区方言训练模型的泛化能力。本文提出了一种基于公开数据集ANCHOLIK-NER的跨方言孟加拉语NER框架，该数据集包含五个主要孟加拉地区方言的17,405个标注句子和101,817个词元。采用留一方言交叉验证（LODOCV）策略，即在四个方言上训练模型并在剩余未见方言上进行评估。在相同实验设置下评估了八种预训练Transformer模型，包括BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa和Multilingual-E5。Multilingual-E5 Large在每一轮中均取得最高F1分数，Mymensingh方言最高达97.26%，而最具挑战性的Chattogram方言最低为82.38%。为提升可解释性，应用局部可解释模型无关解释（LIME）对词级预测进行分析，结果显示模型决策主要由目标实体词的表面形式驱动，而非周围句子上下文。这些发现建立了跨方言孟加拉语NER的基准，并展示了Transformer迁移学习在低资源地区方言中的有效性，同时指出现有模型对表面形式的依赖是未来研究的重要方向。

summary: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.
title: When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models
title_translated: 余弦相似性在对话模型中无法反映线性可解结构的情形
summary_translated: 余弦相似性广泛用于分析Transformer表示，隐含假设其能反映任务相关结构。本文研究该假设在对话条件下的大型语言模型中何时失效。在三个7-8B参数的聊天调优模型中，环境余弦相似性显著低估了同一隐藏状态上的线性可解人格结构；数值上，线性探测AUC值在0.73-0.97之间，而余弦kNN值仅为0.56-0.77（针对30类任务）。低维监督子空间可恢复大部分差距，而匹配秩的PCA子空间则不能，甚至在某些情况下降低性能。这种不匹配具有依赖性：在单句情感分类（SST-5）中不存在，且通过匹配基数控制排除了属性基数的混淆因素。差距不会随对话轮次系统性增加，任务对齐子空间在时间上保持稳定。然而，三款模型中有两款违反预注册的子空间可分性不变性标准（|Delta AUC| <= 0.03），一款违反预注册的轮次不变性标准（|Delta L| <= 0.05）。结果表明，即使结构是线性可访问的，余弦相似性也可能无法反映对话表示中的任务对齐结构。

summary: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.
title: CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems
comment: Accepted to NLP+CSS 2026
title_translated: CultureMINE：提升NLP系统文化能力的数据集与方法
summary_translated: 近年来，文化自然语言处理（Cultural NLP）领域兴起，大量研究致力于构建全球包容的NLP系统。该领域文献快速增长，难以追踪方法与数据资源的趋势。为此，我们分析了超过375篇论文，回答三个互补问题：（1）当前NLP系统关注哪些文化能力（CCs）？（2）文化数据资源如何构建？（3）采用何种方法提升系统的文化能力？我们讨论了三个问题中的趋势，并识别出相关研究空白。为促进该领域进一步研究，我们发布了一个交互式网页界面，包含全部分析论文列表，并支持研究人员添加自己的工作。我们希望这能推动未来研究，成为文化NLP社区的宝贵资源。

summary: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.
title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
title_translated: 基于语言模型的可个性化可穿戴数据睡眠指导研究
summary_translated: 可穿戴设备数据在睡眠监测方面展现出个人健康管理的潜力，但基于大语言模型（LLM）的摘要与问答仍不足以提供个性化睡眠指导。然而，训练专用模型通常需要昂贵的专家标注。此外，隐私与可访问性问题促使轻量级、本地部署方案以服务终端用户。我们提出一个两阶段框架以应对这些挑战。第一阶段，通过多智能体LLM流水线从无标注可穿戴记录中推理出结构化睡眠指导，实现大规模数据集构建；第二阶段，通过监督微调将指导推理轨迹蒸馏至小型语言模型（SLMs），并集成无需训练的Best-of-$N$选择策略以增强推理能力。实验结果表明，该方法优于商业通用及医疗LLM以及开源模型。人工评估进一步支持生成指导的质量，并验证了使用SLMs实现个性化睡眠指导的可行性。

summary: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of P.Herc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.
title: Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures
title_translated: Apollo Restore：面向古希腊文本填空修复的历史希腊语基础大语言模型
summary_translated: 我们提出Apollo Restore，一个240亿参数的大语言模型，用于修复残缺古希腊文本中的物理缺失部分（lacunae）。该模型基于Mistral Small进行微调，采用填空中间（fill-in-the-middle）目标，能够在无需知晓缺失长度的情况下重建缺失段落。据我们所知，它是首个大规模解码器模型用于历史希腊语，也是首个用于任何古代地中海语言的模型。按照先前研究的评估方式，在最多十个字符的短缺失上，Apollo Restore在文献纸草、文学纸草和石刻缺失中分别将正确修复置于前二十候选中的80.6% / 54.6% / 61.0%，超越最强已发表模型1.6倍/2.6倍/1.4倍。然而，先前评估协议因偏向于极短缺失而夸大得分；在长度平衡度量下，Apollo Restore的优势扩大至2.3倍/3.5倍/1.6倍，并在给出错误长度提示时仍表现稳健。在盲测中，20位专家（纸草学家、铭文学者和哲学家）强烈偏好Apollo Restore胜过最强基线，并在77%的情况下认为其表现至少与人类修复相当。Apollo Restore还改进了P.Herc. 1667的已有解读——这是一份在公元79年维苏威火山喷发中碳化的纸草卷，其数字展开与编辑发生在Apollo Restore训练数据收集之后。Apollo Restore是奥地利科学院主导的“解码古代”计划的成果，旨在为历史语言与手稿构建专用大语言模型。

summary: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at https://vox-infinity.github.io.
title: Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models
title_translated: Vox-Infinity：评估长上下文语音语言模型极限的基准测试
summary_translated: 长上下文理解仍是大语言模型面临的基本挑战，因为过长的输入常常导致模型遗忘关键信息。这一问题在语音领域尤为突出，因为音频作为低压缩模态，需要比文本多得多的嵌入来保留语义内容和声学线索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了首个专门用于评估语音语言模型长上下文理解能力的基准测试——Vox-Infinity。Vox-Infinity从对话轮次数量和每轮持续时间两个维度系统性地扩展音频历史，涵盖多种具有不同互动结构和语义复杂度的代表性场景。关键的是，Vox-Infinity提供了明确的答案来源标注，并按解决每个查询所需的历史上下文量对样本进行组织，从而实现精确且长度感知的评估。对七种代表性语音语言模型的广泛评估揭示了明显的近期效应：当支持答案的信息更接近查询时，模型通常表现更好，但难以检索并使用对话历史中较远位置的信息。案例和数据集可在 https://vox-infinity.github.io 获取。

summary: Understanding contextual causality is critical for large language models (LLMs), as it enables them to accurately identify causal relations in specific situations and support more reliable decision-making. Despite its significance, a systematic exploration of contextual causality with LLMs is still lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive survey on this topic. In this survey, we first propose a taxonomy of contextual causality, consisting of semantic, intervention, and counterfactual causality, and characterize each category by its core causal question, required model capabilities, representative tasks, and practical uses in causality analysis. We then analyze existing studies and discuss their key limitations. Finally, we examine the gaps between current benchmarks and real-world needs and outline promising directions for future research. Our goal is to clarify the research landscape of contextual causality with LLMs, emphasize its importance, and highlight promising future directions.
title: Contextual Causality with Large Language Models: A Survey

title_translated: 大语言模型中的情境因果关系：一项综述
summary_translated: 理解情境因果关系对于大语言模型（LLMs）至关重要，因为它使模型能够准确识别特定情境下的因果关系，并支持更可靠的决策。尽管其重要性显著，但目前仍缺乏对LLMs与情境因果关系系统性探索的研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一项全面的综述。本文首先提出了一个情境因果关系的分类体系，包括语义因果、干预因果和反事实因果三类，并通过其核心因果问题、所需模型能力、代表性任务以及在因果分析中的实际应用对每一类进行了刻画。随后，我们分析了现有研究并讨论了其关键局限性。最后，我们审视了当前基准与真实世界需求之间的差距，并指出了未来研究的有前景方向。我们的目标是厘清LLMs情境因果关系的研究格局，强调其重要性，并突出未来发展的潜力方向。

summary: Debates about whether artificial systems can feel are often forced between two unsatisfactory positions: behavioral equivalence is treated as sufficient for emotion, or phenomenal consciousness is treated as a prerequisite that makes the question empirically inaccessible. This article develops a structural alternative. It models emotions as context-sensitive regions, trajectories and attractor dynamics in high-dimensional representational state spaces. Recent mechanistic interpretability findings support the existence of causally active emotion-concept representations in large language models, but they do not establish subjective feeling or full emotional agency. Assessed against published adequacy standards for representation in language models, intervention provides strong evidence of causal use, while full affective role integration, uniformity across subject domains and coherence remain only partially established; there is no direct analogue of accuracy. These mismatches expose the need for a standard of affective appropriateness, which an account of character must supply. Such an account requires three further conditions: regulatory embodiment that gives valence endogenous stakes, temporal continuity that allows affective episodes to accumulate into a history, and an integrated self-model that binds that history to persistent values. Aristotle's concepts of pathē, hexis, mesotēs and phronēsis are translated into a state-space sketch in which practical wisdom includes competence in estimating normatively salient context, not merely acting on a context description already given. The framework reframes alignment as a problem of durable disposition rather than output conformity, and yields interventional tests with explicit control conditions.
title: Functional Emotion Without Character: Large Language Models, Aristotelian Disposition, and the Limits of Behavioral Alignment
title_translated: 无角色的功能性情感：大语言模型、亚里士多德倾向性与行为对齐的限度
summary_translated: 关于人工系统是否能感受情感的争论往往陷入两种令人不满的立场：一种认为行为等价即足以代表情感，另一种则将现象意识视为先决条件，使该问题在经验上不可探知。本文提出一种结构性替代方案。我们将情感建模为高维表征状态空间中的上下文敏感区域、轨迹和吸引子动力学。近期机制可解释性研究支持大语言模型中存在因果活跃的情感概念表征，但并未确立主观感受或完整的情感代理性。根据已发表的语言模型表征充分性标准评估，干预提供了强有力的因果使用证据，而完全的情感角色整合、跨主体领域的统一性以及连贯性仍仅部分成立；不存在直接对应于准确性的指标。这些不匹配暴露了对情感适当性标准的需求，而这一标准必须由一种角色理论提供。这种理论还需满足三个额外条件：赋予价值内生意义的调节性具身、允许情感事件积累成历史的时间连续性，以及将历史绑定到持久价值观的整合自我模型。亚里士多德的pathē、hexis、mesotēs和phronēsis概念被转化为状态空间草图，在其中实践智慧包含估计规范性相关情境的能力，而不仅仅是基于已有情境描述行动。该框架将对齐重新定义为持久倾向的问题而非输出一致性问题，并生成具有明确控制条件的干预测试。

summary: Lexicon-driven misogyny detectors cannot, by construction, distinguish a slur used against a woman from the same slur mentioned in counter-speech ("don't call her that") -- yet exactly this distinction governs whether moderation protects or silences the people discussing abuse. We study this problem in code-mixed Hinglish and make three contributions.   First, we diagnose two evaluation artifacts on a publicly available redacted corpus: category-encoding anonymization placeholders leak the label (a no-learning rule scores 1.000), and even after they are neutralized misogynistic and benign comments occupy lexically disjoint registers, so bag-of-words reaches macro-F1 approximately 1.00 under random cross-validation but collapses under template-disjoint evaluation.   Second, we release Hinglish-MGY-Diag, a deterministic generator and a 416-item / 163-minimal-pair contrast-set diagnostic across five linguistically motivated categories in which slur presence and gendered register are decorrelated from the label by construction.   Third, we introduce a strict pair-consistency metric that credits a model only when both members of a minimal pair are correctly labelled. Five from-scratch classical baselines evaluated under construction-disjoint five-fold cross-validation reveal that the strongest model reaches 0.93 accuracy on the cleanest use-mention subset but only 0.82 consistency -- it still mislabels roughly one counter-speech pair in five. A frontier LLM used as an author-model ceiling attains 1.000 on all metrics, doubling as independent label validation and confirming the benchmark is a capability gradient rather than an adversarial wall. We release all code, data, the generator, and an arms-length LLM harness for reproducing every number.
title: Used, Mentioned, or Condemned? A Controlled Contrast-Set Diagnostic for the Use-Mention Distinction in Code-Mixed Hinglish Misogyny Detection

title_translated: 被使用、被提及，还是被谴责？一种针对代码混合印地-英语性别歧视检测中用-提区分的受控对比集诊断
summary_translated: 基于词典的性别歧视检测器由于其构造特性，无法区分对女性使用的侮辱性词汇与在反话语中提及同一词汇的情况（如“不要那样称呼她”）——然而正是这一区别决定了内容审核是保护还是压制讨论虐待的人。我们在代码混合的印地-英语语境中研究这一问题，并做出三项贡献。第一，我们在一个公开可用的脱敏语料库上诊断出两种评估偏差：类别编码匿名占位符泄露标签（无学习规则得分达1.000），即使消除后，性别歧视和无害评论仍占据词汇上分离的语域，导致词袋模型在随机交叉验证下达到约1.00的宏F1，但在模板无关评估下崩溃。第二，我们发布了Hinglish-MGY-Diag，一个确定性生成器及一个416项/163个最小对的对比集诊断，涵盖五个语言学动机类别，其中侮辱性词汇的存在与性别化语域在构造上与标签解耦。第三，我们引入了一种严格的配对一致性度量，仅当最小对中的两个成员均被正确标注时才给予模型加分。五种从零开始的经典基线在构造无关五折交叉验证下评估显示，最强模型在最干净的用-提子集上达到0.93准确率，但一致性仅为0.82——仍会错误标注约五分之一的反话语对。以前沿大模型作为作者模型上限时，所有指标均达1.000，同时作为独立标签验证，确认该基准是一个能力梯度而非对抗壁垒。我们发布了所有代码、数据、生成器及独立的LLM工具链，以复现所有结果。

summary: Context layers, curated documentation that an analytics agent fetches at query time, produce large accuracy gains on text-to-SQL benchmarks. A with/without comparison cannot say which part of the layer does the work: the semantic content, the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it, or the pre-computed views that usually accompany it. We report a four-arm ablation on DABStep on four models that separates the three. The instrument is a data contract: a YAML artifact that carries a domain's semantics and the rules an agent's tools enforce. One arm empties every field of prose in the frozen contract while holding the tool surface, retrieval instruction, table allow-list and operation rules byte-for-byte fixed. Compiling the contract's own SQL expressions into views gives the ceiling a pre-computed layer would reach: gold on all 176 tasks it covers. Content dominates. It raises hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, beating the same knowledge pasted into the prompt on every model. Scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models. Against the compiled ceiling the contract arm's shortfall is a failure to derive, and it falls from 39 points to 5 with model capability. The contract beats the prompt because the rule it needs is one lookup away rather than buried in a long prompt: its SQL carries the fee semantics up to 98% of the time against the prompt arm's 4%, and at the lowest cost per correct answer on three of four models. For practitioners: semantics first, scaffolding second, pre-computed macros only where an agent demonstrably fails to derive. Ungoverned arms submitted 166 mutating statements; governed arms none. The gain is confined to the contract's domain. On one model the benchmark's own withheld golds grade the contract arm at 51.9% against 18.8% for the prompt baseline.
title: Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents
title_translated: 上下文层中哪一部分在起作用？在文本到SQL智能体中分离语义内容与检索支撑
summary_translated: 上下文层（即分析智能体在查询时获取的整理文档）在文本到SQL基准测试中带来了显著的准确率提升。然而，有无对比实验无法判断是语义内容、提供内容的检索支撑，还是通常伴随的预计算视图在起作用。我们在DABStep上对四种模型进行了四臂消融实验，实现了三者的分离。实验工具是一个数据契约：一个YAML文件，包含领域语义和智能体工具所强制执行的规则。其中一个分支将冻结契约中的所有文字字段清空，同时保持工具界面、检索指令、表白名单和操作规则字节不变。将契约自身的SQL表达式编译为视图，达到了预计算层应有的上限：在覆盖的176个任务中全部为黄金标准。结果显示，语义内容起主导作用：它将高难度任务准确率从13.9%提升至55.1%，22.6%升至56.6%，22.9%升至68.4%，37.0%升至77.4%，在所有模型上均优于将相同知识粘贴到提示中的方法。无内容的支撑仅在两个快速模型上带来0至5分增益，在两个前沿模型上带来14至15分增益。与编译后的上限相比，契约分支的不足在于无法推导，且随着模型能力下降，得分从39分降至5分。契约优于提示的原因在于其所需规则只需一次查找，而非深埋于长提示中：其SQL在98%的情况下携带费用语义，而提示分支仅为4%，且在四个模型中的三个上单位正确答案成本最低。对实践者建议：优先语义，其次支撑，仅在智能体明显无法推导时才使用预计算宏。未受管控的分支提交了166条变异语句；受管控的分支则一条未提交。收益局限于契约所属领域。在一个模型上，基准自身保留的黄金标准将契约分支评分定为51.9%，而提示基线仅为18.8%。

summary: Effective workplace negotiation requires balancing multiple objectives, including achieving task goals, preserving professional relationships, and resolving conflicts constructively. However, misunderstandings, misaligned preferences, and interpersonal friction often impede successful outcomes. Politeness mitigates these challenges by fostering trust, reducing tension, and preventing escalation, and persuasive communication helps overcome resistance, align preferences, and guide participants toward mutually beneficial agreements.
