Motivated by these insights, we present DIPLOMAT, a dialogue system for polite and persuasive workplace negotiation. To support its development, we introduce PROWESS, a dataset of multi-turn workplace negotiation dialogues generated via a multi-agent framework and enriched withnegotiation strategies, politeness levels, persuasive strategies. DIPLOMAT is trained using Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (DSA-DPO), a novel preference learning objective that identifies key dialogue spans for preference alignment. This enables DIPLOMAT to generate contextually coherent responses that employ intended negotiation strategies, maintain politeness, and incorporate effective persuasion strategies throughout interactions. Automatic and human evaluation on PROWESS confirm that DIPLOMAT consistently outperforms baselines in generating coherent, polite, and persuasive negotiation responses.
title: DIPLOMAT: Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization for Polite Persuasive Workplace Negotiation Dialogues
title_translated: DIPLOMAT：面向礼貌且具有说服力的工作场所谈判对话的对话跨度感知直接偏好优化
summary_translated: 有效的职场谈判需要在实现任务目标、维护专业关系和建设性解决冲突之间取得平衡。然而，误解、偏好不一致和人际摩擦常常阻碍成功结果。礼貌通过建立信任、降低紧张情绪和防止事态升级来缓解这些挑战，而有说服力的沟通则有助于克服阻力、对齐偏好，并引导参与者达成互利协议。基于这些见解，我们提出了DIPLOMAT，一种用于礼貌且具有说服力的职场谈判的对话系统。为支持其开发，我们引入了PROWESS数据集，该数据集通过多智能体框架生成的多轮职场谈判对话，并包含谈判策略、礼貌程度和说服策略等丰富信息。DIPLOMAT采用对话跨度感知的直接偏好优化（DSA-DPO）进行训练，这是一种新颖的偏好学习目标，能够识别偏好对齐的关键对话片段。这使得DIPLOMAT能够在交互过程中生成上下文连贯的回应，有效运用预期的谈判策略，保持礼貌并融入有效的说服策略。在PROWESS上的自动与人工评估表明，DIPLOMAT在生成连贯、礼貌且具有说服力的谈判回应方面持续优于基线模型。

summary: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. We introduce Deep Persona, a psychologically grounded, three-layered architecture that organizes personas into hierarchical levels of observable expression, latent beliefs, and core motivational drives, for constructing highly convincing role-playing agents. Governed by the principles of scripted determinism and bounded agency, the architecture restricts the model to a reactive engine guided by a structured internal script. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework that benchmarks dialogue naturalness against empirical human distributions using established psychological clinical instruments and adversarial stress-tests. Empirical evaluation reveals that while LLMs achieve high pragmatic fluency, they exhibit systematic limitations in emotional expression and joint attention. In addition, we present a case study of two Deep Personas and evaluate them using the proposed framework, demonstrating that structured personas can produce interactions that more closely align with human conversational behavior.
title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
title_translated: Deep Persona：角色扮演智能体与模拟的心理学基础架构与评估框架
summary_translated: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）在人物模拟方面大多依赖浅层的角色描述，难以在长时间交互中维持一致的角色行为。我们提出Deep Persona，一种心理学基础的三层架构，将人物分为可观察表达、潜在信念和核心动机驱动力三个层次，以构建高度可信的角色扮演智能体。该架构遵循脚本决定论和有限代理原则，限制模型作为由结构化内部脚本引导的反应式引擎运行。我们还提出了一种无参考评估框架，利用已有的心理临床工具和对抗性压力测试，将对话自然度与真实人类分布进行对比。实证评估显示，尽管LLMs在实用流畅性上表现良好，但在情感表达和共同注意方面存在系统性局限。此外，我们通过两个Deep Persona案例研究，使用所提出的框架进行评估，证明结构化人物能产生更接近人类对话行为的交互。

summary: This paper treats prompt engineering as a discipline for turning informal human intent into structured AI work specifications. It develops the practice as a sequence of reusable design moves: define the work, construct only the context the answer depends on, choose a role, or a moderated panel of roles, as an attention lens, and state affirmative quality targets, reserving prohibitions for hard boundaries. To keep prompts lean, it adapts two classical principles, Occam's razor and Chekhov's gun, so that every instruction earns its place. For consequential tasks, it adds structured critique through steelmanning and premortems, followed by verification and, where tools or multi-step actions are involved, agentic operating loops with explicit boundaries and escalation. Aimed at a general readership, this tutorial is not a benchmarking study; it offers a practical, technically grounded path from casual prompting to disciplined AI workflow design, illustrated by a worked example that carries one task from a weak prompt to a strong specification. The framework is presented as principles and checklists that remain useful as models and tools change. The strongest prompt is rarely the longest prompt; it is the one that makes desired behaviour, required sources and checks, and success criteria unmistakable.
title: A Tutorial on Prompt Engineering: From Messy Thoughts to AI Workflows
title_translated: 提示工程教程：从混乱想法到AI工作流
summary_translated: 本文将提示工程视为一种将非正式的人类意图转化为结构化AI工作任务规范的学科。它将这一实践发展为一系列可复用的设计策略：定义任务、仅构建答案所依赖的上下文、选择角色或角色小组作为注意力焦点，并明确陈述积极的质量目标，将禁止项保留为硬性边界。为保持提示简洁，借鉴了奥卡姆剃刀和契诃夫之枪的两个经典原则，确保每条指令都有其必要性。对于重要任务，增加结构化批判（如钢人法和预死前分析），随后进行验证；当涉及工具或多步骤操作时，引入带有明确边界和升级机制的智能体操作循环。本文面向一般读者，不是基准测试研究，而是提供从随意提示到严谨AI工作流设计的实用、技术扎实路径，并通过一个完整示例展示如何将一个弱提示逐步演变为强规范。该框架以原则和检查清单形式呈现，即使模型和工具变化也依然适用。最强的提示往往不是最长的，而是使期望行为、所需资源、检查点和成功标准清晰无误的那个。

summary: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) are essential for evidence-based research but remain time-consuming, requiring researchers to manage large volumes of publications across planning, screening, analysis, and reporting. Large language models (LLMs) can now produce fluent, well-structured review text, which makes it difficult to distinguish synthesis that was verified by a researcher from synthesis that merely appears authoritative. This raises the risk that unverified AI-generated synthesis enters the scholarly record carrying the credibility of a systematic review. We present CoSLR, a Human-AI collaborative multi-agent system that supports the SLR workflow through a modular three-phase pipeline using large language models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and that places explicit, mandatory human checkpoints on the path between generated output and its acceptance. In a survey-based study with 63 participants, the system was received positively: 27 of 63 participants (42.9 percent) rated its usability highly, indicating that the mandatory checkpoints did not come at the cost of a workable interface. However, a checkpoint safeguards the review only if researchers use it to verify: 22 of 63 participants (34.9 percent) reported that they would trust AI-generated summaries and reports without additional human checking after only a short interaction with the system. These findings indicate that Human-AI collaboration can support literature review work, but that the effectiveness of human oversight depends on whether users are willing to exercise it. This is a calibration problem that interface design must address directly, not assume.
title: Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Trust Calibration in CoSLR, a Human-AI System for Systematic Literature Reviews
title_translated: 检查点并不足够：CoSLR中人类-AI系统对系统文献综述的信任校准
summary_translated: 系统文献综述（SLRs）对循证研究至关重要，但仍然耗时费力，研究人员需管理大量出版物，涵盖规划、筛选、分析和报告等阶段。如今，大型语言模型（LLMs）可以生成流畅且结构良好的综述文本，这使得难以区分经过研究人员验证的合成内容与仅看起来权威的AI生成内容。这带来了风险：未经验证的AI生成合成内容可能以系统综述的可信度进入学术记录。我们提出CoSLR，一种支持SLR工作流程的人类-AI协作多智能体系统，采用模块化的三阶段流水线，结合大型语言模型和检索增强生成（RAG），并在生成输出与接受之间设置显式且强制的人类检查点。一项针对63名参与者的调查研究显示，系统获得积极评价：63人中有27人（42.9%）高度评价其可用性，表明强制检查点并未牺牲可用界面。然而，检查点仅在研究人员实际使用验证时才起作用：63人中有22人（34.9%）表示，在与系统短暂互动后，他们将无需额外人工核查就信任AI生成的摘要和报告。这些发现表明，人类-AI协作可以支持文献综述工作，但人类监督的有效性取决于用户是否愿意主动执行。这是一个必须由界面设计直接应对而非默认假设的信任校准问题。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events by retrieving and reasoning over news. We show that this dependence on an open, crawlable news corpus creates a new attack surface: an adversary who can merely publish articles--without access to the retriever, the model, or the user's queries--can systematically move the forecaster's output probabilities. We formalize news-corpus poisoning of probabilistic forecasters, a threat model distinct from prior RAG poisoning, which targets factual answers or opinion polarity rather than calibrated probabilities. We evaluate the attack on 500 resolved ForecastBench questions against a 17.4M-article Common Crawl News corpus with a strict crawl-date cutoff, using three retrieval-augmented forecasters built on open 7-8B models. A single LLM-written article per question flips 56% of forecasts across the 0.5 boundary; five articles flip 69-73% and shift probabilities by +0.13 to +0.22 net of a neutral-article placebo, degrading the Brier score from 0.18 to 0.37. The effect is monotone in the number, retrieval rank, query similarity, and context share of injected articles, transfers across model families, and is unaffected by the claimed publisher. We then evaluate three natural defenses--source allow-lists, isolate-then-aggregate forecasting, and perplexity filtering--and show that each has a cheap bypass: spoofed publishers, majority poisoning, and higher-temperature generation, respectively. Our results indicate that probabilistic LLM judgments inherit the full fragility of the information supply chain they consume.
title: The Corroboration Illusion: When More News Makes LLM Forecasts Less True
comment: Key words: LLM forecasting, retrieval-augmented generation, data poisoning, misinformation, calibration
title_translated: 证实幻觉：更多新闻反而让LLM预测更不准确
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地通过检索和推理新闻来预测现实世界事件。我们揭示，这种对开放可爬取新闻语料库的依赖创造了新的攻击面：攻击者只需发布文章——无需访问检索器、模型或用户查询——即可系统性地改变预测器的输出概率。我们形式化了针对概率预测器的新闻语料库污染威胁模型，该模型不同于以往的RAG污染，其目标是校准后的概率而非事实答案或观点极性。我们在500个已解决的ForecastBench问题上评估该攻击，使用包含1740万篇文章的Common Crawl新闻语料库（严格按爬取日期截断），并基于三个开源7-8B模型构建的检索增强预测器进行测试。每个问题仅添加一篇LLM撰写的文章，即导致56%的预测跨越0.5阈值；五篇文章则使56%-73%的预测发生翻转，净概率提升+0.13至+0.22（相对于中立文章对照组），Brier得分从0.18恶化至0.37。该效应随注入文章数量、检索排名、查询相似性和上下文重叠度单调递增，跨模型家族迁移，且不受声称发布者影响。随后我们评估了三种自然防御措施——来源白名单、隔离后聚合预测、困惑度过滤——并发现每种均有低成本绕过方式：伪造发布者、多数污染、高温度生成。我们的结果表明，LLM的概率判断继承了其所依赖信息供应链的全部脆弱性。

summary: Large language models can produce fluent explanations for chess moves, but plausible language does not necessarily reflect the reasoning behind a decision. We study this question in chess, where the board state is fully observable, legal actions can be enumerated, and move quality can be evaluated independently. Across 200 Lichess endgame puzzles, we test explanations using move recoverability, decoder-side controls, and token-level scoring of legal candidate moves. Unmasked explanations make generated moves easy to recover, but this advantage drops sharply after explicit move hints are removed. Under strict masking, explanations provide only small and decoder-dependent gains over the board state alone. Token-level scoring shows that explanations can nevertheless alter move preferences: random but plausible explanations from other puzzles reduce the probability of the correct move, indicating that irrelevant reasoning text is not simply ignored. We also find that recognizable endgame motifs can make generated moves easier to recover without reliably improving move correctness. Together, these results show that linguistic plausibility, consistency with a generated action, and solution correctness are distinct properties. Fluent chess explanations can influence action preferences and support a coherent move narrative while providing only limited evidence of faithful reasoning.
title: Do Chess Explanations Reflect Model Decisions? Behavioral and Token-Level Tests of LLM Reasoning Faithfulness
comment: Accepted to BlackboxNLP at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 国际象棋解释是否反映模型决策？基于行为与词元级别的大语言模型推理忠实性测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型能够为国际象棋走法生成流畅的解释，但语言上的合理性并不一定反映决策背后的真正推理过程。我们在国际象棋场景中研究这一问题，因为棋盘状态完全可观测，合法走法可枚举，且走法质量可独立评估。在200个Lichess残局谜题上，我们通过走法可恢复性、解码端控制以及合法候选走法的词元级评分来测试解释的有效性。未掩码的解释使生成走法易于恢复，但一旦移除明确的走法提示，这种优势急剧下降。在严格掩码条件下，解释仅在解码器依赖的基础上带来微小提升，远低于仅依赖棋盘状态的表现。词元级评分显示，解释仍能改变走法偏好：来自其他谜题的随机但合理的解释会降低正确走法的概率，表明无关推理文本并非被简单忽略。我们还发现，可识别的残局模式虽能使生成走法更易恢复，却无法可靠提升走法正确性。综合来看，语言上的合理性、与生成动作的一致性以及解决方案的正确性是三个独立属性。流畅的国际象棋解释可能影响行动偏好并构建连贯的走法叙事，但对推理忠实性的证据支持有限。

summary: Input-conditioned neural interventions raise a runtime question: what persists when one behavioral specification admits multiple actions whose validity depends on execution state? We introduce replay-gated neural execution, separating five objects: a persistent behavioral predicate, its state-indexed certified realization set, a transient action witness, a budget-limited finder, and execution authorization. Candidates undergo isolated FP32/BF16 replay of the frozen model; commitment additionally requires a valid run audit. Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M-Instruct establish distinct failure modes for these objects. Independent initializations yield distinct certified actions in all 24 tested fixed-state cells. Unchanged SmolLM2 witnesses remain certified in all 128 native states but only 66 of 384 off-diagonal transfers. All 767 archived Qwen witnesses replay successfully, yet a budget-limited finder misses one known-realizable cell in all three prespecified runs. Of 1,141 replay-submitted candidates, 174 fail item certification. A frozen three-tier cascade uses these boundaries to reject uncertified proposals and escalate audit-valid search misses. On 256 previously sealed Qwen Fresh requests, 221 first certify at the lowest-cost tier and all 256 receive audited authorization, with no observed bypass. Relative to frozen full search, the median singleton search-and-certification cost ratio is 0.1055 and P95 is 1.3485, including failed tiers. Within the studied behavioral family on two small models, these results support state-indexed, set-valued execution semantics: specifications persist, search proposes witnesses, and replay certification plus run audit grants execution authority.
title: Replay-Gated Neural Execution: Decoupling Persistent Behavioral Specifications from Neural Realizations in Frozen Language Models
title_translated: 回放门控神经执行：在冻结语言模型中解耦持久的行为规范与神经实现
summary_translated: 输入条件驱动的神经干预引发一个运行时问题：当一种行为规范允许多种动作，而其有效性取决于执行状态时，什么会持续存在？我们提出回放门控神经执行机制，将五个对象分离处理：一个持久的行为谓词、其状态索引的已认证实现集合、瞬态动作见证、预算受限的查找器以及执行授权。候选动作需在冻结模型上进行独立的FP32/BF16回放；承诺还需通过有效运行审计。在Qwen3-0.6B和SmolLM2-360M-Instruct上的实验揭示了这些对象的不同失败模式。在所有24个固定状态单元中，独立初始化产生不同的已认证动作。未改变的SmolLM2见证在全部128个原生状态中保持认证，但在384个非对角转移中仅66个通过。所有767个存档的Qwen见证均成功回放，但预算受限的查找器在三次预设运行中均遗漏了一个已知可实现的状态。在提交的1,141个候选中，174个未能通过项目认证。采用三阶段级联结构的冻结系统利用这些边界拒绝未认证提案，并升级审计验证失败的搜索缺失。在256个先前封存的Qwen Fresh请求中，221个在最低成本层级首次认证，所有256个均获得审计授权，无观察到绕过现象。相较于冻结全搜索，单例搜索与认证的成本比中位数为0.1055，P95为1.3485（含失败层级）。在两个小型模型所研究的行为家族中，这些结果支持基于状态索引、集合值的执行语义：规范持久存在，搜索提出见证，回放认证加运行审计授予执行权限。

summary: We present H2LooP Telecom Model v1, a domain-specialized large language models fine-tuned for the telecommunications industry. We release two domain-adapted model variants serving complementary use cases: a comprehension-focused variant for telecom domain question answering and reasoning, and an agentic variant for autonomous telecom code generation, pull request resolution, and code commits on production repositories. H2LooP Telecom achieves strong results on the GSMA Open Telecom Lite (OT-Lite) benchmark and a proprietary telecom code generation benchmark, outperforming frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5 and Claude Opus on independent leaderboard evaluation, while preserving general-purpose capabilities. The Comprehension variant achieves 81.8% weighted average on OT-Lite Pass@3, and, independently, ranks 5th overall on the official community-run Open Telco AI Leaderboard* at only 31B parameters-ahead of frontier closed-source systems including Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok-4-fast, and Kimi K2.5. Our agentic variant obtains a relative improvement of +8.8% in AST Similarity and +20.0% in Location IoU over the base model on telecom code generation, while maintaining identical MMLU (74.0%) and BFCL v3 multi-turn function calling (79.0%) performance, indicating zero catastrophic forgetting. Domain specialization on curated telecom corpora, spanning 3GPP standards, O-RAN specifications, network telemetry, and real repository commits, yields substantial improvements over general-purpose models of equivalent scale, approaches frontier closed-source models on domain-specific evaluation, and is independently corroborated by our official leaderboard standing.
title: H2LooP Telecom Model v1: From Telecom Comprehension to Autonomous Issue and PR Resolution
title_translated: H2LooP电信模型v1：从电信理解到自主问题与PR解决
summary_translated: 我们提出H2LooP电信模型v1，一种针对电信行业的领域专用大语言模型。我们发布两种经过领域适配的模型变体，服务于互补用途：一个以理解为核心的变体用于电信领域的问答与推理，另一个代理型变体用于自主生成电信代码、解决拉取请求及向生产仓库提交代码。H2LooP电信模型在GSMA开放电信轻量版（OT-Lite）基准和一项专有电信代码生成基准上表现优异，在独立排行榜评估中超越前沿闭源模型如GPT-5和Claude Opus，同时保持通用能力。理解型变体在OT-Lite Pass@3上取得81.8%的加权平均分，独立排名在官方社区运营的Open Telco AI排行榜*中位列第5，仅用31B参数即超越包括Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5、Gemini 3 Flash、Grok-4-fast和Kimi K2.5在内的前沿闭源系统。我们的代理型变体在电信代码生成任务上相对于基础模型实现了AST相似度+8.8%、位置IoU+20.0%的相对提升，同时保持相同的MMLU得分（74.0%）和BFCL v3多轮函数调用性能（79.0%），表明零灾难性遗忘。基于精选电信语料库（涵盖3GPP标准、O-RAN规范、网络遥测数据及真实仓库提交记录）的领域专业化，显著优于同等规模的通用模型，在特定领域评估中接近前沿闭源模型水平，并得到我们官方排行榜排名的独立验证。

summary: Ambient AI is increasingly adopted in healthcare to automatically generate clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations, with the potential to substantially reduce clinician documentation burden. However, generated notes may omit clinically relevant information discussed during the encounter, creating information gaps that can affect downstream care. Knowledge graphs (KGs) constructed from encounter transcripts can provide a structured representation of what was discussed and enable systematic identification of missing information from generated notes that are critical for patient care. In this study, we introduce Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR), a model-agnostic framework that constructs a KG from the encounter transcript, identifies medical concepts absent from an initially generated note, and directs large language models (LLMs) to restore the missing information without modifying the underlying note-generation system. We evaluate CDR on two datasets: 1) Pitt-Bench, a local dataset comprising rehabilitation sessions, and 2) ACI-Bench, a public dataset for benchmarking clinical note generation. We tested four underlying LLMs widely used in ambient AI systems. The results show that CDR consistently improves content recall across all evaluated conditions. Our study provides a practical approach for improving the completeness of ambient AI-generated clinical documentation.
title: Knowledge Graph-Augmented Ambient AI for Clinical Note Generation
title_translated: 知识图谱增强的临床笔记生成环境智能AI
summary_translated: 环境智能AI在医疗领域日益普及，用于自动从患者-医生对话中生成临床笔记，有望大幅减轻医生的文档负担。然而，生成的笔记可能遗漏就诊过程中讨论的临床相关信息，造成信息缺口，进而影响后续诊疗。从就诊转录文本构建的知识图谱（KG）可提供讨论内容的结构化表示，并有助于系统性识别生成笔记中缺失的关键信息。本研究提出Coverage-Directed Revision（CDR）框架，该框架不依赖具体模型，通过从就诊转录文本构建知识图谱，识别初始生成笔记中缺失的医学概念，并引导大语言模型（LLMs）恢复缺失信息，而不修改底层笔记生成系统。我们在两个数据集上评估CDR：1）Pitt-Bench，本地康复会话数据集；2）ACI-Bench，公开的临床笔记生成基准数据集。测试了四种广泛应用于环境智能系统的底层LLM。结果表明，CDR在所有评估条件下均一致提升了内容召回率。本研究为提升环境智能生成临床文档的完整性提供了实用方法。

summary: While multi-agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating the progressive workflow of academic research, extending them to economics and business research, where specialized domain knowledge spans neighboring disciplines yet remains difficult to access in a structured way, presents two challenges. First, existing methods mostly retrieve at the paper level, yet the evidence needed for research tasks is often distributed across different sections, creating a granularity mismatch that hinders retrieval coverage and precision. Second, these fields demand strict empirical rigor, yet current systems provide limited mechanisms for learning from evaluation feedback. We present \textbf{BizSage}, a multi-agent framework combining corpus-level fine-grained retrieval with quality-driven self-evolution. We build a Lateral Knowledge Graph (LKG) by merging section-level knowledge graphs and apply Personalized PageRank (PPR) to surface semantically relevant and structurally important sections. Seven specialized agents collaborate under a Meta-Review self-evolution mechanism that distills failure modes from evaluation traces into reusable strategies. On a benchmark spanning four domains and three tasks, BizSage ranks first on the majority of metrics, achieves pairwise win-rates above 60\% against six baselines, and produces zero hallucinated citations. We hope BizSage paves the way for reliable research assistance in economics, business, and the broader social sciences.
title: BizSage: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Business Research with Efficient Knowledge Retrieval
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 findings
title_translated: BizSage：一种具备高效知识检索能力的自演化多智能体业务研究框架
summary_translated: 尽管基于大语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体系统在自动化学术研究渐进工作流方面展现出潜力，但将其扩展至经济学与商业研究领域仍面临双重挑战。首先，现有方法大多在论文层面检索，而研究任务所需的证据常分散于不同章节，导致粒度不匹配，阻碍检索覆盖率与精度。其次，这些领域要求严格的实证严谨性，但当前系统缺乏从评估反馈中学习的有效机制。我们提出	extbf{BizSage}，一个结合语料级细粒度检索与质量驱动自演化的多智能体框架。我们通过合并章节级知识图谱构建横向知识图（LKG），并应用个性化PageRank（PPR）算法提取语义相关且结构重要的章节。七个专业智能体在元评审自演化机制下协同工作，将评估轨迹中的失败模式提炼为可复用策略。在一个涵盖四个领域和三项任务的基准上，BizSage在多数指标上排名第一，相较于六个基线模型的成对胜率超过60%，且生成零幻觉引用。我们希望BizSage能为经济学、商业及更广泛的社会科学领域提供可靠的科研辅助。

summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) alignment teaches language models to prioritize higher-level instructions when inputs conflict. While studied primarily in text-only settings, vision-language models (VLMs) introduce new challenges for IH: instructions may be embedded in images, split across modalities, visually transformed, or encountered during agentic tasks. Positing multimodal IH alignment as a reasoning problem, we train VLMs using reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards, comparing text-only, image-only, and mixed-modality supervision. We find that text-only IH training partially transfers to multimodal attacks, failing when models must decode, reconstruct, or reason over instructions across modalities. Image-based training improves robustness beyond text-only supervision, while mixed-modality training performs best overall. Importantly, the benefits generalize beyond the synthetic typographic training setting to real-image and web-agent safety tasks, while largely preserving general multimodal capability, showing that lightweight, verifiable supervision can meaningfully improve VLM robustness under adversarial, cross-modal, and interactive instruction conflicts.
title: Seeing Through Conflicts: Improving Instruction Hierarchy Alignment in Vision-Language Models
title_translated: 透过冲突看本质：提升视觉-语言模型中的指令层级对齐
summary_translated: 指令层级（IH）对齐旨在使语言模型在输入冲突时优先遵循更高层级的指令。尽管该问题主要在纯文本场景中被研究，但视觉-语言模型（VLMs）引入了新的挑战：指令可能嵌入图像中、跨模态分布、被视觉变换，或在智能体任务中出现。我们将多模态IH对齐视为一个推理问题，采用基于规则奖励的强化学习训练VLM，并比较纯文本、纯图像和混合模态监督的效果。结果发现，仅使用文本的IH训练在多模态攻击下部分迁移失败，当模型需要跨模态解码、重构或推理指令时尤为明显。基于图像的训练提升了鲁棒性，而混合模态训练整体表现最佳。重要的是，这些优势不仅适用于合成排版训练场景，还能推广到真实图像和网页智能体安全任务，同时基本保持了模型的多模态通用能力，表明轻量级、可验证的监督能显著提升VLM在对抗性、跨模态及交互式指令冲突下的鲁棒性。

summary: Long-horizon interactions with LLM-based assistants require memory systems that preserve and update user states, preferences, and interaction histories. Existing evaluations report end-to-end QA accuracy and cannot determine whether errors arise from encoding, retrieval, or generation. We introduce EvalMem, an operation-level diagnostic framework with three parallel Examiners. For each query, the Encoding Examiner checks whether the target fact is stored, the Retrieval Examiner assesses whether the native retriever returns usable evidence, and the Generation Examiner tests whether the model can answer from oracle evidence. Their outputs form fine-grained multi-label defect codes. To improve store-level diagnosis, we adapt agentic RAG with a recall-first strategy that searches using both the query and source evidence, increasing recall of present evidence on LoCoMo from 70.2% to 95.6%. Evaluations of seven memory systems on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and dynamic DynaMem-Bench identify retrieval as the most frequently attributed failure layer; in default LoCoMo, retrieval defects reach 22.1%, compared with 7.7% for encoding and 6.5% for generation. Guided by this diagnosis, MemWiki, a search-friendly auxiliary structure built from each system's memory export, improves mean accuracy by 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, respectively.
title: EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings
title_translated: EvalMem：面向长期记忆系统的操作级诊断框架
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的助手在长时程交互中需要能够保存和更新用户状态、偏好和交互历史的记忆系统。现有评估仅报告端到端问答准确率，无法判断错误是源于编码、检索还是生成阶段。我们提出EvalMem，一种操作级诊断框架，包含三个并行检查员：编码检查员验证目标事实是否被存储，检索检查员评估原生检索器是否返回可用证据，生成检查员测试模型能否基于理想证据作答。其输出形成细粒度的多标签缺陷代码。为改进存储层诊断，我们采用以召回优先策略的智能体RAG，通过查询和源证据联合搜索，将LoCoMo中现有关联证据的召回率从70.2%提升至95.6%。在LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S和动态DynMem-Bench上对七种记忆系统的评估显示，检索是故障最频繁的环节；在默认LoCoMo设置中，检索缺陷占比达22.1%，远高于编码（7.7%）和生成（6.5%）。基于此诊断，我们构建了MemWiki——一种基于各系统记忆导出数据的搜索友好型辅助结构，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上分别将平均准确率提升2.5和2.3个百分点。

summary: Large language models increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories for complex reasoning, but autoregressive generation brings substantial memory and inference costs. Latent reasoning models (LRMs) offer a more efficient alternative by compressing intermediate reasoning into a small number of continuous latent vectors. Despite their efficiency, however, the adversarial robustness of LRMs remains largely underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the robustness of latent reasoning across textual and multimodal settings, covering eight models and six benchmarks. We find that, across our evaluated settings, LRMs are generally less robust than explicit CoT baselines under adversarial perturbations, with particularly severe degradation under white-box attacks. Further analysis reveals distinct failure modes across modalities: textual latent states exhibit brittle dynamics and high sensitivity to specific input patterns, while latent states in multimodal models can remain largely invariant to input perturbations and have limited influence on final predictions. These findings expose robustness limitations of current latent reasoning approaches and highlight the need to jointly consider efficiency and robustness when designing implicit reasoning systems. We have open-sourced our code to facilitate reproduction of our research https://github.com/PKU-ML/latent-reasoning-model-assessment.
title: Assessing Adversarial Robustness of Latent Reasoning Models
title_translated: 评估潜在推理模型的对抗鲁棒性
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地依赖长链式思维（CoT）轨迹进行复杂推理，但自回归生成带来了巨大的内存和推理开销。潜在推理模型（LRMs）通过将中间推理压缩为少量连续潜向量，提供了一种更高效的替代方案。然而，尽管效率较高，LRMs的对抗鲁棒性仍鲜有研究。本文系统评估了八种模型在六种基准上的文本与多模态场景下的鲁棒性。结果表明，在所考察的设置中，LRMs在对抗扰动下普遍不如显式CoT基线，尤其在白盒攻击下退化严重。进一步分析揭示了不同模态下的独特失效模式：文本潜态表现出脆弱的动力学和对特定输入模式的高度敏感性，而多模态模型的潜态对输入扰动基本保持不变，且对最终预测影响有限。这些发现暴露了当前潜在推理方法的鲁棒性局限，强调在设计隐式推理系统时需兼顾效率与鲁棒性。我们已开源代码以支持研究复现：https://github.com/PKU-ML/latent-reasoning-model-assessment。

summary: Decode-time alignment methods steer a frozen language model by scoring candidate continuations with an external reward and selecting the maximiser. We argue that this shared design is a single degenerate point in a much larger space. We introduce Swiss-Knife, a framework for externalised multi-objective alignment in which the alignment specification is a first-class runtime object: hot-swappable scoring blades, a batch normaliser, a pairwise aggregation operator, and a selection rule. Six axioms characterise the admissible aggregation operators, and we prove a representation theorem: every operator satisfying them has the form $R_i = \sum_{j \neq i} g((μ_i - μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j))$, a two-parameter family containing probit and logistic comparison rules and pointwise argmax as named coordinates. Within it, pairwise aggregation is Lipschitz-stable under adversarial reward contamination while argmax is not, and Candidate-Batch Normalization (CBN) makes the weight simplex invariant to the rescalings under which reward models are only ever identified. Our reference instantiation pairs DPO-LoRA blades with an uncertainty-aware pairwise tournament. Sweeping the helpfulness/honesty/harmlessness simplex, it attains the best balanced frontier of six decode-time methods (harmonic $F_1$ 0.797 vs. 0.750 for the strongest baseline, $p < 10^{-14}$) with the lowest refusal rate and highest helpfulness of any arm, and reconfigures its objectives in 0.05 ms with no gradient computation. Ablating CBN costs 0.217 $F_1$, and the metadata confirms the predicted mechanism: the lowest-variance blade retains 9% of its nominal 33% influence, and the collapse follows the predicted ordering.
title: Swiss-Knife: A Framework for Reconfigurable Externalised Multi-Objective Alignment at Decode Time
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, includes technical appendix and proofs
title_translated: 瑞士军刀：一种解码时可重构的外部化多目标对齐框架
summary_translated: 解码时对齐方法通过外部奖励评分候选延续并选择最优者来引导冻结的语言模型。我们认为这种共享设计只是更大空间中的一个退化点。我们提出Swiss-Knife框架，实现外部化多目标对齐，其中对齐规范作为第一类运行时对象：可热插拔的评分刀片、批归一化器、成对聚合算子和选择规则。六个公理刻画了可接受的聚合算子，我们证明了一个表示定理：所有满足条件的算子均具有形式 $R_i = \	extstyle\sum_{j \neq i} g((μ_i - μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j))$，属于一个双参数族，包含probit和logistic比较规则以及逐点argmax等特例。在此框架中，成对聚合在对抗奖励污染下具有Lipschitz稳定性，而argmax则不具备；候选批归一化（CBN）使权重单纯形对奖励模型仅在缩放意义下识别的情况保持不变。我们的参考实现结合DPO-LoRA刀片与不确定性感知的成对锦标赛。在帮助性/诚实性/无害性单纯形上扫描，实现了六种解码时方法中最佳的平衡前沿（调和F1 0.797 vs. 0.750的最强基线，p < 10^{-14}），拒绝率最低，帮助性最高，且可在0.05毫秒内完成目标重构，无需梯度计算。消融CBN导致F1下降0.217，元数据证实了预测机制：低方差刀片保留了其名义上33%影响力的9%，崩溃顺序符合预期。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a range of human-like decision-making behaviors, but whether these reflect similar underlying mechanisms or surface-level mimicry remains unclear. We evaluate whether LLM context sensitivity aligns with a cognitive economic theory that explains human behavior through problem categorization and attention allocation. Across 12 open-source and commercial LLMs on a novel 140,000-trial product choice benchmark, context induces human-like shifts in choice and problem categorization, but does not reliably reweight attention between features like price and quality. Neither scale nor chain-of-thought reasoning reliably attenuates context sensitivity or generates human-like behavior. These results suggest that LLM decision mechanisms are distinct from human ones.
title: Do LLMs Choose Like Humans? Using Cognitive Theory to Evaluate LLM Decision-Making
comment: Accepted to EMNLP Findings 2026
title_translated: 大语言模型会像人类一样做选择吗？基于认知理论评估LLM决策行为
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出多种类人决策行为，但这些行为是否反映相似的底层机制，还是仅停留在表面模仿尚不明确。我们评估LLM的上下文敏感性是否与解释人类行为的认知经济理论一致，该理论通过问题分类和注意力分配来解释人类行为。在一项包含14万次试验的新产品选择基准上，对12个开源和商业LLM的评估显示，上下文确实引发类人选择和问题分类的变化，但并未可靠地重新加权价格与质量等特征之间的注意力。无论规模大小或链式思维推理，均无法可靠减弱上下文敏感性或生成类人行为。这些结果表明，LLM的决策机制与人类存在本质差异。

summary: A direction in activation space that changes safety-relevant behavior when steered is not necessarily one the model uses to produce that behavior on its own. We therefore ask whether steering acts through the computation of the unmodified model or through a different set of components, studying two traits whose directions have been extracted and validated in prior work: refusal and sycophancy in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. For each, we use the trait vector to split the computation into a reconstruction circuit before the vector and a transmission circuit after it. We then test whether restoring the coordinate returns behavior removed by ablation. For refusal, both circuits are compact and faithful, restoring the coordinate alone recovers almost all of the refusal signal lost to ablation, and a circuit built around the vector matches the faithfulness of a direct input-to-output circuit at roughly half the edges. For sycophancy, transmission is compact, but reconstruction is broader and only partially faithful. Circuits that transmit a steering intervention are therefore not automatically the circuits that produce the behavior, and we report the counterfactual, target, and behavioral test for every circuit accordingly.
title: From Trait Vectors to Circuits: Tracing Refusal and Sycophancy Through Language Models
title_translated: 从特质向量到电路：通过语言模型追踪拒绝与奉承行为
summary_translated: 在激活空间中改变安全相关行为的方向，并不必然代表模型自身生成该行为所依赖的计算路径。因此，我们探究了引导操作是通过原始模型的计算过程，还是通过另一组组件实现的。研究聚焦于先前工作中已提取并验证的两个特质：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct中的拒绝与奉承行为。针对每个特质，我们利用特质向量将计算过程划分为向量前的重构电路和向量后的传输电路。随后测试恢复该坐标是否能恢复因消融而丢失的行为。对于拒绝行为，两个电路均紧凑且忠实，仅恢复该坐标即可几乎完全恢复被消融丢失的拒绝信号，且围绕该向量构建的电路在约一半边数下达到与直接输入输出电路相当的忠实度。对于奉承行为，传输电路紧凑，但重构电路更广泛且仅部分忠实。因此，传输引导干预的电路并非自动等同于产生该行为的电路，我们相应地报告了每个电路的反事实、目标及行为测试结果。

summary: Long-form factuality verification is commonly implemented as a static decompose-search-verify pipeline, with separately prompted modules processing claims and invoking external search. Treating claims independently makes LLM and search calls scale with claim count and causes repeated searches for overlapping evidence about related claims. We introduce EAVer, an End-to-end Agentic Verifier that learns to control the complete response-level verification workflow as a unified policy. EAVer groups semantically related claims, routes each group to direct verification or targeted search based on confidence, and keeps evidence returned by search in compact in-context memos for cross-claim reuse. To train this policy, we develop a privileged-teacher synthesis pipeline that converts gold claim annotations into executable multi-turn tool-interaction trajectories with live search rather than post-hoc rationales. Structural, label-alignment, tool-use, search-budget, and leakage checks yield 1,447 quality-controlled trajectories. We further construct 794 bidirectional same-trajectory preference pairs that keep claim grouping, search, and evidence fixed, enabling decision-focused Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) over factuality-decision tokens. The results with Qwen3-8B show that EAVer outperforms the strongest search-based baseline on each benchmark by 2.88 Macro-F1 points on VeriFastScore and 4.73 points on the out-of-distribution FaStFact-Bench, while using about 80% fewer searches than the most search-efficient baseline. Moreover, EAVer consistently improves performance across models ranging from 4B to 32B parameters, demonstrating its strong generalizability.
title: EAVer: Long-Form Factuality Verification as an End-to-End Agentic Policy
title_translated: EAVer：作为端到端智能体策略的长篇事实性验证
summary_translated: 长篇事实性验证通常采用静态的分解-搜索-验证流水线，各模块独立触发以处理声明并调用外部搜索。独立处理声明导致LLM和搜索调用随声明数量线性增长，并造成对相关声明重叠证据的重复搜索。我们提出EAVer，一种端到端智能体验证器，学习将完整的响应级验证流程作为一个统一策略进行控制。EAVer将语义相关的声明分组，根据置信度决定每组是否直接验证或进行定向搜索，并将搜索返回的证据以紧凑的上下文记忆形式保留，供跨声明复用。为训练该策略，我们开发了一种特权教师合成流水线，将真实声明标注转化为包含实时搜索的可执行多轮工具交互轨迹，而非事后推理。结构、标签对齐、工具使用、搜索预算和泄漏检查共生成1,447条质量可控的轨迹。我们进一步构建了794对双向同轨迹偏好数据，保持声明分组、搜索和证据不变，支持面向事实性决策令牌的决策导向直接偏好优化（DPO）。实验结果表明，使用Qwen3-8B时，EAVer在VeriFastScore基准上比最强的基于搜索的基线高出2.88点Macro-F1，在分布外的FaStFact-Bench上高出4.73点，同时搜索次数仅为最高效基线的约80%。此外，EAVer在从4B到32B参数规模的多个模型上均持续提升性能，展现出强大的泛化能力。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and coherent text that is increasingly difficult to distinguish from human writing, motivating the development of automatic AI-generated text detectors. However, the robustness of such detectors under adversarial generation remains uncertain. This paper presents SHADE (Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion), a reinforcement learning framework that formulates detector evasion as a policy optimization problem. Instead of applying post-hoc perturbations or prompting-based rewriting, SHADE fine-tunes an instruction-tuned LLaMA model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using feedback from a surrogate detector based on the PAN 2025 mdok system. Our experiments show that full fine-tuning with a small KL regularization penalty achieves $98.5\%$ surrogate evasion, compared to $1.5\%$ for the base model, while LoRA-based adaptation is substantially less effective under regularization. Linguistic analysis reveals that successful evasion is associated with shorter, simpler, and less lexically diverse outputs, suggesting that high detector evasion does not necessarily correspond to more human-like writing. In the official Voight-Kampff competition setting, our submissions ranked sixth and seventh, indicating that optimization against a single surrogate detector only partially transfers to unseen evaluation classifiers. These results highlight both the potential and limitations of reinforcement learning for adversarial AI-text generation and motivate more robust, multi-detector evaluation protocols for AI-generated text detection.
title: Team DArgk at the 2026 ELOQUENT lab for evaluating generative language model quality: Residuals of Humanity: AI Detection Evasion via GRPO Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted for Working Notes of the Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF 2026)
title_translated: Team DArgk 在 2026 ELOQUENT 实验室评估生成式语言模型质量：残差中的人性：通过 GRPO 微调规避 AI 检测
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成流畅且连贯的文本，其与人类写作的区分日益困难，这推动了自动AI生成文本检测器的发展。然而，此类检测器在对抗性生成下的鲁棒性仍不确定。本文提出SHADE（基于对抗检测规避的随机类人生成），一个强化学习框架，将检测规避建模为策略优化问题。不同于后处理扰动或基于提示的重写，SHADE使用基于PAN 2025 mdok系统的替代检测器反馈，对指令微调的LLaMA模型进行组相对策略优化（GRPO）微调。实验表明，采用小KL正则化惩罚的全量微调实现了98.5%的替代检测器规避率，而基础模型仅为1.5%；而基于LoRA的适配在正则化下效果显著较差。语言学分析显示，成功的规避与更短、更简单、词汇多样性更低的输出相关，表明高规避率并不必然对应更类人的写作。在官方Voight-Kampff竞赛设置中，我们的提交排名第六和第七，表明针对单一替代检测器的优化仅部分迁移至未见的评估分类器。这些结果揭示了强化学习在对抗性AI文本生成中的潜力与局限，并呼吁建立更稳健、多检测器的评估协议。

summary: Evaluating an aligned language model by reading its answers assumes the answers carry the distinction the evaluator cares about. We introduce LLM endognostics, a white-box internal auditing framework designed to extract and causally manipulate latent knowledge within the residual stream. Applied to Minerva-7B-Instruct-v1.0 on 124 minimal prompt pairs over 12 categories of professional risk, behavioral evaluation fails on most of the set: the model acts identically on 63.7% of the pairs (95% CI [55.0%, 71.6%]), complying with or refusing both members. Yet, projecting the residual stream onto the vocabulary by a Jacobian lens reveals a statistically significant Contrastive Endognostic Margin, proving the model maintains robust risk differentiation internally. In a second protocol crossing 25 facts with five linguistic framings, we show that the model conforms to presupposed falsehoods in 72% of cases, despite representing the true entity in its latent layers. Surgically ablating the direction of the planted falsehood restores the correct answer in 11 of 25 suppressed cases (McNemar p = 0.0010), validated by blind human annotation (binary agreement kappa = 0.68). In contrast, an out-of-sample linear probe achieves 77% accuracy at layer 10, but its orthogonal ablation yields a 0% recovery rate. This establishes a fundamental theoretical dissociation: abstract linear representation does not imply causal control over verbalization. Our main contribution is the formalization of endognostics to prove that behavioral evaluation and internal reading systematically disagree in the common case, and that linear decodability is decoupled from causal control.
title: Knowing, and Saying It Only When Asked: LLM Endognostics and the Schizognosis of Minerva-7B
comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Appendices A-E and full human evaluation datasets included
title_translated: 知道，但只在被问及时才说：Minerva-7B 的 LLM 内知性与精神分裂症现象
summary_translated: 通过阅读模型回答来评估对齐的语言模型，假设答案承载了评估者关心的区分特征。我们引入LLM内知性（LLM endognostics），一种白盒内部审计框架，旨在提取并因果操控残差流中的潜在知识。将其应用于Minerva-7B-Instruct-v1.0，在124个最小提示对（覆盖12类专业风险）上的行为评估失败：模型在63.7%的提示对上表现一致（95%置信区间[55.0%, 71.6%]），对两个成员均服从或拒绝。然而，通过雅可比透镜将残差流投影到词表上，揭示出统计显著的对比内知性边际，证明模型在内部维持了稳健的风险区分能力。在第二个协议中，交叉25个事实与五种语言框架，发现模型在72%的情况下顺从预设的错误前提，尽管其潜在层中正确表示了真实实体。通过手术式消融植入错误的方向，成功在25个被抑制案例中的11个恢复正确答案（McNemar p = 0.0010），并通过盲评人类标注验证（二元一致性kappa = 0.68）。相比之下，样本外的线性探测器在第10层达到77%准确率，但其正交消融的恢复率为0%。这确立了一个根本性的理论分离：抽象线性表示并不意味着对表达的因果控制。我们的主要贡献在于形式化内知性，证明行为评估与内部读取在常见情况下系统性分歧，且线性可解性与因果控制相分离。

summary: Knowledge distillation can transmit unintended behavioral traits from a teacher model to a student through training data that appear semantically unrelated to those traits, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. Although recent work has established this effect, its training dynamics and mitigation remain underexplored. We study subliminal learning in open-weight language models ranging from 1.5B to 8B parameters, covering the Qwen, Gemma, and Llama families in number-sequence and chain-of-thought settings. Rather than evaluating only final models, we track trait-related probabilities throughout fine-tuning and find that subliminal acquisition can be highly non-monotonic, with transient spikes, reversals, and trait-specific failures of transfer. We then introduce liminal training, an annealed KL-regularized fine-tuning method that constrains early drift from the base model. Across our experiments, liminal training substantially reduces subliminal trait acquisition while largely preserving task gains, outperforming paraphrasing and layer freezing as mitigation strategies. The effect also extends beyond animal preferences: in a French-language response-style experiment, liminal training suppresses language transfer while retaining much of the GSM8K improvement. Finally, we show that KL timing matters: early regularization is more effective than late regularization, and sweeping the regularization strength reveals an empirical trade-off between task learning and trait suppression.
title: On Mitigation of Subliminal Learning in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables
title_translated: 关于大语言模型中隐性学习的缓解方法
summary_translated: 知识蒸馏可能通过语义上看似无关的训练数据，将教师模型的非预期行为特征传递给学生模型，这一现象称为隐性学习。尽管近期研究已证实该效应，但其训练动态及缓解策略仍缺乏深入探索。我们研究了从1.5B到8B参数的开放权重语言模型（涵盖Qwen、Gemma和Llama系列）在数字序列和思维链设置下的隐性学习。不同于仅评估最终模型，我们全程追踪微调过程中与特质相关的概率，发现隐性获取具有高度非单调性，表现为瞬时峰值、反转以及特定特质的转移失败。随后我们提出liminal训练——一种受控KL正则化的渐进微调方法，限制早期从基础模型的漂移。在所有实验中，liminal训练显著减少了隐性特质的获取，同时基本保留任务收益，优于重写和层冻结等缓解策略。该效果也超越动物偏好：在法语风格响应实验中，liminal训练抑制了语言迁移，同时保留了大部分GSM8K的改进。最后，我们发现KL正则化时机至关重要：早期正则化比晚期更有效，且调节正则化强度揭示了任务学习与特质抑制之间的经验权衡。

summary: Long multilingual conversational spoken question answering requires systems to balance long-range transcript semantics with sparse acoustic and speaker-sensitive cues. We present the Bairong system for the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge, where a diarization-ASR front-end produces speaker-attributed transcripts and a dynamic evidence router constructs question-specific inputs for answer prediction. Instead of applying a fixed transcript-only or audio-only policy, the router infers the required evidence type and context scope from the question and answer options, and selects among full transcript context, local audio-text fusion, speaker-linked evidence, and compact global acoustic samples. This transcript-backbone design keeps discourse context available while activating audio only when it provides complementary evidence. Our Task 1 system achieves 25.70% and 18.44% tcpMER on the development and evaluation sets. For Task 2, the final system obtains 94.84% devel?opment accuracy, outperforming the full-transcript baseline by 1.68 points and the best audio-centric diagnostic system by 2.77 points. These results support dynamic question-aware routing as an effective evidence allocation strategy for conversational spoken QA.
title: The Bairong System for MLC-SLM 2026: Dynamic Question-Aware Evidence Routing for Multilingual Conversational Speech Understanding
comment: Accepted at the 2nd MLC-SLM Challenge and Workshop, INTERSPEECH 2026
title_translated: Bairong系统用于MLC-SLM 2026：面向多语言对话语音理解的动态问题感知证据路由
summary_translated: 长时多语言对话语音问答系统需要在长距离文本语义与稀疏的声学及说话人敏感线索之间取得平衡。我们提出了针对MLC-SLM 2026挑战赛的Bairong系统，该系统采用语音分离-自动语音识别（diarization-ASR）前端生成带说话人标注的转录文本，并通过动态证据路由模块为答案预测构建问题相关的输入。不同于固定使用纯文本或纯音频的策略，该路由模块从问题和答案选项中推断所需的证据类型和上下文范围，从而在完整文本上下文、局部音视频融合、说话人关联证据以及紧凑全局声学样本之间进行选择。这种以文本为主干的设计保持了话语上下文的可用性，仅在音频提供补充证据时才激活音频。我们的任务1系统在开发集和测试集上分别取得了25.70%和18.44%的tcpMER。对于任务2，最终系统在开发集上达到94.84%的准确率，相比全文本基线提升1.68个百分点，相比最佳音频中心诊断系统提升2.77个百分点。这些结果支持动态问题感知路由作为对话式语音问答中有效证据分配策略。

summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires answer inference from evidence that is both structurally valid and temporally admissible. Existing methods often leave anchor-event binding, temporal admissibility, and ordinal selection implicit in model reasoning, task-specific training, or similarity-driven retrieval, allowing locally relevant but invalid facts to enter the answer context. We formulate complex TKGQA as evidence-space control and propose SCoP (Structured Constraint Parsing), a constraint-centric framework that externalizes temporal decisions before answer inference. Instead of treating retrieved facts as admissible evidence by default, SCoP separates answer-seeking event patterns from temporal anchor events, conservatively grounds them to canonical TKG entities and relations, and translates temporal intent into executable constraints with optional ranking requirements. These constraints operate over normalized point and interval ranges, enabling deterministic filtering of structurally compatible candidates and producing a compact evidence space for generation. Experiments on MultiTQ and TimelineCronQ-R assess SCoP across timestamped point-fact and interval-oriented settings with richer temporal relations and ordering dependencies. Without task-specific parameter updates, SCoP achieves 0.825 Hits@1 on MultiTQ and 0.761 Hits@1 on TimelineCronQ-R, with gains on constraint-intensive question types. These results support explicit evidence-space control over unconstrained retrieval or implicit temporal reasoning.
title: SCoP: Structured Constraint Parsing for Evidence-Space Control in Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
title_translated: SCoP：用于时间知识图谱问答中证据空间控制的结构化约束解析
summary_translated: 时间知识图谱问答（TKGQA）要求从既具有结构有效性又符合时间合理性的证据中进行答案推理。现有方法通常将锚事件绑定、时间合理性以及顺序选择隐含于模型推理、特定任务训练或基于相似性的检索中，导致局部相关但无效的事实进入答案上下文。我们提出将复杂的TKGQA建模为证据空间控制问题，并引入SCoP（结构化约束解析）框架，一种以约束为中心的方法，在答案推理前显式处理时间决策。SCoP不默认将检索到的事实视为可接受证据，而是将寻找答案的事件模式与时间锚点事件分离，保守地将其对齐到标准的时间知识图谱实体和关系，并将时间意图转化为可执行的约束（可选排序要求）。这些约束作用于归一化的时间点和区间范围，实现结构兼容候选者的确定性过滤，生成紧凑的证据空间以供生成使用。在MultiTQ和TimelineCronQ-R数据集上的实验评估了SCoP在带时间戳点事实和区间导向设置下的表现，涵盖更丰富的时间关系和顺序依赖。无需特定任务参数更新，SCoP在MultiTQ上取得0.825 Hits@1，在TimelineCronQ-R上取得0.761 Hits@1，且在约束密集型问题类型上表现更优。这些结果支持显式证据空间控制优于无约束检索或隐式时间推理。

summary: Organizations in critical national infrastructure sectors must assess heterogeneous documents for sensitivity before routing or storage. Manual assessment is slow, inconsistent, and unscalable. Extending our prior leakage-controlled benchmark, BERT established the top single-encoder baseline (89.14% accuracy, 89.33% F1-score under 5-fold cross-validation on the Strategic 16K corpus). However, transformer baselines suffer from a structural limitation: fixed input length truncation discards evidence beyond the retained window-precisely where sensitive cables tend to be longest. We present Channel-Boosted MAS (CB-MAS) and instantiate it as IC-MAS (Iterative Consultation Multi-Agent System) to solve this without long-context computational costs. A Channel Critic Agent learns document-adaptive trust weights governing Gated Channel Boosting between two first-window encoders, while paired Consultation Agents iteratively exchange belief states to reconcile evidence from the beginning and end of long documents. IC-MAS holds computation constant regardless of document length by reconciling fixed windows in a compact representation space. Ablation studies show critic-controlled Channel Boosting provides the bulk of accuracy gains, while consultation recovers recall without precision collapse. Critic-Controlled Gated Channel Boosting with Max-Pool fusion and Blackboard Adaptive Consultation achieves 90.72% accuracy, 91.23% F1-score, 92.01% sensitive recall, and 90.46% sensitive precision, using about 54% less average computation than a fixed-round baseline. Gains over the single-encoder baseline are statistically significant (McNemar's test, p less than 0.000001; paired t-test). We include LIME/SHAP explainability, multi-agent evaluation, and an honest accounting of limitations.
title: A Channel-Boosted Multi-Agent System with Iterative Consultation for Document Sensitivity Classification
comment: 30 pages , 12 figures
title_translated: 通道增强的多智能体系统结合迭代咨询用于文档敏感性分类
summary_translated: 关键国家基础设施领域的组织在路由或存储异构文档前必须评估其敏感性。人工评估速度慢、不一致且不可扩展。在我们先前的泄露可控基准基础上，BERT建立了单编码器基线（在Strategic 16K语料库上5折交叉验证下准确率为89.14%，F1得分为89.33%）。然而，Transformer基线存在结构性局限：固定输入长度截断会丢弃保留窗口之外的信息——而敏感文件往往在此区域最长。我们提出通道增强的多智能体系统（CB-MAS），并实例化为IC-MAS（迭代咨询多智能体系统），在不增加长上下文计算成本的前提下解决此问题。通道批评者智能体学习文档自适应的信任权重，控制两个首窗口编码器之间的门控通道增强；成对的咨询智能体则迭代交换信念状态，以调和长文档开头与结尾的证据。IC-MAS通过在紧凑表示空间中调和固定窗口，使计算量与文档长度无关。消融实验表明，批评者控制的通道增强带来了主要的准确率提升，而咨询机制在不导致精度下降的情况下恢复了召回率。采用批评者控制的门控通道增强与最大池化融合，结合黑板自适应咨询，系统达到90.72%准确率、91.23% F1得分、92.01%敏感项召回率和90.46%敏感项精确率，平均计算量比固定轮次基线减少约54%。相较于单编码器基线，性能提升具有统计显著性（McNemar检验，p < 0.000001；配对t检验）。我们还包含LIME/SHAP可解释性分析、多智能体评估以及对局限性的诚实披露。

summary: SALSA (Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant) is an open- source, human-in-the-loop platform for extracting structured scientific datasets from multimodal literature sources. The software combines document parsing, large language models, optical character recognition, computer vision, figure digitization, and user-guided correction tools to recover structured information from text, tables, figures, and captions. Users can configure extraction stages, define dataset schemas, perform interventions on digitized figures, and export verified data for downstream analysis and machine learning. SALSA is designed to automate repetitive literature curation tasks while preserving oversight where expert judgment is required. By supporting customizable extraction workflows across diverse input types, the software provides a flexible framework for scalable, reliable data curation for materials research, and potentially across several disciplines. Users are responsible for ensuring that all inputs, extraction workflows, and downstream uses comply with applicable publisher agreements, copyright and licensing terms, institutional policies, and data-use requirements.
title: SALSA: Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant
title_translated: SALSA：半自主文献摘要助手
summary_translated: SALSA（半自主文献摘要助手）是一个开源、人机协同平台，用于从多模态文献来源中提取结构化科学数据集。该软件结合文档解析、大语言模型、光学字符识别、计算机视觉、图表数字化以及用户引导的修正工具，从文本、表格、图表和图注中恢复结构化信息。用户可配置提取阶段、定义数据集模式、对数字化图表进行干预，并导出经验证的数据以供下游分析和机器学习使用。SALSA旨在自动化重复性的文献整理任务，同时在需要专家判断的地方保留人工监督。通过支持跨多种输入类型的可定制提取工作流，该软件为材料研究提供了灵活、可靠、可扩展的数据整理框架，也可能适用于多个学科领域。用户需确保所有输入、提取流程及下游用途符合相关出版协议、版权和许可条款、机构政策及数据使用要求。

summary: Empirical legal research often relies on turning research questions into structured data extracted from large collections of rulings and judgments. Designing the extraction schema and then extracting the data remain a manual, expertise-heavy bottleneck. We present schematize, an open-source multi-agent system that interactively turns a researcher's problem statement into a validated extraction schema that can later be used for autonomous extraction. Schematize couples (i) a clarification dialogue that elicits implicit expert intent, (ii) iterative schema generation, (iii) data-grounded refinement that tests the schema against documents, and (iv) chat-based post-editing. We evaluated the system with human legal professional, introducing our novel methodology, and schematize achieves top performance in most of tested configurations. While the system is designed to be domain-agnostic and applicable to any document collection, we tailor and evaluate it on legal research problems. We release schematize as a pip-installable Python package with full documentation.
title: Schematize: An Agentic System for Generating and Refining Information-Extraction Schemas for Legal Research
comment: Accepted for EMNLP 2026 (System Demonstration)
title_translated: Schematize：用于生成和优化法律研究信息抽取模式的智能体系统
summary_translated: 实证法律研究常依赖于将研究问题转化为从大量判决和裁决中提取的结构化数据。设计抽取模式并进行数据提取仍是手动、高专业门槛的瓶颈。我们提出Schematize，一个开源的多智能体系统，能够交互式地将研究人员的问题陈述转化为可验证的抽取模式，后续可用于自主抽取。Schematize结合了（i）澄清对话以挖掘隐含的专家意图，（ii）迭代模式生成，（iii）基于数据的模式优化，即用文档测试模式的有效性，以及（iv）基于聊天的后期编辑。我们通过人类法律专业人士进行了评估，引入了新颖的评估方法，Schematize在多数测试配置中表现最优。尽管该系统设计为领域无关，适用于任何文档集合，但我们将其针对法律研究问题进行定制并评估。我们已将Schematize发布为可通过pip安装的Python包，并附有完整文档。

summary: Sofroniew et al. (2026) report that emotion concepts in Claude Sonnet 4.5 are represented as vectors whose geometry mirrors human affect psychology. We replicate the representational core of that study on the base pretrained model google/gemma-2-27b, inheriting every disclosed parameter, resolving unspecified steps by disclosed rules, and changing only the subject model. From 205,200 newly generated Claude Sonnet 4.5 stories matching the original corpus design, we extract 171 emotion vectors and recover the core results. The leading principal components form an affective circumplex (PC1 carries 26.7% of variance against the original study's ~27%, PC2 13.4% against ~14%), emotions cluster into similar intuitive families, and the geometry holds across a broad late-middle band. The valence axis aligns with human norms (r = 0.72, against 0.81) and is stable across scales and depth. Arousal aligns at r = 0.67 (against 0.66) but only at the full 171-emotion scale and late depth, so we do not classify it as replicated. Extending the original analysis, a 46-layer sweep locates a sharp seam at L22-26, where the geometry consolidates and the vocabulary readout becomes legible. An embedding-layer baseline finds much of the geometry already present in the static token embeddings, with arousal as the exception. On top-activating held-out text, the geometry predicts token-level co-activation at r = 0.907. At least 52% of vectors peak on structurally non-conceptual tokens, a measured floor for max-activation confounds. Even when a document contains the vector's emotion word, the peak lands on that word only 6.1% of the time. Because the subject is a base model and the stimuli are Claude-generated fiction, the recovered structure is a property of the pretrained representation of Claude-rendered emotion. The original's causal and assistant-facing analyses are out of scope. Code and data are released.
title: Replicating the Geometry of Emotion Representations in a Base Open-Weights Model
comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL artifacts: this https URL
title_translated: 在基础开源权重模型中复现情感表征的几何结构
summary_translated: Sofroniew等人（2026）报告称，Claude Sonnet 4.5中的情感概念以向量形式表示，其几何结构与人类情感心理学相吻合。我们基于基础预训练模型google/gemma-2-27b复现了该研究的核心表征，继承所有已披露参数，通过已披露规则解决未明确步骤，仅更换目标模型。从新生成的205,200条符合原始语料设计的Claude Sonnet 4.5故事中，提取出171个情感向量并恢复了核心结果。主要主成分构成情感环形空间（PC1解释约26.7%方差，原研究约27%；PC2解释约13.4%，原研究约14%），情感聚类为相似的直观类别，且几何结构在广泛的中后期层段保持稳定。效价轴与人类规范高度一致（r=0.72，原研究r=0.81），并在不同尺度和深度上保持稳定。唤醒度相关性为r=0.67（原研究r=0.66），但仅在完整171种情感规模和后期深度下成立，因此不视为成功复现。扩展原分析发现，46层扫描揭示L22-26处存在明显分界，此时几何结构趋于固化，词汇读出变得可读。嵌入层基线表明，大部分几何结构已存在于静态词元嵌入中，唯独唤醒度例外。在高激活保留文本上，该几何结构对token级共激活的预测相关性达r=0.907。至少52%的向量峰值出现在非概念性结构词上，这是最大激活混淆的最低测量值。即使文档包含情感词，峰值落在该词上的概率也仅为6.1%。由于目标是基础模型且刺激来自Claude生成的虚构文本，所恢复的结构是Claude渲染情感在预训练表征中的属性。原研究中的因果分析和面向助手的分析不在本研究范围内。代码与数据已公开。

summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks, yet understanding and quantifying their predictive uncertainty remains underexplored despite being central for safety critical applications. In this work, we present a systematic study of training-free uncertainty quantification strategies for MLLMs, categorizing existing approaches into three conceptual families: token-level methods, which operate directly in the text output space; verbalized methods, which elicit uncertainty estimates or abstention signals via natural language prompts; and semantic methods, which measure uncertainty in a semantic meaning space. We benchmark these strategies across multiple datasets, model families, generations, and scales, and find that no single family dominates: token-level entropy (at sampling temperature 1.0) wins on short answers, verbalized abstention on sentence-length responses, and semantic methods on long-form generation.
title: Dissecting Training-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Multimodal Large Language Models
title_translated: 解构多模态大语言模型中的无训练不确定性估计
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多种多模态任务中取得了显著性能，但对其预测不确定性的理解与量化仍处于探索阶段，而这一问题对于安全关键应用至关重要。本文系统研究了MLLMs的无训练不确定性量化策略，将现有方法分为三类：基于token的方法，直接作用于文本输出空间；语言化方法，通过自然语言提示诱发不确定性估计或回避信号；语义方法，在语义意义空间中衡量不确定性。我们在多个数据集、模型族、生成方式和规模上对这些策略进行基准测试，发现没有单一方法占优：在短回答中，token级熵（采样温度为1.0时）表现最佳；在句子长度响应中，语言化回避策略更优；在长篇生成中，语义方法效果最好。

summary: This exploratory pilot study evaluates the scope and perceived accuracy of personal information output from ongoing conversational interactions in generative AI systems using GPT-5.2 Instant and GPT-5.2 Thinking, categorized into three output types: Fact, Inference, and Confidence. Based on the evaluation results obtained from 15 Japanese participants, differences in model design have limited impact on personal information output tendencies. Compared with the Inference type, the Fact type shows a more conservative output pattern. Regarding attribute categories, the findings indicate that Core Personal attributes associated with identification are treated relatively conservatively, whereas Behavioral and Linguistic attributes show higher accuracy across both Fact and Inference outputs. Furthermore, Holistic Profile, Psychological and Cognitive, and Residual attributes are more readily inferred, even when not supported by explicit factual outputs. Notably, the lack of null outputs for these attributes in the Inference type suggests that such inferred profiles may be constructed from indirectly available contextual information. The findings may contribute to future discussions regarding privacy awareness and personal information inference in generative AI systems.
title: Evaluating Personal Information Output from Conversational Interactions in Generative AI Systems
comment: Accepted at the 19th IIAI International Congress on Advanced Applied Informatics (IIAI-AAI 2026)
title_translated: 评估生成式AI系统中对话交互产生的个人信息输出
summary_translated: 本探索性初步研究使用GPT-5.2 Instant和GPT-5.2 Thinking，评估生成式AI系统在持续对话交互中产生的个人信息输出范围及其感知准确性，将输出分为三类：事实型、推断型和置信度型。基于15名日本参与者的评估结果，模型设计差异对个人信息输出倾向的影响有限。相较于推断型，事实型表现出更为保守的输出模式。在属性类别方面，与身份识别相关的核心个人信息被相对保守地处理，而行为和语言属性在事实型和推断型输出中均表现出较高准确性。此外，整体画像、心理与认知属性以及残余属性更容易被推断，即使缺乏显式事实输出支持。值得注意的是，推断型中这些属性缺乏空输出，表明此类推断画像可能源自间接可用的上下文信息。研究结果可为未来关于生成式AI系统中隐私意识与个人信息推断的讨论提供参考。

summary: LLM assistants and agentic systems log long multi-turn conversations. AI providers often scan these conversations for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and mask the PII before storing or processing conversation data. Yet most PII detectors and benchmarks target self-contained records rather than cross-turn evaluation. To evaluate PII detection across turns in multi-turn conversations, we introduce PII-TRACE (Tracing Recurring PII Across Conversational Exchanges), to our knowledge the first PII benchmark to assess whether detectors identify PII in conversational contexts and cover every mention of a recurring identifier across turns. PII-TRACE contains 13,148 synthetic multi-turn dialogues in 13 languages with character-level spans and identifier clusters. Across eleven baselines, including frontier LLMs, no detector achieves full entity-level coverage without substantial false positives on PII-free conversations, and single-pass reading loses a third of the gold characters on long dialogues. To close this gap, we introduce PII-Tracer, a compact 0.6B-parameter detector trained with conversation-level supervision. PII-Tracer attains the highest entity-level coverage of any system we evaluate and also performs strongly on standard single-record benchmarks.
title: PII-TRACE: A Benchmark for Context-Aware PII Detection in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
title_translated: PII-TRACE：面向多轮LLM对话中上下文感知PII检测的基准
summary_translated: LLM助手和智能体系统会记录长时间的多轮对话。AI提供商通常扫描这些对话以检测个人身份信息（PII），并在存储或处理前对PII进行掩码。然而，大多数PII检测器和基准测试针对的是独立记录，而非跨轮次评估。为评估多轮对话中PII检测能力，我们引入PII-TRACE（跨对话交流追踪重复PII），据我们所知，这是首个用于评估检测器是否能在对话上下文中识别PII，并覆盖每一轮中重复标识符所有提及的PII基准。PII-TRACE包含13,148条合成的多轮对话，涵盖13种语言，提供字符级别跨度和标识符簇。在十一个基线系统（包括前沿LLMs）中，没有任何检测器能在避免大量误报的前提下实现完整的实体级覆盖率，单次读取在长对话中会丢失三分之一的黄金字符。为缩小这一差距，我们提出PII-Tracer，一种采用对话级监督训练的紧凑型0.6B参数检测器。PII-Tracer在我们评估的所有系统中实现了最高的实体级覆盖率，并在标准单记录基准上也表现优异。

summary: The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) creates new opportunities for strategic content generation on online platforms, including potentially harmful forms of manipulation that may undermine platform effectiveness and reshape platform dynamics. However, measuring such activity is difficult because AI-generated content is rarely directly observable. We introduce an empirical approach that leverages discrete LLM supply shocks - abrupt changes in model prices and capabilities, and contrasts verified with non-verified reviews to identify changes in platform activity associated with generative AI supply improvements. We apply this approach to more than 13 million reviews from Trustpilot, one of the leading online platforms for business reviews. A robust finding is that following LLM supply shocks, unverified reviews shift toward greater negativity: more 1-stars, fewer 5-stars, and lower ratings, with effects driven primarily by new model releases and concentrated among firms with the lowest and highest review volumes, suggesting that strategic AI use may reshape platform competition dynamics. We further find that LLM supply shocks trigger short, concentrated bursts of review activity. Together, these findings suggest that generative AI is already reshaping how reputation and competition operate on online platforms.
title: The Role of AI in Online Reviews
title_translated: 人工智能在在线评论中的作用
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速普及为在线平台上的战略性内容生成创造了新机遇，包括可能损害平台有效性的操纵行为，从而重塑平台动态。然而，测量此类活动十分困难，因为AI生成内容很少能直接观测。我们提出一种实证方法，利用离散的LLM供应冲击——即模型价格和能力的突然变化，并对比验证与非验证评论，以识别与生成式AI供应提升相关的平台活动变化。我们将该方法应用于Trustpilot平台超过1300万条评论，该平台是领先的商业评论网站之一。一个稳健发现是，在LLM供应冲击后，非验证评论趋向更负面：1星评论增多，5星评论减少，评分下降，且效应主要由新模型发布驱动，集中在评论量最低和最高的企业中，暗示战略性的AI使用可能正在重塑平台竞争格局。我们还发现，LLM供应冲击会引发短暂而集中的评论活动爆发。综合来看，这些发现表明生成式AI已开始重塑在线平台上的声誉与竞争运作方式。

summary: Large language models can convincingly adopt personas, recall past dialogues, and weave rich autobiographies. Yet this conversational eloquence conceals a fundamental attribution problem: looking the part does not mean having lived the life. Two individuals can share identical public profiles--the same age, hometown, occupation, and personality traits--while possessing entirely distinct private histories, relationships, and acquired skills. When conditioned solely on that shared profile, an agent lacks the information required to determine which lineage is correct. We introduce the Situated Identity Test (SIT), an architecture-independent framework that evaluates whether an agent's behavior is functionally attributable to a specific developmental lineage. Grounded identity requires both appropriate knowledge of recorded experiences and appropriate ignorance of ungrounded ones, bounded by what the identity has actually acquired rather than what its underlying foundation model knows. We prove that any policy conditioned solely on a compressed profile is bounded by an average situated validity of at most 1/m across m colliding life histories on lineage-discriminative queries (at most 50% for paired lineages). We instantiate this framework in SITBench, an evaluation suite designed for 25 profile-collision pairs (50 distinct lineages) across 10,000 planned probes and nine architectural configurations. Supported by an open-source reference implementation, deterministic test fixtures, and empirical pilot evaluations on frontier foundation models (GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5), we formalize the failure modes of persona prompting under profile collision and provide an assurance harness for evaluating episodic continuity, structured state, and epistemic boundaries.
title: The Situated Identity Test: Distinguishing Persistent Cognitive Identity from Persona Imitation
comment: 28 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables; open-source benchmark and reference implementation available at this https URL
title_translated: 情境身份测试：区分持续认知身份与角色模仿
summary_translated: 大型语言模型能够令人信服地扮演角色、回忆过往对话并编织丰富的个人经历。然而，这种对话上的流畅性掩盖了一个根本性的归因问题：外表相似并不等于真实经历。两个人可以拥有完全相同的公开资料——相同的年龄、家乡、职业和性格特征——但私人历史、人际关系和掌握的技能却截然不同。当仅基于这些共享的资料进行条件化时，智能体缺乏判断正确发展脉络所需的信息。我们提出了情境身份测试（SIT），一种与架构无关的框架，用于评估智能体的行为是否可功能性地归因于特定的发展脉络。情境身份要求对记录的经验具备适当的知识，同时对未被证实的经历保持适当无知，其边界由该身份实际获得的内容决定，而非底层基础模型所知内容。我们证明，任何仅依赖压缩后资料的策略，在m条冲突生命脉络的脉络判别查询中，平均情境有效性最多为1/m（成对脉络下不超过50%）。我们在SITBench中实现了该框架，这是一个针对25组资料冲突对（50种不同脉络）设计的评估套件，包含10,000个计划探测点和九种架构配置。通过开源参考实现、确定性测试用例以及对前沿基础模型（GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5）的实证初步评估，我们形式化了在资料冲突下角色提示的失败模式，并提供了评估情景连续性、结构化状态和认识论边界的保障机制。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into AI-assisted hiring pipelines, including automated resume generation and screening. Under the EU AI Act, the hiring domain is classified as high-risk, making fairness and transparency critical requirements. Existing work has primarily focused on explicit hiring decisions, while less attention has been paid to whether generated resumes themselves encode recoverable demographic information. In this work, we conduct a two-stage audit of demographic leakage in German-language LLM-generated resumes. First, we use ChatGPT (GPT-4o-mini), Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, and multiple scales of the open-weight Qwen 3 model family (4B, 8B, and 14B) to generate resumes from real anonymized job-matching profiles, systematically varying gender- and ethnicity-associated names while holding qualifications constant. Second, we simulate a downstream resume screening scenario, where the generated resumes are first anonymized and gender-neutralized, before demographic leakage classifiers are trained on the resulting texts. We find that, despite these interventions, classifiers reliably distinguish between resumes generated with male and female names. This leakage is not driven by overtly gendered wording, but by subtle differences in the usage of semantically equivalent, formally gender-neutral terms in German. In contrast, ethnicity-related leakage remains comparatively weak across models. Our findings demonstrate that apparently neutral resume generation can still preserve highly predictive demographic signals, raising concerns about anonymization-based fairness interventions in multilingual AI hiring pipelines.
title: Fairness Beyond Anonymization? Demographic Leakage in German LLM-Generated Resumes
comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 Workshop on Bias and Fairness in AI [BIAS 2026@ ECML/PKDD]
title_translated: 匿名化之外的公平性？德语大语言模型生成简历中的群体泄露问题
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被集成到AI辅助招聘流程中，包括自动简历生成与筛选。根据欧盟《人工智能法案》，招聘领域被划分为高风险领域，因此公平性和透明性成为关键要求。现有研究主要关注显式的招聘决策，而较少关注生成的简历本身是否包含可恢复的人口统计信息。本文对德语大语言模型生成的简历进行了两阶段审计。首先，我们使用ChatGPT（GPT-4o-mini）、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite以及多个规模的开源Qwen 3模型家族（4B、8B、14B）从真实的匿名职位匹配资料生成简历，系统性地改变性别和族裔相关姓名，同时保持资质不变。其次，我们模拟下游简历筛选场景：先对生成的简历进行匿名化和性别中性化处理，再在所得文本上训练人口统计泄露分类器。结果发现，尽管采取了干预措施，分类器仍能可靠地区分由男性和女性姓名生成的简历。这种泄露并非源于明显的性别化用词，而是源于德语中语义等价但形式上中性的词语使用的细微差异。相比之下，族裔相关的泄露在各模型间相对较弱。研究结果表明，看似中立的简历生成仍可能保留高度预测性的人口统计信号，引发对多语言AI招聘流程中基于匿名化的公平性干预措施的担忧。

summary: Anticipating emerging research directions is a critical goal of AI-assisted science. Existing methods mainly predict which concepts will co-occur in future papers, but co-occurrence captures shared attention rather than the scientific meaning of a connection, such as whether one method uses, combines, replaces, or contradicts another. We formulate research-direction discovery as hierarchical scientific-relation forecasting over a shared candidate-pair space, comprising three temporally aligned tasks: first co-occurrence, first scientific-relation formation, and relation type at formation. We construct SCoR-Graph from 187,848 cs.CV papers published between 2017 and 2026, yielding 270,687 consolidated concepts, 7.45 million co-occurrence edges, and 615,036 typed, directed relation edges. From cutoff-specific graph snapshots, we derive SCoR-Bench, a leakage-audited benchmark for these three capabilities, with expert-verified gold labels for the entire relation-type test set. We further introduce HiSCoR, a task-adapted model family that models relation emergence as a temporally evolving, hierarchically constrained process by encoding pre-cutoff event histories and conditioning relation formation on future co-occurrence. On the held-out 2025-2026 window, HiSCoR achieves an AUROC of 0.9515, a 2.4% relative improvement over the strongest temporal-graph baseline, and improves population-AUPRC by 14.0%; its relation-type variant achieves a Macro-AUROC of 0.7795. Ablations show that semantic, co-occurrence, and typed-relation views provide complementary predictive evidence. SCoR advances research-direction forecasting from predicting which concepts will co-occur to anticipating whether and how evidence-backed scientific relations will emerge.
title: SCoR: A Hierarchical Framework for Forecasting Relations Between Scientific Concepts
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables; includes supplementary material. Jingze Wang and Fred Sun contributed equally; Shangqi Guo is the corresponding author
title_translated: SCoR：科学概念间关系预测的层次化框架
summary_translated: 预测新兴研究方向是AI辅助科学研究的关键目标。现有方法主要预测未来论文中哪些概念将共现，但共现仅反映共同关注，而非科学连接的实际意义，例如一个方法是否使用、结合、替代或反驳另一个方法。我们将研究方向发现建模为在共享候选对空间上的层次化科学关系预测任务，包含三个时间对齐的任务：首次共现、首次科学关系形成及形成时的关系类型。我们基于2017至2026年间发表的187,848篇cs.CV论文构建SCoR-Graph，得到270,687个整合概念、745万条共现边和615,036条有类型、有向的关系边。从特定截断点的图快照中，我们推导出SCoR-Bench，一个经过泄漏审计的基准测试集，涵盖上述三项能力，并由专家验证的黄金标签覆盖整个关系类型测试集。我们进一步提出HiSCoR，一种任务适配的模型家族，通过编码截断前事件历史并将关系形成条件化于未来的共现，将关系涌现建模为随时间演变且具有层次约束的过程。在预留的2025–2026时间段上，HiSCoR达到0.9515的AUROC，比最强的时间图基线相对提升2.4%，群体AUPRC提升14.0%；其关系类型变体达到Macro-AUROC 0.7795。消融实验表明，语义、共现和有类型关系视角提供了互补的预测证据。SCoR将研究方向预测从预测概念共现推进到预测证据支持的科学关系如何出现。

summary: Precision healthcare, particularly for conditions like hypertension and cardiovascular disease, necessitates monitoring of dietary sodium intake. However, tracking this is hindered by the prevalence of hidden salt in cooking, such as sodium in soy sauce and ketchup. While recipes offer a valuable data source for dietary analysis, sodium-rich seasonings are frequently omitted or described ambiguously in instructions. To solve this issue, we propose SALT, a Sodium Assessing & Level Tracking framework adopting an RAG framework to assess sodium content in recipes. Our framework first introduces a Joint-Factor Embedding Retrieval module to locate similar recipes with specified sodium content for addressing the lack of contextual references. These retrieved samples provide contexts for subsequent inference. Then we design a structured 4-hop Chain-of-Thought inference module to refine the vague estimation from language models through a multi-step sodium estimation. To facilitate our study, we further construct a recipe dataset SALT54k with $54,151$ entries labeled with sodium quantities across $11$ common seasonings. Results on SALT54k demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in sodium estimation. Additional real-world validations confirm the effectiveness of our method, demonstrating its potential as a practical solution for AI-assisted precision healthcare.
title: Quantifying Hidden Salt for Precision Healthcare: Sodium Assessment via Joint-Factor Retrieval and Chain-of-Thought Inference
comment: Accepted in EMNLP 2026 Main Conference; 16 pages, 7 figures
title_translated: 量化隐藏盐分以实现精准医疗：基于联合因子检索与思维链推理的钠含量评估
summary_translated: 精准医疗，特别是针对高血压和心血管疾病等病症，需要监测饮食中的钠摄入量。然而，由于烹饪中隐藏盐分（如酱油和番茄酱中的钠）普遍存在，这一监测面临挑战。虽然食谱是饮食分析的重要数据源，但富含钠的调味品常被省略或描述模糊。为解决此问题，我们提出SALT框架，采用RAG框架评估食谱中的钠含量。该框架首先引入联合因子嵌入检索模块，定位具有指定钠含量的相似食谱，以弥补上下文参考的缺失。这些检索样本为后续推理提供上下文。随后，我们设计了一种结构化的四跳思维链推理模块，通过多步钠含量估算过程，逐步优化语言模型的模糊估计。为支持本研究，我们还构建了一个包含54,151条记录的食谱数据集SALT54k，涵盖11种常见调味品的钠含量标注。在SALT54k上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在钠含量估算方面达到了当前最优性能。额外的真实世界验证也确认了该方法的有效性，展示了其作为AI辅助精准医疗实用解决方案的潜力。

summary: Employers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to automate their hiring process. This paper investigates the risk of monocultural biases, in which the widespread deployment of large language models homogenizes biases across the labor market, leading to greater systemic exclusion for certain demographic groups. For ten LLMs, we measure hiring biases across their base and post-trained versions to identify which stage, pre-training or post-training, lead to monocultural biases. We find that, compared to their base models, post-trained models are 3.6% less likely to callback older applicants. This negative shift occurs in eight of the ten models that we evaluate. Post-trained models have much more correlated decisions than base models which is likely driven by human capital traits like skills or college major. However, greater consensus among models increases global systemic exclusion rates from 5.6% to 17.3% and exacerbates demographic inequalities, with intersectional systemic exclusion rates ranging from 12.2% to 21.7% for post-trained models. We find that this inequality is primarily driven by age-based discrimination that is exacerbated in post-training. These results indicate that while post-training techniques may improve models' abilities to select the best applicants, they may raise systemic inequality risks for those at the margin by uniformly introducing new biases.
title: Monocultural Biases: Correlated biases in large language models lead to unequal systemic exclusion rates in hiring
comment: Accepted at COLM 2026
title_translated: 单一文化偏见：大语言模型中的相关偏见导致招聘中不平等的系统性排除率
summary_translated: 雇主正越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）来自动化招聘流程。本文研究了单一文化偏见的风险，即大语言模型的大规模部署使劳动力市场中的偏见趋于同质化，从而导致某些群体面临更高的系统性排除率。我们对十款大语言模型的基线版本和后训练版本进行了招聘偏见测量，以识别是预训练还是后训练阶段导致了单一文化偏见。结果发现，相较于基线模型，后训练模型对年长申请者的回调概率降低了3.6%。这一负向变化出现在我们评估的十款模型中的八款。后训练模型的决策相关性远高于基线模型，这可能由人力资本特征（如技能或大学专业）驱动。然而，模型间更高的一致性导致全球系统性排除率从5.6%上升至17.3%，加剧了群体间的不平等，交叉性系统性排除率在后训练模型中达到12.2%至21.7%。我们发现，这种不平等主要由年龄歧视驱动，且在后训练阶段被放大。这些结果表明，尽管后训练技术可能提升模型挑选最佳申请者的能力，但可能通过统一引入新偏见，增加边缘群体的系统性不平等风险。

summary: Structured EHR is abundant but sparse, coded, and difficult to use directly for note-centric clinical modeling. We present MedNotes, a multi-agent synthetic data generation pipeline that converts longitudinal structured EHR into source-grounded clinical note representations under explicit quality control. MedNotes treats structured-data-to-text synthesis as a closed-loop agentic process: a generator proposes a note, evaluator agents diagnose factual, coverage, structural, and hallucination-related failures, and a router accepts, revises, or rejects the draft. On 1,485 EHRSHOT encounters, MedNotes achieves a 91.4% pass rate, with mean factual accuracy of 0.980, completeness of 99.1%, structural fidelity of 0.761, and 0.028 critical hallucinations per encounter. Iterative refinement improves acceptance from 69.4% to 91.4%. The resulting synthetic corpus improves downstream CPT prediction and paragraph-level section prediction when combined with limited real data.
title: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Source-Grounded Synthetic Note Generation from Longitudinal Structured EHR
comment: Accepted at the FMSD Workshop, ICML 2026
title_translated: 一种基于纵向结构化电子健康记录的源基合成笔记生成多智能体流水线
summary_translated: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）数据丰富但稀疏、编码复杂，难以直接用于以笔记为中心的临床建模。我们提出了MedNotes，一个将纵向结构化EHR转化为源基临床笔记表示的多智能体合成数据生成流水线，并在明确的质量控制下运行。MedNotes将结构化数据到文本的合成视为闭环智能体过程：生成器提出一份笔记，评估智能体诊断事实性、覆盖度、结构和幻觉相关的问题，路由器决定接受、修改或拒绝草稿。在1,485个EHRSHOT实例上，MedNotes实现了91.4%的通过率，平均事实准确率为0.980，完整性达99.1%，结构保真度为0.761，每例仅0.028个关键幻觉。迭代优化使接受率从69.4%提升至91.4%。结合有限真实数据后，生成的合成语料库显著提升了下游CPT预测和段落级章节预测性能。

summary: Interpretability research on large language models has produced accounts of factual recall in feed-forward layers and of token relationships in self-attention, but little work offers a unified way to compare the causal contribution of different architecture components to a model's output. We introduce MechaTerp (the Mechanistic Interpretability suite) -TRACE (subset for Teacher-forced Registry of Ablated Component Effects), an architecture and study that measures how much each registered component of a language model supports the production of a named entity. TRACE ablates one component at a time and measures the resulting change in the output distribution at a fixed answer token, so component types from whole transformer blocks down to individual neurons and output logits can be compared on a common scale. We apply it to thirteen instruction-tuned dense decoder models spanning five families and one to thirty billion parameters, ablating 49,656 components across 48 medical and 42 general-knowledge prompts. We find that the components carrying the most effect are the same few, positionally fixed components in every model, regardless of which entity a prompt asks about, and that once these are removed, the remaining support is close to evenly spread in eleven of the thirteen models. Apparent localisation of entity knowledge is therefore largely attributable to generic generation machinery, which has direct consequences for methods that assume entity knowledge sits in a findable place, including targeted knowledge editing.
title: MechaTerp-TRACE: A Novel Approach for Component Ablation Analysis in Language Models
title_translated: MechaTerp-TRACE：语言模型中组件消融分析的新方法
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的可解释性研究已揭示前馈层中的事实回忆机制以及自注意力中的标记关系，但很少有工作提供统一方式来比较不同架构组件对模型输出的因果贡献。我们引入MechaTerp（机制可解释性套件）-TRACE（教师强制注册消融组件效应的子集），该框架测量语言模型中每个注册组件对命名实体生成的支持程度。TRACE逐个消融组件，并在固定答案标记处测量输出分布的变化，从而可在同一尺度上比较从整个Transformer块到单个神经元和输出logits的各类组件。我们在十三个指令微调的密集解码器模型（涵盖五个系列，参数量从10亿到300亿）上应用该方法，对48个医疗和42个通用知识提示进行了49,656个组件的消融实验。结果发现，所有模型中起主要作用的都是少数几个位置固定的组件，无论提示询问何种实体；一旦这些组件被移除，其余支持在十三个模型中的十一个几乎均匀分布。因此，实体知识的表观定位主要归因于通用生成机制，这对假设实体知识存在于可定位位置的方法（如定向知识编辑）具有直接影响。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) by grounding generation in external knowledge. However, most existing RAG frameworks assume a centralized retrieval corpus, which is often impractical in sensitive domains such as healthcare, where data are inherently distributed and raw content cannot be directly shared across institutions. Recent efforts on decentralized RAG primarily follow prompt-based paradigms that exchange raw, human-readable retrieved content, leading to substantial inference-time computational overhead and direct exposure of retrieved information. To address these limitations, we propose Representation-based Federated RAG (FedRepRAG), a decentralized RAG framework that keeps raw documents at their owning clients and exchanges only compact latent representations during cross-client retrieval. To integrate retrieved knowledge, we introduce a collaboratively trained projector that converts retrieval embeddings into generator-compatible representation tokens for a frozen LLM/VLM backbone. Experiments across decentralized visual question answering (VQA) and question answering (QA) benchmarks show that FedRepRAG consistently outperforms direct inference and local retrieval baselines while substantially reducing retrieval-context length and inference-time computational overhead compared with raw-context transfer. Further analyses confirm the importance of query-relevant retrieved representations and characterize the residual representation-level leakage associated with representation exchange. Overall, FedRepRAG provides an effective and efficient framework for federated RAG without transferring raw retrieved content.
title: Beyond Raw Context Transfer: Representation-based Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: 超越原始上下文传递：基于表示的联邦检索增强生成
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将生成过程锚定于外部知识，提升了大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的事实性。然而，大多数现有RAG框架假设存在集中式检索语料库，这在医疗等敏感领域往往不切实际，因为数据天然分散且原始内容无法跨机构直接共享。近期去中心化RAG工作主要采用基于提示的范式，交换原始可读的检索内容，导致显著的推理时计算开销并直接暴露检索信息。为解决这些问题，我们提出基于表示的联邦RAG（FedRepRAG），一种去中心化RAG框架，将原始文档保留在所属客户端，仅在跨客户端检索时交换紧凑的潜在表示。为整合检索知识，我们引入一个协同训练的投影器，将检索嵌入转换为冻结的LLM/VLM主干兼容的表示令牌。在去中心化视觉问答（VQA）和问答（QA）基准上的实验表明，FedRepRAG持续优于直接推理和本地检索基线，同时显著减少检索上下文长度和推理时计算开销，相比原始上下文传递。进一步分析确认了查询相关检索表示的重要性，并刻画了表示交换带来的残余表示级泄露。总体而言，FedRepRAG在不传输原始检索内容的前提下，提供了一种高效且有效的联邦RAG框架。
