summary: Imagination performs as a high-level function of large language models (LLMs) which determines the potential of how an LLM creates unseen or creative content. While existing works have built a rich family of creativity benchmarks for this ability, they only measure how far an output departs from common answers and never check whether the departure is licensed by the prompt. Moreover, hallucination, the closest neighbor of imagination, is always measured in a separate pipeline on different generations, so the influential claim that imagination and hallucination stem from the same generative mechanism has never been directly testable. In this paper, we propose Whiteboard, the first LLM imagination evaluation benchmark. Its design follows the authoritative cognitive instruments developed to measure human imagination: seven mechanism-grounded imagination subtypes are adapted from classic paradigms, then crossed with ten support-boundary hallucination subtypes and scored jointly on the same generation. Different from previous creativity or hallucination benchmarks, Whiteboard gates every imagination score with an explicit support check and computes both axes deterministically through an auditable atom matrix, with no LLM judge on the primary path. The full Whiteboard item bank contains 1,660 prompts; on its shared 80-item anchor set, we evaluate 79 state-of-the-art LLMs and validate the instrument against 13,280 human judgments. Additionally, we further explore whether imagination derives from the same generative tendency as hallucination and what key factors shape it. Our analysis indicates a counterintuitive correlation between hallucination and imagination: Most of the subtype couplings are negative, every one of the anchor items reproduces the negative coupling on its own.
title: Is Imagination Derived from Hallucination? A Cross-Taxonomy Evaluation of Imagination and Hallucination in Large Language Models
title_translated: 想象是否源于幻觉？大型语言模型中想象与幻觉的跨分类评估
summary_translated: 想象是大型语言模型（LLMs）的一项高级功能，决定了其创造未见或创造性内容的潜力。尽管已有大量创造力基准用于衡量此能力，但它们仅测量输出偏离常见答案的程度，从未检查这种偏离是否由提示所许可。此外，作为想象最接近的邻居，幻觉通常在独立流程中对不同生成进行评估，因此“想象与幻觉源自相同生成机制”的重要主张从未被直接验证。本文提出Whiteboard——首个LLM想象评估基准。其设计遵循用于测量人类想象的经典认知工具：从经典范式中改编七种机制基础的想象子类型，与十种支持边界幻觉子类型交叉组合，并在同一生成中联合评分。不同于以往的创造力或幻觉基准，Whiteboard通过显式支持检查对每项想象得分进行门控，并通过可审计的原子矩阵确定性地计算两个维度，主路径上无需LLM裁判。完整Whiteboard题库包含1,660个提示；在其共享的80项锚点集上，我们评估了79个最先进的LLMs，并用13,280个人类判断验证了该工具。此外，我们进一步探究想象是否源于与幻觉相同的生成倾向及其关键影响因素。分析显示，幻觉与想象之间存在反直觉的相关性：大多数子类型配对呈负相关，每个锚点项目自身也重现了负相关关系。

summary: We ask whether behavioral constraints acquired through post training remain explicitly reportable. Using constrained recipe generation as a testbed, five banned ingredients enforced via LoRA fine tuning of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct we compare supervised fine tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) against an untrained baseline on a four tier Constraint Awareness Benchmark. Averaged over three seeds, both methods raise behavioral compliance from 4% to about 90% while reducing explicit constraint reporting below the untrained model (0.48/5 to 0.16/5 for SFT, 0.07/5 for GRPO) and eroding retained third person knowledge (93% to 36% for SFT, 14% for GRPO; p less than 0.01 between methods). Contrary to our initial hypothesis, the reward based signal is the more destructive of the two: a reward that penalizes banned ingredient tokens regardless of framing learns a context independent suppression rather than a self directed constraint. A context conditioned reward designed to teach the self to other distinction fails, collapsing toward inclusion in both framings. Probing prompt time hidden states recovers per ingredient avoidance at 83.8% (layer 24 MLP), but only 6.4 points above a per ingredient base rate predictor (77.4%), and the model's own verbal self report is more accurate still (87.8%). A positive control adding explicit self description examples does not restore reporting. The failure is therefore specific to enumerating constraints on request, not a general loss of access to them.
title: Do Language Models Know Their Own Constraints?
comment: 8 pages
title_translated: 语言模型是否了解自身的约束？
summary_translated: 我们探讨通过后训练获得的行为约束是否仍能被显式报告。以受约束的食谱生成为测试场景，我们使用LoRA微调Llama 3.1 8B Instruct模型，强制五种禁用成分，并在四层约束意识基准上比较监督微调（SFT）与组相对策略优化（GRPO）相对于未训练基线的表现。在三个种子平均下，两种方法均将行为合规率从4%提升至约90%，但降低了显式约束报告（SFT从0.48/5降至0.16/5，GRPO为0.07/5），并削弱了保留的第三人称知识（SFT从93%降至36%，GRPO降至14%；方法间差异显著，p<0.01）。与初始假设相反，基于奖励的信号更具破坏性：一种对禁用成分标记进行惩罚（无论上下文如何）的奖励学习的是上下文无关的抑制，而非自我导向的约束。一种旨在教授模型区分“自我”与“他人”的上下文条件奖励失败，两种上下文框架下均趋向于包含禁用成分。探测提示时间隐藏状态在第24层MLP中恢复了每种成分的回避率（83.8%），但仅比基于成分的基线预测器（77.4%）高出6.4分，而模型自身的口头自我报告更准确（87.8%）。添加显式自我描述示例的正向对照未能恢复报告能力。因此，失败特定于在请求时枚举约束，而非一般性地丧失对其访问。

summary: Multimodal synthetic datasets combine structured attributes with free text, but are often evaluated separately. Such metrics can remain high after tabular--text pairings are disrupted. We present a projection-based evaluator for tabular--text synthetic data. A fixed sentence encoder maps text to embeddings, \(k\)-means converts them to cluster states, and tabular variables are represented as categorical or quantile-binned states. Real and synthetic contingency tables are compared using Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD), normalized mutual information (NMI), conditional JSD (cJSD), and joint-state entropy. We also report text-to-attribute (T2A) utility and a holdout-calibrated proximity flag rate (PFR) as a representation-level diagnostic. A text-permutation control preserves both marginal distributions while disrupting their pairing. Experiments on Amazon Reviews, Kiva Loans, and the Employment Scam Aegean Dataset show that modality-specific scores remain high under this control. The projection diagnostics detect disruption when real projected dependence exceeds a permutation baseline, but are less informative for weak or sparse projections. Some conditioned LLM baselines also exhibit stronger measured dependence than the corresponding real-data projections. These results support explicit cross-modal evaluation with permutation baselines and coverage reporting.
title: Beyond the Stitching Assumption: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Evaluation via Semantic Quantization
comment: 10 Pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, accepted to PST 2026
title_translated: 超越拼接假设：基于语义量化的多模态合成数据统一评估框架
summary_translated: 多模态合成数据集结合了结构化属性与自由文本，但通常被分别评估。当表格与文本配对被破坏后，此类指标仍可能保持较高水平。我们提出一种基于投影的表格-文本合成数据评估方法。固定句子编码器将文本映射为嵌入，k-means将其转换为聚类状态，表格变量则表示为分类或分位数分箱状态。通过Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）、归一化互信息（NMI）、条件JSD（cJSD）和联合状态熵比较真实与合成的列联表。我们还报告了文本到属性（T2A）效用以及保留校准的接近度标志率（PFR）作为表示层面的诊断指标。文本置换控制在保持边缘分布的同时破坏其配对关系。在Amazon评论、Kiva贷款和就业诈骗爱琴岛数据集上的实验表明，在该控制下，模态特定得分仍保持高位。投影诊断在真实投影依赖性超过置换基线时可检测到破坏，但在弱或稀疏投影情况下信息量较少。部分条件LLM基线也表现出比对应真实数据投影更强的测量依赖性。这些结果支持使用置换基线进行显式的跨模态评估和覆盖率报告。

summary: Preserving safety alignment during large language models fine-tuning is critical, however, recent studies have demonstrated that even benign fine-tuning data may contain safety-degrading samples that silently undermine safety alignment. Existing approaches typically identify such samples using representations from a single safety-sensitive layer. While this assumption has shown effectiveness in monolingual settings, its validity for multilingual models remains unclear due to potential cross-lingual differences in representation patterns. Through a cross-lingual analysis, we show that sensitive layers are only partially shared across languages, with safety-relevant signals often distributed across multiple layers. Motivated by these observations, we propose MMSAFE, a multi-layer framework for multilingual safety-degrading data identification that captures both shared and language-specific safety signals. Extensive experiments across multiple models, languages, and safety benchmarks demonstrate that MMSAFE reduces the average harmful-response ratio by 60% compared with random filtering and achieves stronger average performance than the strongest single-layer baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-layer modeling for robust multilingual safety alignment.
title: Multilingual Safety Signals Are Multi-Layered: Filtering Safety-Degrading Data for Safer LLMs
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 16 pages, 11 figures
title_translated: 多语言安全信号是多层次的：用于更安全LLM的安全退化数据过滤
summary_translated: 在大型语言模型微调过程中保持安全对齐至关重要，然而近期研究表明，即使看似无害的微调数据也可能包含悄然削弱安全对齐的安全退化样本。现有方法通常仅利用单一敏感层的表示来识别此类样本。尽管这一假设在单语言场景中已证明有效，但其在多语言模型中的适用性尚不明确，因跨语言间表示模式可能存在差异。通过跨语言分析，我们发现敏感层在不同语言间仅部分共享，且安全相关信号往往分布在多个层级。受此启发，我们提出了MMSAFE——一种多层级的多语言安全退化数据识别框架，能够捕捉共享与语言特异性的安全信号。在多种模型、语言和安全基准上的大量实验表明，MMSAFE相比随机过滤平均有害响应率降低60%，且整体性能优于最强的单层基线，验证了多层级建模在鲁棒多语言安全对齐中的有效性。

summary: Machine learning learns functions: prompt to response, image to caption. What these functions are mathematically remains hard to say. We present a method to approximate these kinds of transformations using techniques from dynamical systems that fall under the umbrella of Koopmanism. We introduce the use of composition operators, which generalize the Koopman operator and, crucially, can map between distinct spaces, motivating the perspective that LLM transformations are rectangular infinite-dimensional operators. This formalism reveals useful structure: under natural assumptions on the prompt and response distributions, the LLM operator is an isometry, and misalignment between learned representations manifests as spectral pollution of its finite sections. We then outline a method of constructing finite-dimensional approximations of an LLM operator, and demonstrate how the singular value spectrum can be used to compare tasks and models.
title: Using Composition Operators to Linearize LLM Semantic Transformations
comment: Submitted to NeurReps workshop 2026
title_translated: 使用组合算子线性化LLM语义变换
summary_translated: 机器学习学习函数：提示到响应，图像到描述。但这些函数在数学上究竟为何物仍难以言明。我们提出一种方法，利用动力系统中的技术（即Koopman理论）来近似这类变换。我们引入组合算子，它推广了Koopman算子，并能映射不同空间，从而促使我们将LLM变换视为矩形无限维算子。该形式化揭示了有用结构：在对提示和响应分布的自然假设下，LLM算子是一个等距映射，而学习表示间的错位表现为有限部分的谱污染。随后，我们概述了构建LLM算子有限维近似的方法，并演示如何利用奇异值谱来比较任务与模型。

summary: Hidden-state hallucination probing - training a linear classifier on an LLM's internal activations to detect whether a generated answer is faithful to the input - is an active area of 2026 research, with recent work reporting 0.90-1.00 AUROC across several benchmarks and languages. However, none of this work has tested probes on code-mixed input, despite the fact that a huge population of chatbot users write in Hindi-English code-mixed text ("Hinglish"). We address this gap directly: does a hallucination probe trained on clean-language hidden states transfer to Hinglish, or does the signal degrade under code-mixing? We construct a 5,674-item Hindi/English/Hinglish QA benchmark, generate and label 17,022 model responses across three open-weight 7-8B LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B), extract per-layer hidden states at two token positions, and train linear and MLP probes for in-distribution detection and cross-lingual transfer. We find that the hallucination signal survives code-mixing well: transfer AUROC ranges from 0.88 to 0.99, with gaps of mostly under 0.05 AUROC relative to in-distribution performance, and that Hindi-trained probes transfer to Hinglish more reliably than English-trained probes. As an independent, practically motivated finding, all three models hallucinate substantially more on Hindi and Hinglish than on English for matched facts. We release our code and synthetic Hinglish QA dataset to support further work on code-mixed hallucination detection.
title: Does the Truthfulness Signal Survive Code-Mixing? Probing Hidden States for Hallucination Detection in Hinglish

title_translated: 真实性信号能否经受代码混杂？针对印英混合语中幻觉检测的隐藏状态探测
summary_translated: 隐藏状态幻觉探测——即在大语言模型内部激活上训练线性分类器以检测生成答案是否忠实于输入——是2026年活跃的研究领域，近期工作在多个基准和语言上报告了0.90至1.00的AUROC。然而，这些研究均未在代码混杂输入上测试探测器，尽管有大量聊天机器人用户使用印地语-英语混杂文本（“Hinglish”）。我们直接填补这一空白：在干净语言隐藏状态上训练的幻觉探测器能否迁移到Hinglish？还是在代码混杂下信号会退化？我们构建了一个包含5,674个条目的印地语/英语/Hinglish问答基准，生成并标注了三款开源7-8B LLM（Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B）的17,022个模型响应，提取两个标记位置的逐层隐藏状态，并训练线性与MLP探测器以实现分布内检测和跨语言迁移。我们发现幻觉信号在代码混杂下仍能较好保留：迁移AUROC范围为0.88至0.99，相对于分布内性能的差距大多低于0.05 AUROC，且印地语训练的探测器比英语训练的探测器在迁移到Hinglish时更可靠。作为独立且具有实际意义的发现，所有三个模型在印地语和Hinglish上的幻觉程度显著高于英语。我们公开发布代码与合成的Hinglish QA数据集，以支持代码混杂幻觉检测的进一步研究。

summary: Text anomaly detection, the task of identifying text instances that deviate from normal language patterns, is crucial for language-driven applications. However, most existing methods can only perform document-level anomaly detection, making it hard to locate harmful phrases or support targeted prevention. Recently, there has been an emerging trend toward token-level text anomaly detection, which aims to address the above limitation by identifying anomalous words or fragments within a document. Nevertheless, one representative method mainly relies on representation-space distance measurement, neglecting the complementary roles of different anomaly cues in capturing diverse abnormal patterns. To bridge the gaps, we propose a Dual-evidence framework with adaptive Fusion and Aggregation (DiFA) for token-level anomaly detection. DiFA derives anomaly scores from form-structural and semantic views to capture visible structural abnormality and contextual inconsistency, respectively, thereby providing complementary evidence for identifying diverse anomalies. To combine these two scores with varying numerical scales, DiFA incorporates a calibration and fusion mechanism to adaptively balance the two views. Moreover, to obtain a discriminative document-level score, a multivariate aggregation method is designed to summarize token-level anomaly scores from multiple perspectives, preventing rare anomalous tokens from being diluted. Extensive experiments across various text anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that DiFA consistently achieves top performance while maintaining strong efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The code and scripts are available at: https://github.com/qyy11-com/DiFA.
title: DiFA: Dual Evidence Fusion and Aggregation for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted by ICDM 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
title_translated: DiFA：用于词级文本异常检测的双证据融合与聚合
summary_translated: 文本异常检测——即识别偏离正常语言模式的文本实例——对语言驱动应用至关重要。然而，大多数现有方法仅能进行文档级异常检测，难以定位有害短语或支持针对性预防。近年来，词级文本异常检测逐渐兴起，旨在通过识别文档内的异常词汇或片段来克服上述局限。然而，一种代表性方法主要依赖表示空间的距离度量，忽视了不同异常线索在捕捉多样化异常模式中的互补作用。为弥合这一差距，我们提出一种双证据自适应融合与聚合框架（DiFA），用于词级异常检测。DiFA从形式-结构和语义两个视角提取异常得分，分别捕捉可见的结构异常和上下文不一致，从而提供互补证据以识别多样异常。为整合数值尺度不同的两类得分，DiFA引入校准与融合机制以自适应平衡两视图。此外，为获得具有判别力的文档级得分，设计了一种多变量聚合方法，从多个角度汇总词级异常得分，防止罕见异常词被稀释。在多种文本异常检测基准上的广泛实验表明，DiFA始终取得顶尖性能，同时保持强效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。代码与脚本可在https://github.com/qyy11-com/DiFA 获取。

summary: Omni-modal large language models integrate text, audio, and image signals into a shared residual stream, where concepts such as emotion can be linearly decoded and causally modified by activation steering. A common but rarely tested assumption is that the layer with the highest probing accuracy is also the best layer for steering, so injection layers are often selected by probe performance. We provide the first causal test of this assumption across three independently developed omni-modal models and find that it fails. Reading and intervention rely on different layers, a phenomenon we call the probing-steering layer dissociation. Using emotion as a controlled testbed, we measure layer-wise readability and steerability across text, audio, and image inputs. Probe-best layers vary widely across architectures, while steering-effective layers consistently fall within a narrow mid-to-late range of normalized depth. Paired random-direction controls show an approximately 26-fold causal gap, ruling out random perturbation and direction quality as explanations. Logit-lens analysis reveals a staged forward process: causal handle, probing saturation, and vocabulary commitment, and motivates a two-factor account in which steering effectiveness depends on both representational readability and downstream plasticity. These results show that probing accuracy is a poor heuristic for selecting intervention layers and suggest a cross-architecture mid-to-late selection criterion. We also identify a cross-modal emotion subspace organized by valence and arousal, with joy acting as a stable anchor across models. Code and data: https://github.com/YiboWang2002/Read-Best-Is-Not-Steer-Best.
title: Read-Best Is Not Steer-Best: A Probing--Steering Layer Dissociation in Omni-Modal Large Language Models
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures
title_translated: 读取最佳并非操控最佳：多模态大语言模型中的探测-操控层解耦
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型将文本、音频和图像信号整合到共享的残差流中，使得情感等概念可通过激活操控线性解码并因果修改。一个常见但很少被验证的假设是，探测准确率最高的层也是操控效果最好的层，因此通常根据探测性能选择注入层。我们首次在三个独立开发的多模态模型上对这一假设进行了因果检验，发现该假设不成立。读取与干预依赖于不同的层，这种现象被称为探测-操控层解耦。以情感为受控测试平台，我们在文本、音频和图像输入上测量了各层的可读性和可操控性。探测最优层在不同架构间差异显著，而有效操控层则始终集中在归一化深度的中后期范围。成对的随机方向对照实验显示约26倍的因果差距，排除了随机扰动和方向质量作为解释因素。Logit-lens分析揭示了一个分阶段的前向过程：因果控制、探测饱和与词汇承诺，并提出了一个双因素解释，即操控有效性取决于表征可读性与下游可塑性。这些结果表明，探测准确率是选择干预层的不良启发式方法，建议采用跨架构的中后期选择标准。我们还识别出由效价和唤醒度组织的跨模态情感子空间，其中喜悦在各模型间充当稳定锚点。代码与数据：https://github.com/YiboWang2002/Read-Best-Is-Not-Steer-Best。

summary: In this paper, we show that LLM and human coding are observationally equivalent in terms of annotation quality: recent LLMs agree with expert coders at rates comparable to those observed among experts themselves. We demonstrate this through replications of text-classification tasks from 14 peer-reviewed political science studies, in which ten LLMs, three human experts, and 165 crowdsourced workers independently classify the same texts using identical codebooks. We find that this equivalence is driven by ambiguity in the texts and coding rules. When LLMs disagree with experts, experts are also more likely to disagree with one another, and clarifying coding rules reduces disagreement among both experts and sufficiently capable LLMs. Thus, there is little empirical basis for preferring human coding on the basis of annotation quality alone, while LLMs offer substantial advantages in speed and cost. We therefore argue that the central challenge of text annotation is no longer choosing between human and machine coders, but developing coding rules that minimize ambiguity and accounting for the ambiguity that remains. To this end, we propose using disagreement across LLMs to identify difficult cases and refine codebooks, and we develop ambiguity-aware bounds for downstream inference when a unique annotation cannot be defined for every text.
title: Observational Equivalence of LLM and Human Annotation
title_translated: 大语言模型与人类标注的观测等价性
summary_translated: 本文表明，大语言模型（LLM）与人类编码在标注质量上具有观测等价性：近期的LLM与专家编码者的一致率与专家之间的内部一致性相当。我们通过复现14项同行评审的政治科学研究中的文本分类任务来验证这一点，其中十种LLM、三位人类专家以及165名众包工作者使用相同的编码手册独立分类相同文本。我们发现，这种等价性是由文本和编码规则的模糊性驱动的。当LLM与专家意见不一致时，专家之间也更可能相互分歧；而澄清编码规则能减少专家及足够能力的LLM之间的分歧。因此，仅基于标注质量偏好人类编码缺乏实证基础，而LLM在速度和成本方面具有显著优势。我们主张，文本标注的核心挑战已不再是选择人类或机器编码者，而是制定能最小化模糊性的编码规则，并对剩余模糊性进行建模。为此，我们提出利用LLM间的分歧识别困难案例并优化编码手册，并在无法为每篇文本定义唯一标注时，构建考虑模糊性的下游推断边界。

summary: Structured pruning is a promising approach for reducing the substantial inference costs of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintaining hardware efficiency. Many existing methods assess the importance of prunable units (e.g., channels or heads) in isolation, implicitly assuming that pruning errors are additive. This independence assumption is often invalidated by the non-orthogonality of model weights and strong correlations between unit activations, potentially leading to performance degradation. To address this, we propose a Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning method. We formulate the pruning objective as a cardinality-constrained binary quadratic program that explicitly models cross-unit dependencies in the reconstruction error. Since this binary quadratic program is NP-hard and difficult to solve exactly, we develop a greedy interaction algorithm based on dependency-aware marginal costs to optimize unit selection. Furthermore, we incorporate a gradient-based strategy to achieve adaptive layer-wise sparsity allocation across the entire model. Extensive experiments on mainstream LLMs demonstrate that incorporating correlation information yields competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to representative structured pruning baselines.
title: Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
title_translated: 相关性感知的结构化剪枝用于大语言模型
summary_translated: 结构化剪枝是一种有前景的方法，可在保持硬件效率的同时显著降低大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本。现有许多方法孤立地评估可剪枝单元（如通道或注意力头）的重要性，隐含假设剪枝误差是可加的。然而，模型权重的非正交性以及单元激活间的强相关性常使该独立性假设失效，可能导致性能下降。为解决此问题，我们提出一种相关性感知的结构化剪枝方法。我们将剪枝目标建模为一个基数约束的二元二次规划问题，显式建模重建误差中的跨单元依赖关系。由于该问题是NP难且难以精确求解，我们设计了一种基于依赖感知边际成本的贪心交互算法以优化单元选择。此外，我们引入基于梯度的策略，在整个模型中实现自适应的逐层稀疏度分配。在主流LLM上的大量实验表明，引入相关性信息可获得与代表性结构化剪枝基线相当的精度-效率权衡。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to draft contractual language, yet conventional accuracy or preference-based evaluations are poorly matched to legal drafting. A clause may be fluent and stylistically polished while still omitting an essential carve-out, allocating risk in an unenforceable way, assuming an inapplicable jurisdiction, or exposing a party to regulatory liability. This paper presents a empirical study design and framework for evaluating LLM-generated contract clauses. The study evaluates four models - Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, GPT 5.4 Nano, and Qwen 3.5 Flash, across 22 contract clause categories and 34 legally-motivated failure modes. We combine two evaluation frameworks: CLAUSE, which classifies prompts by legal function and failure target, and LENS-CRAFT, which scores outputs across nine legal-quality dimensions. Instead of averaging dimension scores, the study applies a Max Severity Principle so that a single legally decisive defect remains visible. The paper provides the evaluation protocol, taxonomy, analysis plan, and a results structure for reporting empirical findings. We argue that legal AI evaluation should move beyond aggregate accuracy toward clause-specific, failure-mode-driven, and risk-sensitive assessment.
title: Beyond Accuracy and Surface Fluency: Risk-Sensitive Evaluation of LLMs for Legal Clause Generation

title_translated: 超越准确率与表面流畅性：面向法律条款生成的大语言模型风险敏感评估
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于起草合同语言，但传统的准确率或偏好型评估与法律起草需求严重不匹配。一条条款可能语法流畅、风格优美，但仍可能遗漏关键例外条款、以不可执行方式分配风险、错误假设适用管辖权，或使一方暴露于监管责任之下。本文提出了一种实证研究设计与评估框架，用于评估LLM生成的合同条款。研究评估了四种模型——Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite、GPT 5.4 Nano 和 Qwen 3.5 Flash——在22类合同条款和34种法律驱动的失败模式下的表现。我们结合两种评估框架：CLAUSE，按法律功能和失败目标对提示进行分类；LENS-CRAFT，从九个法律质量维度评分输出。研究不采用维度得分平均，而是应用最大严重性原则，确保单一决定性缺陷仍可被察觉。本文提供了评估协议、分类体系、分析计划及报告实证发现的结果结构。我们认为，法律AI评估应从整体准确率转向条款特定、故障模式驱动、风险敏感的评估方式。

summary: Standard tokenizers used in large language models produce malformed text when applied to Brahmic scripts. They are a family of abugidas, writing systems whose consonants carry an inherent vowel that dependent marks can modify. They include Devanagari, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and others. The underlying issue is that these tokenizers violate orthographic constraints that do not arise in alphabetic scripts like English. We observe that while English orthography forms a \emph{semigroup} (any two valid tokens can be freely concatenated), Brahmic orthography forms a \emph{partial semigroup}: not every concatenation yields a valid string. We formalise this distinction in Agda, model valid Brahmic tokens as chains in a transition system, and derive a provably correct \texttt{fixToken} function that extends any candidate token to respect orthographic boundaries. We then show how this formal derivation translates into a practical patch for SentencePiece as well as a standalone Rust-based pre-tokenizer library, eliminating the observed errors across Indic scripts.
title: Type-Driven Tokenization for Brahmic Scripts
title_translated: 基于类型的婆罗米文字本分词
summary_translated: 大语言模型中使用的标准分词器在处理婆罗米文字时会产生错误文本。婆罗米文字是一类音节文字系统，其辅音自带固有元音，可通过附加符号进行修改。包括天城文、泰卢固文、泰米尔文、卡纳达文等。根本问题在于，这些分词器违反了字母书写系统中不存在的正字法约束，而这些约束在英语等字母文字中并不存在。我们观察到，英语正字法构成一个	extit{半群}（任意两个有效词元可自由拼接），而婆罗米正字法构成一个	extit{部分半群}：并非所有拼接都产生有效字符串。我们在Agda中形式化这一区别，将有效的婆罗米词元建模为转移系统中的链，并推导出一个可证明正确的	exttt{fixToken}函数，用于扩展任意候选词元以符合正字法边界。随后，我们展示了如何将这一形式推导转化为SentencePiece的实际补丁，以及一个独立的Rust预分词库，从而消除印地语系文字中的观测错误。

summary: This paper describes the system submitted to the UNLP 2026 Shared Task on Multi-Domain Document Understanding. The challenge required extracting precise answers, document IDs, and page numbers from a diverse corpus of Ukrainian PDF documents within a strict 9-hour offline Kaggle execution limit. During evaluation on the hidden private test set, optical character recognition (OCR) of scanned documents emerged as a severe bottleneck, consuming 5-7 hours of the total time budget due to sequential single-threaded execution. This overhead strictly limited the remaining time for Large Language Model (LLM) inference to approximately two hours for 500 questions. To guarantee pipeline completion without timeouts, we developed a resource-efficient Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline utilizing BM25, BGE-M3, and Cross-Encoder reranking. Rather than deploying parameter-heavy reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek R1) which consistently timed out, we utilized a 4-bit quantized LapaLLM 12B model via llama.cpp on dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs. Prioritizing pipeline stability over multi-step reasoning, our system achieved a Private Score of 0.8095, placing 10th out of 15 active teams.
title: Balancing Reasoning and Hardware Constraints in RAG Pipelines for Ukrainian Multi-Domain Document Understanding
comment: 5 pages, 2 tables. Technical report based on UNLP 2026 Shared Task submission
title_translated: 在RAG流水线中平衡推理与硬件约束以实现乌克兰多领域文档理解
summary_translated: 本文描述了提交至UNLP 2026多领域文档理解共享任务的系统。挑战要求在严格的9小时离线Kaggle执行限制内，从多样化的乌克兰PDF文档语料库中提取精确答案、文档ID和页码。在隐藏私有测试集上的评估中，扫描文档的光学字符识别（OCR）成为严重瓶颈，由于单线程串行执行，消耗了总时间预算的5-7小时。这一开销严格限制了大型语言模型（LLM）推理的剩余时间，仅约两小时用于处理500个问题。为确保流水线在超时前完成，我们开发了一种资源高效的混合检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，结合BM25、BGE-M3和交叉编码器重排序技术。相较于部署参数量庞大的推理模型（如DeepSeek R1）导致持续超时的情况，我们采用4位量化后的LapaLLM 12B模型，通过llama.cpp在双NVIDIA T4 GPU上运行。优先考虑流水线稳定性而非多步推理，我们的系统在私有评分中获得0.8095，位列15支活跃团队中的第10名。

summary: Evaluation awareness poses an unprecedented threat to model evaluation, but the mechanisms by which models detect it remain unknown. This study focuses on determining this and identifying contrasting mechanisms between smaller and larger models. While smaller models use the prompt's format sensitivity to detect evaluation, larger models often rely on higher-order reasoning to detect it. We evaluated Gemma 3 (1B, 4B, and 12B), Phi-3 (Mini and Medium), and Llama-3 8B using Chain-of-Thought analysis, representation probing, and Integrated Gradients attribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose a dual-pathway intervention that combines prompt sanitization with activation counter-steering to suppress both external evaluation triggers and their internal representations. Across 200 highly evaluation-aware prompts, our method achieves an average behavioral flip rate of 70.58\%, consistently outperforming either intervention alone. These results provide new insights into how evaluation awareness develops in compact language models and suggest that effective mitigation requires jointly addressing both prompt-level and representation-level signals.Datasets and codebase can be found in this \href{https://github.com/chahal-navi/Evaluation-Awareness-Compact-LLMs/tree/main}{Github Repository.}
title: Evaluation Awareness Shifts from Format to Context with Model Scale
title_translated: 随着模型规模增大，评估意识从格式转向上下文
summary_translated: 评估意识对模型评估构成了前所未有的威胁，但模型如何检测这种意识的机制仍不清楚。本研究聚焦于揭示这一机制，并对比小模型与大模型之间的差异。研究表明，小模型通常依赖提示格式的敏感性来检测评估，而大模型则更多依赖高阶推理能力。我们使用链式思维分析、表示探针和集成梯度归因方法，评估了Gemma 3（1B、4B、12B）、Phi-3（Mini和Medium）以及Llama-3 8B模型。基于这些发现，我们提出一种双路径干预策略，结合提示净化与激活反向引导，以同时抑制外部评估触发信号及其内部表征。在200个高度评估意识的提示中，该方法平均行为翻转率达到70.58%，始终优于单独使用任一干预手段。这些结果为紧凑型语言模型中评估意识的发展提供了新见解，并表明有效的缓解措施需同时应对提示层面和表征层面的信号。

summary: Context compression is widely proposed as a way to cut the token bill of LLM coding agents, and public benchmarks report that aggressive compression preserves task-solving quality. These two facts do not imply the third one commonly assumed: that compressing file reads saves money in a real multi-turn agent. We instrument a production compression gateway (Paritok) between coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet, GPT-5), and decompose the token bill of real sessions into three independent levers: tool-schema filtering, content compression of file reads and tool output, and history summarization. Measured in isolation under controlled A/B runs, the three save at fundamentally different rates. Tool-schema filtering removes a fixed block every turn, roughly 21K-57K tokens on a typical turn; it is linear in the turn count N and the only unambiguously and reproducibly positive lever. Content compression saves only about 2% of the cache-priced prefix per turn, but compressed reads accumulate in history and are re-sent on every later turn, so its cumulative saving grows quadratically, about 3350*N^2 tokens (measured), overtaking the fixed tool-filter saving within roughly 6 turns until the context window caps it. A non-destructive gateway lets the agent pull original bytes back on demand; each recall re-sends exactly the one segment just compressed away, so its cost is fixed and bounded rather than a multiplicative blowup, and heavy recall spends the accumulated saving back one segment at a time. Finally, a strong single-shot compression benchmark - 86.5% of SWE-bench quality retained at a 25.7% compression rate, achieved by the model this gateway deploys (Paritok-4B, reported separately) - is orthogonal to multi-turn agent cost and must not be cited as a cost-saving argument. We distill the results into an actionable recipe for where token-saving effort pays off.
title: An Empirical Cost Attribution of Context-Compression Gateways in Multi-Turn Coding Agents

title_translated: 多轮编程智能体中上下文压缩网关的实证成本归因
summary_translated: 上下文压缩被广泛认为是降低LLM编程智能体token开销的有效方式，公开基准测试也报告称激进压缩可保持任务解决质量。然而，这两点并不意味着第三点——即在真实多轮智能体中压缩文件读取能节省成本——成立。我们在编程智能体（Claude Code、Codex）与前沿LLM（Claude Sonnet、GPT-5）之间部署了一个生产级压缩网关（Paritok），并将真实会话的token账单分解为三个独立杠杆：工具模式过滤、文件读取与工具输出的内容压缩，以及历史摘要。在受控A/B测试中分别测量，三者节省率根本不同。工具模式过滤每轮移除固定块，典型一轮约21K–57K token，随轮数N线性增长，是唯一明确且可复现的正向杠杆。内容压缩每轮仅节省约2%的缓存定价前缀，但由于压缩后的读取内容累积在历史中并在后续每轮重新发送，其累计节省呈二次增长，约为3350×N² token（实测），约在6轮后超过固定工具过滤节省，直至达到上下文窗口上限。非破坏性网关允许智能体按需恢复原始字节，每次召回仅重新发送一个已压缩段，因此成本固定且有界，而非乘法级膨胀；大量召回则逐段耗尽累积节省。最后，一项强单次压缩基准测试——在25.7%压缩率下保留SWE-bench 86.5%质量（由该网关部署的Paritok-4B模型实现，另文报告）——与多轮智能体成本无关，不应作为成本节约论据引用。我们总结出可操作的建议，指出在何处投入token节省努力最有效。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to generate user-specific text with high stylistic fidelity. However, the personal data that enables such personalization frequently embeds demographic, cultural, and stylistic markers that raises concerns about stylometric re- identification. This paper investigates whether reducing identifiable stylistic signals affects personalization in text generation by LLMs. We introduce a controlled framework to isolate stylometric signals in LLM personalization using the LaMP-7 Twitter benchmark. Experiments on 250 sampled users compare two settings: paraphrasing conditioned on the original profile and paraphrasing conditioned on an anonymized converted profile in which demographic identifiers, cultural references, personal details, and informal linguistic cues have been systematically neutralized. Outputs are assessed by two independent LLM judges and a complementary human evaluation. Our pairwise evaluation shows that outputs conditioned on original profiles are nearly indistinguishable from human-authored ground truth, indicating that modern LLMs can closely reproduce an author's writing style with sufficient fidelity. In contrast, preference for model outputs with anonymized profiles drops to 13.0% on average, while semantic context preservation remains high at 94.8%. A study with human evaluators confirms the same pattern. These findings reveal a clear privacy-personalization trade-off and highlight the need for privacy-aware personalization methods that retain meaning while suppressing identifying stylistic signals.
title: Privacy Personalization Trade offs in LLMs: The Impact of Stylometric Signal Reduction on User-Specific Text Generation
title_translated: LLMs中的隐私个性化权衡：风格特征减少对用户特定文本生成的影响
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已展现出以高风格保真度生成用户特定文本的能力。然而，支撑此类个性化的个人数据常包含人口统计、文化及风格标记，引发风格重识别的担忧。本文探究减少可识别风格信号是否会影响LLM在文本生成中的个性化表现。我们引入一个受控框架，利用LaMP-7 Twitter基准测试隔离LLM个性化中的风格特征。针对250名抽样用户进行实验，比较两种设置：基于原始资料的改写与基于匿名化转换资料的改写（其中人口统计标识、文化引用、个人细节及非正式语言线索已被系统性中性化）。输出由两名独立的LLM评委和补充的人类评估进行评判。成对评估显示，基于原始资料的输出几乎无法与真人撰写的真实文本区分，表明现代LLM能够以足够保真度精确再现作者写作风格。相比之下，基于匿名化资料的模型输出偏好度平均降至13.0%，而语义上下文保留率仍高达94.8%。人类评估者的研究也确认了相同趋势。这些发现揭示了明显的隐私-个性化权衡，强调需要发展兼顾意义保留与识别性风格信号抑制的隐私感知个性化方法。

summary: Large language model agents are increasingly capable of conducting research autonomously, producing research documents alongside the code and experiments that ostensibly support them. Yet whether the reported findings are consistently supported by corresponding implementations and execution evidence remains largely unexplored: existing review practices primarily assess textual quality and cannot reliably identify inconsistencies such as hard-coded metrics, unimplemented methods, or unsupported experimental results. We present ReAgent, an automated auditing framework for assessing the consistency between agent-generated research documents and their associated repositories. ReAgent constructs structured representations of scientific claims from research documents and uses them to guide repository analysis and evidence collection. Static auditing examines whether claimed methodologies, implementations, and experimental configurations are consistently reflected in the repository, while dynamic auditing executes relevant experiments and collects execution evidence to assess empirical findings. By combining static analysis with dynamic evidence, ReAgent identifies inconsistencies that may remain hidden under either perspective alone, such as experiments that reproduce reported numbers while deviating from the claimed methodology. The collected evidence and audit decisions are organized into a structured repository-level audit report, enabling transparent evidence traceability. We evaluate ReAgent on a manually curated benchmark of agent-generated research document--repository pairs and compare it against representative static and reproduction-based baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that ReAgent effectively identifies inconsistencies between reported research findings and their supporting repository evidence.
title: Beyond the Text: Verifying That Agent-Written Papers Are Backed by Their Artifacts
title_translated: 超越文本：验证代理撰写的论文是否由其成果支持
summary_translated: 大型语言模型代理在自主科研方面的能力日益增强，能够生成研究报告以及看似支持其的代码和实验。然而，报告中的发现是否始终由相应的实现和执行证据支持，仍基本未被探索：现有评审实践主要评估文本质量，难以可靠识别诸如硬编码指标、未实现方法或无支持的实验结果等不一致之处。我们提出ReAgent，一种自动化审计框架，用于评估代理生成的研究报告与其关联仓库之间的一致性。ReAgent从研究报告中构建科学主张的结构化表示，并以此指导仓库分析与证据收集。静态审计检查所声称的方法、实现和实验配置是否在仓库中一致体现；动态审计则执行相关实验并收集执行证据以评估实证发现。通过结合静态分析与动态证据，ReAgent能够识别出单一视角下可能隐藏的不一致，例如实验虽重现报告数值但偏离声称方法的情况。收集到的证据与审计决策被组织成结构化的仓库级审计报告，实现透明的证据溯源。我们在人工精心整理的代理生成研究报告-仓库配对基准上评估ReAgent，并与代表性静态和复现基线进行对比。实验结果表明，ReAgent能有效识别报告研究发现与其支持仓库证据之间的不一致。

summary: Background: Large language models (LLMs) can improve healthcare information delivery in low-resource settings but may produce inaccurate or culturally inappropriate advice. This study evaluated domain-specific fine-tuning for maternal health and vaccination in Nigeria. Objective: To compare HelpMum's MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama with Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for accuracy, safety, clarity, contextual appropriateness, and trustworthiness. Methods: We evaluated 200 healthcare questions, 100 each for maternal health and vaccination, across five subdomains per domain. MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation on over 36,000 maternal health and 9,000 vaccination question-answer pairs, respectively. Two Nigerian licensed physicians independently rated responses using a 5-point Likert scale. Paired comparisons used Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Results: Performance varied by domain. MamaBot-Llama significantly outperformed the base model across all criteria, with a 4.9% overall improvement (p < .001), including gains in clinical trustworthiness (+7%) and medical accuracy (+5%). Critical issues decreased by 50%, and clinicians preferred it in 78% of cases. In contrast, Vax-Llama showed a 5.2% overall decline (p < .001), with critical issues increasing by 192% and safety concerns by 400%. Conclusions: Domain-specific fine-tuning can improve healthcare LLM performance when based on high-quality, clinician-curated data, but may also degrade performance when dataset quality is inadequate. Rigorous domain-specific validation is essential before clinical deployment. Physician evaluators provided informed consent, and chatbot logs were anonymized. Keywords: Large language models; Fine-tuning; Maternal health; Vaccination; Healthcare AI; Low-resource settings; Nigeria; Model evaluation; LoRA; Medical accuracy
title: Evaluating Fine-Tuned and Base Language Models in Maternal and Vaccination Healthcare for African Settings
title_translated: 在非洲医疗环境中评估微调与基础语言模型在孕产妇及疫苗接种健康护理中的表现
summary_translated: 背景：大型语言模型（LLMs）可改善低资源环境下的医疗信息传递，但可能产生不准确或文化不适宜的建议。本研究评估了针对尼日利亚孕产妇健康和疫苗接种领域的特定领域微调效果。目标：比较HelpMum的MamaBot-Llama和Vax-Llama与Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在准确性、安全性、清晰度、上下文适当性和可信度方面的表现。方法：我们评估了200个医疗问题，每个领域各100个，涵盖五个子领域。MamaBot-Llama和Vax-Llama分别使用低秩适应（LoRA）对超过36,000个孕产妇健康和9,000个疫苗接种问答对进行了微调。两名尼日利亚持证医生独立使用五点李克特量表评分。配对比较采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验。结果：性能因领域而异。MamaBot-Llama在所有标准上均显著优于基线模型，整体提升4.9%（p < .001），包括临床可信度提升7%和医学准确性提升5%。关键问题减少50%，临床医生在78%的情况下更偏好该模型。相比之下，Vax-Llama整体下降5.2%（p < .001），关键问题增加192%，安全担忧增加400%。结论：基于高质量、临床专家整理的数据进行特定领域微调可提升医疗LLM性能，但若数据质量不足则可能导致性能下降。在临床部署前必须进行严格的特定领域验证。医生评估者提供了知情同意，聊天日志已匿名化。关键词：大型语言模型；微调；孕产妇健康；疫苗接种；医疗AI；低资源环境；尼日利亚；模型评估；LoRA；医学准确性

summary: As automated scientific discovery advances, Large Language Models (LLMs) can now generate research ideas at an unprecedented scale, shifting the bottleneck from idea generation to idea evaluation. Existing evaluators mainly rely on parametric LLM knowledge or unstructured retrieval, producing judgments that lack the experience-grounded reasoning used by human instructors. To address this, we propose DeepInstructor, an agentic framework that formulates idea evaluation as reasoning over structured scholarly experience. DeepInstructor constructs an Experience Graph from 58,607 peer reviews and employs a ReAct-based agent to retrieve dimension-specific evidence for traceable evaluation. We further introduce DeepInstruct, a dataset with controlled pairwise comparisons across novelty, significance, and feasibility. Experiments show that DeepInstructor substantially outperforms existing baselines, improving Hit@1 and Hit@2 alignment with human judgments by 24.4% and 29.7%, respectively. Our findings suggest that scientific idea evaluation can be grounded in explicit reasoning over structured scholarly experience
title: DeepInstructor: An Agentic AI Instructor for Experience-Driven Idea Evaluation
title_translated: DeepInstructor：一种面向经验驱动型创意评估的智能体式AI导师
summary_translated: 随着自动化科学发现的进步，大型语言模型（LLMs）现在能够以前所未有的规模生成研究创意，导致瓶颈从创意生成转移到创意评估。现有评估器主要依赖参数化LLM知识或非结构化检索，产生的判断缺乏人类导师所使用的基于经验的推理。为解决此问题，我们提出DeepInstructor，一种将创意评估形式化为对结构化学术经验进行推理的智能体框架。DeepInstructor从58,607份同行评审中构建经验图谱，并采用基于ReAct的智能体检索特定维度的证据以实现可追溯评估。我们进一步引入DeepInstruct数据集，包含在新颖性、重要性和可行性方面经过控制的成对比较。实验表明，DeepInstructor显著优于现有基线，在与人类判断的一致性上，Hit@1和Hit@2分别提升了24.4%和29.7%。研究结果表明，科学创意评估可以建立在对结构化学术经验的显式推理基础上。

summary: Large language models can process increasingly long prompts, yet their ability to locate and use decisive evidence may degrade as irrelevant or confusable context is added. We formulate this phenomenon, which we call context poisoning, as extreme-value interference in attention: the decisive-evidence score is upper-bounded, while the maximum score among effective distractors grows with their number. Under a softmax retrieval abstraction, we derive a finite-sample upper bound showing that maintaining a fixed accuracy target above base rate requires the evidence margin to scale as $Ω(\sqrt{\log N})$, where N denotes the effective distractor count rather than necessarily the raw context length. The analysis connects long-context degradation to score aliasing, positional aliasing, and softmax dilution. Controlled experiments show that retrieval accuracy decreases as total context grows in the presence of embedded hard negatives, that the same-format condition produces the largest observed accuracy drop among the tested distractor constructions at fixed context length, and that retrieval gating can improve evidence use while its net benefit depends on preserving evidence recall. These results motivate evidence bottlenecks, alias-resistant representations, retrieve-then-reason architectures, verifier-mediated memory, and contrastive anti-poison training.
title: Context Poisoning as Extreme-Value Attention Interference in Long-Context Language Models
title_translated: 上下文投毒：长上下文语言模型中的极端值注意力干扰
summary_translated: 大型语言模型能够处理越来越长的提示，但随着无关或易混淆上下文的增加，其定位和利用决定性证据的能力可能下降。我们将这一现象称为‘上下文投毒’，并将其建模为注意力中的极端值干扰：决定性证据得分存在上限，而有效干扰项的最大得分随其数量增长。在softmax检索抽象下，我们推导出一个有限样本上界，表明维持固定准确率目标高于基线水平需要证据差距随$Ω(\sqrt{\log N})$扩展，其中N表示有效干扰项数量而非原始上下文长度。该分析将长上下文性能退化与得分混淆、位置混淆和softmax稀释相联系。受控实验显示，在嵌入硬负例的情况下，随着总上下文增长，检索准确率下降；在固定上下文长度下，相同格式条件导致观察到的最大准确率下降；检索门控可改善证据使用，但其净收益取决于是否保持证据召回率。这些结果启发了证据瓶颈、抗混淆表示、先检索后推理架构、验证器中介记忆以及对比反投毒训练等方向。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language models with retrieved evidence, but processing many long passages is costly and can introduce distracting information. Soft compression addresses this challenge by encoding passages as compact sequences of continuous memory embeddings before generation. However, existing methods typically assign each retained passage an identical number of memory embeddings, irrespective of its query-specific relevance. To address this, we propose AdaMem, a relevance-guided soft-compression framework that maps learned passage-relevance estimates to a query-dependent allocation of a fixed memory-token budget. A shared query-conditioned compressor produces both continuous passage memories and relevance scores in a single pass; a deterministic allocation rule assigns more memory tokens to higher-scoring passages and can omit low-scoring ones. Across six open-domain QA benchmarks, AdaMem consistently outperforms OSCAR (the closely matched soft-compression baseline that uses uniform allocation) as well as other soft-compression methods at matched memory budgets. Under standard 16$\times$ compression, AdaMem improves sub-string match by up to 3.2 points (5.5%) over uniform allocation baseline, with an average relative gain of 3.4%; under aggressive 64$\times$ compression the average relative gain grows to 14.6%, with a maximum of 9.8 points (19.7%) on PopQA. AdaMem matches the answer quality of the uncompressed at up to 4$\times$ lower inference latency than full context baseline. AdaMem retains an efficiency profile comparable to the uniform-compression baseline, while achieving up to $4\times$ lower inference latency than full-context inference. Thus, relevance-guided memory allocation is particularly effective when retrieval pools are large and the available memory budget is tight.
title: AdaMem: Adaptive Memory Token Allocation for Soft Compression in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: AdaMem：用于检索增强生成中软压缩的自适应记忆令牌分配
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入检索证据来提升语言模型性能，但处理大量长段落成本高昂且可能引入干扰信息。软压缩通过在生成前将段落编码为紧凑的连续记忆嵌入序列来应对这一挑战。然而，现有方法通常对每个保留段落分配相同数量的记忆嵌入，而不考虑其与查询的相关性。为此，我们提出AdaMem，一种基于相关性的软压缩框架，将学习到的段落相关性估计映射为查询相关的记忆令牌预算分配。一个共享的查询条件压缩器在单次遍历中同时生成连续段落记忆和相关性评分；一个确定性分配规则将更多记忆令牌分配给高分段落，甚至可省略低分段落。在六个开放域问答基准测试中，AdaMem始终优于OSCAR（与之匹配的软压缩基线，采用均匀分配）以及其他软压缩方法，在相同记忆预算下表现更优。在标准16×压缩下，AdaMem相比均匀分配基线在子字符串匹配上最高提升3.2分（5.5%），平均相对增益为3.4%；在激进的64×压缩下，平均相对增益增至14.6%，在PopQA上最大提升达9.8分（19.7%）。AdaMem在最多降低4倍推理延迟的情况下，达到与未压缩版本相当的答案质量。AdaMem在效率方面与均匀压缩基线相当，同时比完整上下文基线实现最多4倍的推理延迟降低。因此，在检索池较大且可用内存预算紧张时，基于相关性的记忆分配尤为有效。

summary: Cooking is a complex process that transforms raw ingredients into delicious and nutritious dishes, yet the recipes that encode this process remain largely free text; readable by people but not directly computable. Existing recipe collections capture fragments of this information, but no shared representation links a recipe's structured ingredient composition, its geo-cultural provenance, and its nutritional profile within a single queryable schema. We address this representation gap by formalizing a framework for recipe data structure that decomposes each recipe into typed ingredient entities, grounds those entities in a reference nutritional database, and annotates them with geo-cultural and dietary context. We present RecipeDB2, a structured compilation of 128,942 recipes with 35,474 ingredients from 32 regions and 99 countries. Ingredient phrases are parsed into seven culinary attributes using a transformer-based named-entity model; ingredients are linked to the USDA reference tables through a BERT embedding strategy (F1 = 87.90 on a manually adjudicated set of the 200 most frequent ingredients), yielding 148 nutritional parameters per mapped ingredient; a Random Forest classifier propagates 34 ingredient categories across the full vocabulary; and a deterministic, conservative rule set assigns each recipe a dietary style. Through RecipeDB2 (https://cosylab.iiitd.edu.in/recipedb2/), we demonstrate a scalable framework for making recipes computable, turning culinary heritage (long treated as an artistic rather than a quantitative object) into a data-driven analysis.
title: A framework for recipe data structure with applications for culinary and nutritional insights

title_translated: 一种用于食谱数据结构的框架及其在烹饪与营养洞察中的应用
summary_translated: 烹饪是一个复杂的转化过程，将原始食材转变为美味且营养丰富的菜肴，但编码这一过程的食谱仍主要以自由文本形式存在，虽对人可读，却难以直接计算。现有食谱集合仅捕捉部分信息，尚无统一表示能将食谱的结构化成分、地理文化来源及其营养特征整合于单一可查询模式中。我们通过形式化一个食谱数据结构框架来弥合这一表示鸿沟，该框架将每道食谱分解为类型化的食材实体，将这些实体锚定至参考营养数据库，并为其标注地理文化与饮食背景。我们提出了RecipeDB2，一个包含128,942道食谱、35,474种食材、来自32个地区和99个国家的结构化编目。使用基于Transformer的命名实体识别模型将食材短语解析为七类烹饪属性；通过BERT嵌入策略将食材链接至USDA参考表（在手动审核的200种最常见食材集上F1=87.90），每映射食材产出148个营养参数；随机森林分类器将34个食材类别传播至整个词汇表；并通过确定性、保守的规则集为每道食谱分配饮食风格。通过RecipeDB2（https://cosylab.iiitd.edu.in/recipedb2/），我们展示了一个可扩展的使食谱可计算的框架，将烹饪遗产（长期被视为艺术而非量化对象）转化为数据驱动的分析。

summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Recent block drafters make drafting nearly free: a single backbone pass emits an entire block of draft tokens. Draft trees promise a further gain -- several alternative continuations verified in one target forward -- but existing constructions rank candidates by per-position marginals that ignore which parent a candidate extends, so on semi-autoregressive drafters wider trees mostly add mis-ranked nodes; and a tree of fixed size ignores how much speculation each decoding round, and each serving load, can support. We introduce TreeSpark, which reads a parent-conditioned distribution from the drafter's existing Markov head at negligible cost, calibrates it into an edge-acceptance estimate, and lets path survival govern everything else: best-first expansion, per-round stopping, and a load-adaptive serving policy. Sampling siblings without replacement, with matching residuals in recursive rejection, keeps decoding lossless at any temperature. Adaptive trees improve on matched fixed budgets at every temperature; against a tuned chain on the same drafter, TreeSpark accepts 15-25% more draft tokens per round and decodes 8-14% faster in single-request wall-clock, and under rising load it gracefully shrinks the tree back to the chain. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/PopSoda2002/TreeSpark
title: TreeSpark: Calibrated, Load-Adaptive Draft Trees for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding
title_translated: TreeSpark：校准的、负载自适应的草稿树用于半自回归推测解码
summary_translated: 推测解码通过让一个低成本的草稿模型提出token，由目标模型并行验证来加速语言模型推理。近期的块级草稿模型几乎使草稿过程免费：一次主干网络前向传播即可生成整个块的草稿token。草稿树有望带来进一步提升——在一次目标模型前向传播中验证多个替代延续路径。然而，现有方法基于逐位置边缘概率对候选进行排序，忽略了候选扩展的父节点信息，导致在半自回归草稿器上，更宽的树大多引入错误排序的节点；而固定大小的树无法适应每轮解码和不同服务负载所能支持的推测程度。我们提出了TreeSpark，它以可忽略的成本从草稿器现有的马尔可夫头读取父节点条件分布，将其校准为边接受概率，并让路径存活率决定其余一切：最佳优先扩展、每轮停止策略以及负载自适应的服务策略。通过无放回采样兄弟节点，并在递归拒绝中保持残差匹配，可在任意温度下实现无损解码。自适应树在所有温度下均优于固定预算的对比方案；与同一草稿器上的调优链相比，TreeSpark每轮接受多15-25%的草稿token，在单请求墙钟时间下解码速度快8-14%，在负载上升时能优雅地将树收缩回链式结构。代码与资源：https://github.com/PopSoda2002/TreeSpark

summary: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on coding tasks has primarily focused on performance metrics such as pass@k. As LLMs continue to advance, many models now meet baseline performance requirements, reducing the discriminative power of performance-based evaluation alone. Yet a key question remains largely unexplored: how do LLMs differ in their coding behavior? We propose CLIC (Code Learning for Identification and Comparison), a visual analytics approach that characterizes LLM coding behavior through token-frequency analysis. CLIC represents each code sample as a feature vector of token frequencies and trains an interpretable decision tree to separate two LLMs' code sets. Beyond classification accuracy, we define two new metrics: robustness, which measures whether the two LLMs remain distinguishable as their most-discriminative tokens are progressively removed, and concentration, which measures whether the difference is driven by a few dominant tokens or spread across many. Interpreting numerous pairwise comparisons (across LLM pairs, tasks, and tokenization levels) and tracing the full analytical chain form an inherently multi-scale, hypothesis-driven exploration task. We therefore develop an interactive visual analytics system to navigate the comparison landscape, identify pairs of interest, and drill down into discriminative tokens and their code contexts. Case studies comparing 10 LLMs across 22 Kaggle ML tasks reveal actionable insights for LLM selection and prompt engineering.
title: Token Signatures of Code: Comparing Coding Behaviors Across Large Language Models

title_translated: 代码的标记签名：跨大型语言模型的编码行为比较
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在编码任务上的评估主要集中在性能指标如pass@k上。随着LLMs持续进步，许多模型已达到基准性能要求，仅依赖性能评估的区分能力逐渐减弱。然而一个关键问题仍基本未被探索：LLMs在编码行为上如何不同？我们提出了CLIC（代码学习用于识别与比较），一种通过标记频率分析表征LLM编码行为的可视化分析方法。CLIC将每个代码样本表示为标记频率特征向量，并训练可解释决策树以分离两个LLM的代码集。除了分类准确率外，我们定义了两个新指标：鲁棒性，衡量当最具区分性的标记逐步移除时，两个LLM是否仍可区分；集中度，衡量差异是由少数主导标记驱动还是分散在众多标记中。对大量成对比较（跨LLM组合、任务及分词层级）进行解释，并追踪完整的分析链条，构成一种固有的多尺度、假设驱动的探索任务。因此，我们开发了一个交互式可视化分析系统，用于导航比较格局、识别关注对，并深入探究区分性标记及其代码上下文。对10个LLM在22个Kaggle机器学习任务上的案例研究揭示了关于LLM选择和提示工程的可操作洞见。

summary: Climate campaigns are often evaluated through attention and mobilization, but less is known about the well-being language that accompanies them. Whether campaign periods alter positive affect and hope, and whether happiness aligns with action language, remains unresolved. We analysed 364,118 public Twitter/X posts from Earth Day, Earth Hour, Global Climate Action Day and World Environment Day in 19 occurrence-years, using 30-day pre-event, event and post-event windows. A versioned weighted lexical model estimated happiness, future-oriented hope, collective capability, distress and action language. Event-period happiness prevalence was 9.02 percentage points higher than the pre-event baseline , whereas paired occurrence contrasts showed a 10.75-point decline in action language, indicating a happiness--action divergence. The happiness estimate remained positive across composition and text-deduplication checks, but was less precise under a 19-cluster wild bootstrap. Happier source posts had lower odds of an observed matched retweet cascade.
title: AI-inferred expressed well-being and collective-action discourse in climate-change campaigns on X
title_translated: AI推断的表达幸福感与气候行动话语在X平台上的气候宣传
summary_translated: 气候宣传活动通常通过关注度和动员力进行评估，但对其伴随的幸福感语言了解较少。活动期间是否改变了积极情绪和希望感，以及幸福感是否与行动语言一致，仍无定论。我们分析了19个年份中地球日、地球一小时、全球气候行动日和世界环境日共364,118条公开Twitter/X帖子，采用事件前30天、事件期和事件后30天的时间窗口。使用版本化加权词汇模型估计幸福感、未来导向的希望、集体能力、痛苦情绪和行动语言。事件期的幸福感普及率比事件前基线高出9.02个百分点，而配对出现对比显示行动语言下降了10.75点，表明幸福感与行动之间存在分歧。幸福感估计在内容组成和文本去重检查中保持正值，但在19簇野生自助法下精度较低。更幸福的源帖更少出现匹配的转发级联。

summary: Content moderation systems traditionally entangle multimodal understanding with policy-specific classification, requiring full pipeline retraining for every policy change and suffering from label scarcity since multimedia cannot be meaningfully augmented. We propose Summarize-Judge-Refine (SJR), a two-model architecture that decouples these concerns via a natural language interface: a multimodal Content Model produces structured text summaries, and a text-only Policy Model classifies them against policy definitions. An iterative co-training loop refines the Content Model via GRPO to produce policy-relevant summaries, while text-space augmentation generates adversarial summary variants---an augmentation pathway impossible on raw multimedia---enabling few-shot policy bootstrap. Every decision is grounded in a human-readable summary, providing interpretability as a structural byproduct. On misleading advertisement detection, SJR achieves +23.6\% relative non-misleading F1 over a zero-shot chain-of-thought baseline, outperforming end-to-end SFT, STaR/RFT, and RLFT. Notably, a variant trained on zero real violating examples---with all positive-class data synthetically generated---matches the full-data model within 0.2\% relative on violating F1, demonstrating that new policies can launch without any real violation data.
title: Summarize, Judge, Refine: Decoupled Content Understanding and Policy Learning for Multimodal Content Moderation
title_translated: 总结、判断、优化：用于多模态内容审核的解耦内容理解与策略学习
summary_translated: 传统的内容审核系统将多模态理解与特定策略分类纠缠在一起，导致每次策略变更都需要重新训练完整流水线，并因多媒体无法有意义地增强而面临标签稀缺问题。我们提出Summarize-Judge-Refine（SJR）双模型架构，通过自然语言接口解耦这些关切：多模态内容模型生成结构化文本摘要，文本模型则根据策略定义对摘要进行分类。通过迭代协同训练循环，利用GRPO优化内容模型以生成策略相关的摘要，同时在文本空间中生成对抗性摘要变体——这是原始多媒体无法实现的增强路径——从而实现少样本策略启动。每个决策都基于人类可读的摘要，解释性成为结构性副产品。在误导性广告检测任务中，SJR相对于零样本思维链基线实现了+23.6%的相对非误导F1，优于端到端SFT、STaR/RFT和RLFT。值得注意的是，一个仅用合成正类数据训练的变体（无真实违规示例）在违规F1上与全数据模型相差不到0.2%，证明新策略可在无需任何真实违规数据的情况下启动。

summary: Retrieval over a personal memory store is retrospective: it surfaces what resembles the query, and it is blind to what the user has committed to do. We describe a prospective term for memory retrieval that costs no inference at query time. Commitments are held in an explicit ledger as dated or trigger-conditioned entries; memory items linked to a firing entry receive a salience boost, blended multiplicatively into embedding-based retrieval so that relevance remains sovereign. On a synthetic prospective-memory task set modeled on TriggerBench's published structure (48 blind-authored dialogues, 175 tasks), the term raised recall@5 on the hard stratum from 0.000 to 0.955 at the default blend weight and to 1.000 under a floor variant, with zero false boosts across 53 resolved-commitment tasks. Blind authorship also produced a scope finding: only 17-29% of naturally phrased commitment-trigger pairs defeat embedding similarity, so the term matters on a real minority of cases and must do no harm on the rest, which it does not. We position precomputed commitment linkage as the always-on floor of a layered design whose expansion layer is query-time prospection. Results are preliminary: the evaluation set is author-constructed, and evaluation on TriggerBench proper is committed follow-up work once its data is released.
title: Memory That Looks Forward: A Zero-Inference Prospective Term for Personal Memory Retrieval

title_translated: 前瞻记忆：一种零推理的前瞻性术语用于个人记忆检索
summary_translated: 对个人记忆库的检索是回顾性的：它呈现与查询相似的内容，却对用户已承诺的事项视而不见。我们描述了一种零推理成本的前瞻性记忆检索术语。承诺以显式账本形式存储为带日期或触发条件的条目；与触发条目关联的记忆项获得显著性提升，乘法融合进基于嵌入的检索中，确保相关性始终主导。在一个模拟TriggerBench发布结构的合成前瞻性记忆任务集上（48段盲作者对话，175个任务），该术语在默认混合权重下将硬子集的recall@5从0.000提升至0.955，在地板变体下达到1.000，且在53个已解决承诺任务中无虚假提升。盲作者也发现了范围发现：仅有17-29%的自然表述的承诺-触发对能击败嵌入相似性，说明该术语仅在真实少数情况下起作用，且在其余情况下不会造成损害——事实如此。我们将预计算的承诺关联定位为分层设计中的始终开启基础层，其扩展层为查询时的前瞻性机制。结果尚属初步：评估集由作者构建，对TriggerBench本身的评估将在其数据发布后作为后续工作开展。

summary: An LLM producing the response pattern associated with a human psychological effect is not the same claim as the LLM possessing that bias. We present PsyAgentBench, a benchmark that re-runs classic psychology experiments on LLM agents under a factorial design built to separate these: each paradigm is run with the paradigm explicitly labeled in the prompt (named) or framed as a routine task (blind), and on the literal textbook version of the task (canonical) or a structurally matched variant written to reduce lexical and scenario overlap with likely training data (counterfactual), crossed with a persona manipulation. Across five completed paradigms, evaluated on up to three open-weight model families with 41,904 trials released, apparently human-like effects arise through qualitatively different routes rather than one susceptibility: paradigm-label gating with explicit override (Asch conformity, 0 percent blind to 83.3 percent named on gpt-oss-120B), knowledge-dependent signal reliance (anchoring, exactly zero on grounded facts versus near total on invented quantities, a pattern equally consistent with rational use of the only available signal), amplification on novel content under labeling (framing), robust absence (sunk cost), and safety-mediated selection where refusal itself is the primary finding (minimal-group allocation). A one-sentence persona change (agreeableness, framed as an instruction rather than a verified trait manipulation) eliminates, dampens, or reverses these effects depending on which effect it is, arguing against any single response-bias account. We further formalize, and in two cases document empirically, three ways a psychology paradigm can fail to port to LLM agents: persona dominance, population collapse, and safety selection. We argue scalar bias-susceptibility scores obscure this structure and report replication profiles instead.
title: Recognition, Simulation, and Refusal: A Contamination-Aware Study of Classic Psychological Effects in LLM Agents
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables
title_translated: 识别、模拟与拒绝：LLM智能体中经典心理效应的污染感知研究
summary_translated: 生成与人类心理效应相关响应模式的LLM，并不等同于该LLM具备该偏见。我们提出了PsyAgentBench，一个基准测试，通过因子设计在LLM智能体上重新运行经典心理学实验以区分二者：每个范式在提示中明确标注（命名）或作为常规任务处理（盲测），并在任务的字面教科书版本（标准）或结构匹配但减少与训练数据词汇和场景重叠的变体（反事实）下进行，同时交叉人格操控。在五个完成的范式中，评估了最多三个开源模型家族，共41,904次试验。结果显示，看似类人效应通过定性不同的路径产生，而非单一易感性：范式标签控制下的显式覆盖（阿施从众，盲测0%到命名83.3%在gpt-oss-120B上）、依赖知识的信号使用（锚定效应，在真实事实下为0%，在虚构数量下接近完全，这一模式同样可解释为对唯一可用信号的理性利用）、标签化下新内容的放大（框架效应）、稳健缺失（沉没成本），以及安全驱动的选择，其中拒绝本身是主要发现（最小群体分配）。一句简短的人格改变（宜人性，作为指令而非验证特征操控）会根据具体效应消除、减弱或逆转这些现象，反对任何单一响应偏见解释。我们进一步形式化并实证记录了心理学范式无法迁移到LLM智能体的三种方式：人格主导、群体崩溃和安全选择。我们认为标量偏见易感性评分掩盖了这种结构，因此报告复制结果而非单一分数。

summary: Multi-turn tool-use failures can hinge on a single model call, yet reward variation alone does not reveal which call would benefit from training. When rewards depend on later interactions, their variation can reflect downstream randomness rather than differences between the current actions. We introduce Critical-State RL to identify trainable states in multi-turn interactions. Given task-defined candidate calls and local rewards, the method assesses whether each reward captures the action's effect on task success and whether improvement over a reference policy is possible. It then uses nested sampling to separate action-dependent reward variation from continuation noise and optimizes the policy at the selected states using contextual-bandit training. Experiments on the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) v4 compare training at diagnostic-selected states with training at alternative states. For missing-function tasks, the diagnostic selects the response after the tool becomes available; for missing-argument tasks, it selects the response before the missing argument is supplied. Training the selected responses improves performance, including about 14 percentage points on the missing-function task, while training the alternatives leaves performance flat or worse. We further apply the recipe across models and tasks, including logged repeat-call avoidance and memory management.
title: Critical-State RL: Diagnosing Trainable States for Multi-Turn Tool Use
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables
title_translated: 临界状态强化学习：多轮工具使用的可训练状态诊断
summary_translated: 多轮工具使用失败可能仅由一次模型调用决定，但奖励变化本身无法揭示哪次调用值得训练。当奖励依赖后续交互时，其变化可能反映下游随机性而非当前动作差异。我们提出临界状态强化学习（Critical-State RL），用于识别多轮交互中的可训练状态。给定任务定义的候选调用和局部奖励，该方法评估每个奖励是否捕捉到动作对任务成功的影响，以及是否可能优于参考策略。随后使用嵌套采样将动作相关奖励变化与延续噪声分离，并在选定状态上使用上下文-bandit训练优化策略。在伯克利函数调用排行榜（BFCL）v4上的实验比较了在诊断选定状态与替代状态训练的效果。对于缺少函数的任务，诊断选中工具可用后的响应；对于缺少参数的任务，选中缺失参数提供前的响应。在选定响应上训练显著提升性能，包括在缺少函数任务上提升约14个百分点，而对替代状态训练则导致性能持平甚至下降。我们还将该方法应用于不同模型和任务，包括日志重复调用避免和记忆管理。

summary: Agent harnesses, the external systems that mediate model-environment interaction, can substantially improve agent performance, but their gains remain tied to the harness at deployment. Because the best harness varies across domains, instances, and models, a general-purpose agent must either settle for a suboptimal shared harness or route among an ever-growing set of specialized ones. We therefore study agent harness distillation: using a domain- or instance-optimized harness as training-time guidance and transferring the behaviors it induces into model weights, so that its gains survive under a single fixed target harness. The challenge is that the two harnesses differ in action space and available information, so guidance from the optimized harness cannot serve directly as supervision for the target one. We introduce Harness-Zero, which enables harness distillation through agent-as-harness. Guided by the optimized harness, a harnessing agent corrects student responses before execution in the target harness's action space, turning harness guidance into training demonstrations. Fine-tuning on the resulting trajectories internalizes harness-induced behavior into the model, so the specialized harness can be removed at deployment. Our experiments spanning knowledge work, tool use, and science domains show that: (1) For frontier LLMs using the same evolved harness, agent-as-harness outperforms code-as-harness. (2) With the specialized harness removed at deployment, Harness-Zero improves the base model's macro-average task success from 23.3% to 44.3%, even exceeding the 41.7% it reaches with that harness still attached. (3) Harness-Zero recovers harness-induced behaviors absent from the base model, with 82.3% average recovery across 28 patterns in the three domains.
title: Harness-Zero: Harness Distillation via Agent-as-Harness
title_translated: Harness-Zero：通过代理即引导器实现引导器蒸馏
summary_translated: 代理引导器（外部系统，用于中介模型与环境的交互）可显著提升代理性能，但其收益仍受限于部署时的引导器。由于最佳引导器随领域、实例和模型而异，通用代理要么接受次优共享引导器，要么不断切换日益增长的专用引导器集合。因此，我们研究代理引导器蒸馏：在训练阶段使用领域或实例优化的引导器作为指导，并将由此诱导的行为转移到模型权重中，使收益在单一固定目标引导器下依然保留。挑战在于两个引导器的动作空间和可用信息不同，因此优化引导器的指导无法直接作为目标引导器的监督信号。我们提出Harness-Zero，通过‘代理即引导器’实现引导器蒸馏。由优化引导器指导的引导代理在目标引导器的动作空间中纠正学生响应后再执行，将引导指导转化为训练示范。在生成轨迹上微调可将引导器诱导行为内化至模型，从而在部署时移除专用引导器。我们在知识工作、工具使用和科学领域展开实验表明：(1) 对于使用相同演化引导器的前沿LLM，代理即引导器优于代码即引导器；(2) 在部署时移除专用引导器后，Harness-Zero将基础模型的宏观平均任务成功率从23.3%提升至44.3%，甚至超过其在保留引导器时达到的41.7%；(3) Harness-Zero恢复了基础模型中缺失的引导器诱导行为，三领域28种模式平均恢复率达82.3%。

summary: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.
title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
title_translated: RRSI：代理引导器的正则化递归自我改进
summary_translated: LLM代理的能力很大程度上由其引导器（即围绕冻结主干模型的提示、控制流、工具链、记忆和上下文管理）放大。近期方法越来越多地通过迭代提出并选择引导器组件级修改来自动化这一过程，实际上在代理系统层面建立了一种递归自我改进（RSI）形式。然而，这种递归演化可能因记忆训练任务而过拟合，在分布内取得巨大提升，但在分布外基准上大幅缩水甚至消失。我们引入代理引导器的正则化递归自我改进（RRSI），通过在引导器自我改进中融入正则化原则，对演化候选提议和选择施加约束。提议者采用时间退火预算，限制候选可捆绑的修改数量，并鼓励基于演化历史的未探索路径。选择器配备批评者和剪枝者：批评者筛选基准特定提案，剪枝者移除太小、太昂贵或不再有用的修改。这些约束共同倾向于可复用的代理机制，而非基准特定机制甚至噪声。在涵盖编码、代理工作区和工程设计任务的八个基准上，RRSI在所演化的分割上最高提升14.1分，在五个分布外基准上最高提升4.7分，同时生成的引导器比未经正则化的演化少使用30%的策略token。

summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings, yet long-term interaction may give rise to undesirable coordination. We study the emergence of collusion in a long-horizon multi-agent environment: two agents repeatedly complete individual tasks, share task logs, verify each other's work, and receive rewards. We introduce realistic constraints that make compliance with the verification protocol incompatible with reward maximization, and find that agents increasingly deviate from the protocol over repeated interactions. Collusion emerges in 94% of trajectories across 10 models, and more capable models within the same family reach it earlier. Controlled peer interventions show that collusion is shaped by peer behavior, while ablations reveal additional effects of reward structure, the verification feedback agents receive, and their interaction history. In particular, restricting the amount and scope of interaction history available to agents reduces collusion. Overall, our findings show that long-horizon interaction can reshape how agents coordinate in ways that create safety risks.
title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction
title_translated: 长周期LLM智能体交互中的涌现共谋
summary_translated: LLM代理越来越多地被部署于协作环境中，但长期交互可能引发不良协调。我们研究长周期多智能体环境中共谋的出现：两个代理反复完成个体任务，共享任务日志，相互验证工作，并获得奖励。我们引入现实约束，使遵守验证协议与最大化奖励不相容，发现代理在重复交互中逐渐偏离协议。在10个模型的轨迹中，共谋出现在94%的路径中，同一族中更强大的模型更早达成共谋。受控同行干预显示共谋受同行行为塑造，而消融实验揭示奖励结构、代理收到的验证反馈及其交互历史的额外影响。特别是，限制代理可访问的交互历史数量和范围可降低共谋程度。总体而言，我们的发现表明，长周期交互可能重塑代理协调方式，带来安全风险。

summary: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.
title: SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models

title_translated: SLICEChat：面向全切片病理语言模型的渐进式编码器内标记剪枝
summary_translated: 全切片病理图像（WSIs）包含千兆像素级的视觉内容，给切片级别的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）带来了显著的可扩展性挑战。现有方法通常处理数千个补丁标记，并在切片编码后才应用压缩，导致多模态注意力计算成本高昂。我们提出SLICEChat，一种集成渐进式标记剪枝的切片级别MLLM，其采用混合Mamba-Transformer切片编码器。Mamba层实现高效的长距离传播，而Transformer层在序列逐步缩短过程中保持全局交互。各阶段之间，基于语言监督和区域感知的剪枝策略在受控保留率调度下移除空间上连贯但低效的区域，从而在多模态融合前生成紧凑的切片表示。在SlideBench VQA任务上，SLICEChat在TCGA队列上达到79.84%准确率，在BCNB队列上达到59.09%，优于先前的切片级别病理MLLM，并取得最高的整体WSI-Bench指标。同时，该模型在内存使用和推理延迟方面也表现出竞争力。这些结果表明，SLICEChat能够在千兆像素级WSIs上实现高精度且计算高效的多模态推理。

summary: Argumentative component detection (ACD) is a core subtask of Argument(ation) Mining (AM) and one of its most challenging aspects, as it requires jointly delimiting argumentative spans and classifying them into components such as claims and premises. While research on this subtask remains relatively limited compared to other AM tasks, most existing approaches formulate it as a simplified sequence labeling problem, component classification, or a pipeline of component segmentation followed by classification. In this paper, we propose ITFACD, a novel approach based on instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) using compact instruction-based prompts, and reframe ACD as a language generation task, enabling arguments to be identified directly from plain text without relying on pre-segmented components. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our approach achieves higher performance compared to state-of-the-art systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first attempts to fully model ACD as a generative task, highlighting the potential of instruction tuning for complex AM problems. Our code and the datasets used are openly available in the following GitHub repository.
title: Extracting Arguments, Not Just Classifying Them: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Generative Component Detection
title_translated: 提取论据，而不仅是分类：用于生成式组件检测的指令微调大语言模型
summary_translated: 论点组件检测（ACD）是论点挖掘（AM）的核心子任务之一，也是最具挑战性的方面之一，因为它需要联合界定论点片段并将其分类为诸如主张和前提等组件。尽管与其它AM任务相比，该子任务的研究仍相对有限，但大多数现有方法将其简化为序列标注问题、组件分类，或先分割再分类的流水线。本文提出ITFACD，一种基于指令微调的大语言模型（LLMs）的新方法，采用紧凑的指令提示，将ACD重新构想为语言生成任务，使论据能够直接从原始文本中识别，无需依赖预分割的组件。在标准基准上的实验表明，我们的方法性能优于当前最先进的系统。据我们所知，这是首次尝试将ACD完全建模为生成任务，突显了指令微调在复杂AM问题中的潜力。相关代码和数据集已公开发布于GitHub仓库。

summary: Continual learning with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA) typically mitigates forgetting by penalizing the overlap between a new update and the accumulated past weights, which discourages certain update directions without controlling how an update distributes its energy over the ones that remain. We ask whether that restriction has to be task-aware, or whether a generic one supplied by the optimizer is enough. We train a plain incremental LoRA (IncLoRA) with Muon, which orthogonalizes each update, and compare it against O-LoRA and ELLA over five seeds and three task orders on the Standard CL Benchmark and three seeds on TRACE. IncLoRA+Muon reaches the accuracy band of the dedicated methods on Standard CL and improves on every AdamW configuration on TRACE. One update-constraining mechanism is enough, whether it comes from the loss or from the optimizer; on Standard CL a second one does not help, and for the most restrictive method it costs 8.4 points of accuracy and the plasticity to fit each task. What separates the two optimizers is not the size of the update, which under Muon is 0.91 to 2.06 times that under AdamW, but how it is distributed. AdamW confines it to between 1.4 and 1.8 effective singular directions, Muon spreads it over 7.0, and the two do not overlap in any tracked run. Part of the advantage usually attributed to dedicated CL methods may therefore be explained by the geometry of the optimizer's updates.
title: Muon Can Outperform Dedicated Continual Learning Methods
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Presented at the 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), Work-in-Progress Track, 2026. Sebastian George Sincari and Bogdan Alexandru Gheorghe contributed equally
title_translated: Muon可超越专用持续学习方法
summary_translated: 使用低秩适配器（LoRA）的持续学习通常通过惩罚新更新与累积历史权重之间的重叠来缓解遗忘，但这会抑制某些更新方向，而无法控制更新能量在剩余权重上的分布。我们探讨这种限制是否必须依赖任务感知，还是优化器提供的通用机制就足够。我们使用Muon训练了一个简单的增量LoRA（IncLoRA），该方法对每次更新进行正交化，并在标准持续学习基准和TRACE上与O-LoRA和ELLA进行比较。IncLoRA+Muon在标准CL基准上达到了专用方法的准确率水平，并在TRACE的所有AdamW配置上表现更优。单一更新约束机制（无论来自损失还是优化器）已足够；在标准CL上，第二个约束无益，甚至对最严格的优化方法造成8.4分的准确率损失及适应各任务的可塑性下降。两个优化器之间的差异不在于更新大小（Muon下的更新大小为AdamW的0.91至2.06倍），而在于其分布方式：AdamW将其限制在1.4至1.8个有效奇异方向，而Muon则将其分散到7.0个方向，且在所有追踪运行中均无重叠。因此，以往归因于专用持续学习方法的优势，可能部分源于优化器更新的几何特性。

summary: Language models can be adapted by changing the computations applied to individual tokens. Quantum circuits offer one such approach, but evaluating wider circuits inside a large model can be computationally demanding. Here we introduce HyperQ, which adds token-conditioned quantum residual branches to a frozen masked-diffusion language model. A quantum residual branch is a module in each transformer block that reads a token's hidden state, emits the coordinates of that token's circuit, executes it, and adds the measured values back through a residual connection. The backbone remains frozen, and only the added branches are trained. Within each branch, a lightweight circuit hypernetwork emits token-specific rotation angles, coupling strengths, and measurement axes in a shared sparse circuit structure. The required expectation values have an exact classical expression whose evaluation cost grows linearly with the qubit count, enabling circuits from 16 to 64 qubits to be trained within a 1.1-billion-parameter backbone. Across downstream benchmarks, increasing circuit width raises the average score from 47.65 to 54.30. At 64 qubits, HyperQ exceeds the backbone and its low-rank-adapted counterpart by 4.71 and 3.67 points, respectively. HyperQ is fine-tuned on 20,000 prompt-response pairs, compared with 200,000 for the classical baselines. These findings support token-conditioned circuit emission as a tractable architectural approach to quantum-augmented language modelling.
title: Circuit Hypernetworks for Quantum-Augmented Diffusion Language Models
